original: sa hovāca prajāpatiḥ sa yo ha vai tatsāvitrasyāṣṭākṣaraṃ padaṃ śriyābhiṣiktaṃ tatsāmno'ṅgaṃ veda śriyā haivābhiṣicyate sarve vedāḥ praṇavādikāstaṃ praṇavaṃ tatsāmno'ṅgaṃ veda sa trīṃllokāñjayati caturviṃśatyakṣarā mahālakṣmīryajustatsāmno'ṅgaṃ veda sa āyuryaśaḥkīrtijñānai varyavānbhavati tasmādidaṃ sāṅgaṃ sāma jānīyādyo jānīte so'mṛtatvaṃ ca
analyzed: sa ha uvāca prajāpatiḥ sa yaḥ ha vai tat sāvitrasya aṣṭa akṣaram padam śriyā abhiṣiktam tat sāmnaḥ oṅgam veda śriyā ha eva abhiṣicyate sarve vedāḥ praṇava ādikāḥ tam praṇavam tat sāmnaḥ oṅgam veda sa trīn lokān jayati caturviṃśati akṣarā mahā lakṣmīḥ yajuḥ tat sāmnaḥ oṅgam veda saḥ āyuḥ yaśaḥ kīrti jñānaiḥ varyavān bhavati tasmāt idam sa aṅgam sāma jānīyāt yaḥ jānīte sa umṛta tvam ca

original: gacchati sāvitrīṃ praṇavaṃ yajurlakṣmīṃ strīśūdrāya necchanti dvātiṃraśadakṣaraṃ sāma jānīyādyo jānīte so'mṛtatvaṃ ca gacchati sāvitrīṃ lakṣmīṃ yajuḥ praṇavaṃ yadi jānīyātstrīśūdraḥ sa mṛto'dho gacchati tasmātsarvadā nācaṣṭe yadyācaṣṭe sa ācāryastenaiva mṛto'dho gacchati || 3 ||
analyzed: gacchati sāvitrīm praṇavam yajuḥ lakṣmīm strī śūdrāya na icchanti dvātiṃraśat akṣaram sāma jānīyāt yaḥ jānīte saḥ u mṛta tvam ca gacchati sāvitrīm lakṣmīm yajuḥ praṇavam yadi jānīyāt strī śūdraḥ sa mṛta ūdhaḥ gacchati tasmāt sarvadā na ācaṣṭe yadi ācaṣṭe saḥ ācāryaḥ tena eva mṛta ūdhaḥ gacchati

original: atra kila ṣaṭpra nāḥ pra nacatuṣṭayaṃ nairapekṣyeṇa aṅgapūrvatvādaṅgijñānasya pāriśeṣyācca sāmnoṅgaṃ taddaivataṃ pra nadvayena, sa prajāpatiḥ śrotṝṇāṃ bodhamarthitāṃ ca avekṣya harṣitaḥ, nipātānāmanekārthatvāt, uttaramuvāca -- sa yo ha vā iti | vīpsayā harṣanirbharatāṃ darśayati |
analyzed: atra kila ṣaṣ pra nāḥ pra na catuṣṭayam nairapekṣyeṇa aṅga pūrva tvāt aṅgi jñānasya pāriśeṣyāt ca sāmnā ṅgam tat daivatam pra na dvayena sa prajāpatiḥ śrotṝṇām bodham arthi tām ca avekṣya harṣitaḥ nipātānām aneka artha tvāt uttaram uvāca sa yaḥ ha vā iti vīpsayā harṣa nirbhara tām darśayati

original: sāvitrasya aṣṭākṣaraṃ padaṃ śriyā abhiṣiktaṃ śrībījenābhiṣiktamupariṣṭācchrībījamityarthaḥ | tatsāmnoṅgaṃ veda ityabhiṣiktamiti vadan śiraḥpūrvakatvādabhiṣekasya tasminnabhiṣikte śiro'ṅgasthāne sāmno'ṅgaṃ veda ityaṅgatāṃ vidhatte |
analyzed: sāvitrasya aṣṭa akṣaram padam śriyā abhiṣiktam śrī bījena abhiṣiktam upariṣṭāt śrī bījam iti arthaḥ tat sāmnaḥ oṅgam veda iti abhiṣiktam iti vadan śiraḥ pūrvaka tvāt abhiṣekasya tasmin abhiṣikte śiraḥ aṅga sthāne sāmnaḥ oṅgam veda iti aṅgatām vidhatte

original: śriyā haiva abhiṣicyata ityaṅgeṣu sarvatra phalaśravaṇam ṭha dravyasaṃskārakarmasu parārthatvātphalaśrutirarthavādaḥ syāt ' ityarthavādaḥ; ṭha anatidṛ cam̐ stṛṇāti prajayaivainaṃ paśubhiranatidṛ naṃ karoti ' iti nyāyena guṇaphalādhikāro vā |
analyzed: śriyā ha eva abhiṣicyate iti aṅgeṣu sarvatra phala śravaṇam dravya saṃskāra karmasu parārtha tvāt phala śrutiḥ arthavādaḥ syāt iti arthavādaḥ an atidṛ cam stṛṇāti prajayā eva enam paśubhiḥ an atidṛ nam karoti iti nyāyena guṇa phala adhikāraḥ vā

original: sarve vedāḥ praṇavādikāḥ taṃ praṇavamiti sarve vedā upavedā ca aṣṭau ityaṣṭasaṃkhyānantaraṃ tatsthāne hmadayāṅgasthāne praṇavaṃ vidadhat sarvavedādibhūtātpraṇavāt sāmākṣarāṇyadhikatarāṇaṇīti darśayati | tatsāmno'ṅgaṃ veda sa trīṃllokāñjayatītyuktārtham |
analyzed: sarve vedāḥ praṇava ādikāḥ tam praṇavam iti sarve vedāḥ upavedā ca aṣṭau iti aṣṭa saṃkhyā anantaram tad sthāne hmadayā aṅga sthāne praṇavam vidadhat sarva veda ādi bhūtāt praṇavāt sāma akṣarāṇi iti darśayati tat sāmnaḥ oṅgam veda sa trīn lokān jayati iti ukta artham

original: caturviṃśatyakṣarā mahālakṣmīryajuḥ tasma caturviṃśatyakṣarasthāne sāmatṛtīyapādādupariṣṭāt sāmno'ṅga veda śikhāṅgasthāna ityarthaḥ | sa āyuḥ yaśaḥ jñānapraśaṃsā kīrtiḥ janapraśaṃsā jñānai varyavānbhavatītyuktārtham | yasmādevaṃ sāmāṅgaphalam, tasmādidaṃ sāṅgaṃ sāma jānīyāt, yo jānīte so'mṛtatvaṃ ca gacchatītyuktārtham |
analyzed: caturviṃśati akṣarā mahā lakṣmīḥ yajuḥ caturviṃśati akṣara sthāne sāma tṛtīya pādāt upariṣṭāt veda śikhā aṅga sthāne iti arthaḥ saḥ āyuḥ yaśaḥ jñāna praśaṃsā kīrtiḥ jana praśaṃsā jñānaiḥ varyavān bhavati iti ukta artham yasmāt evam sāma aṅga phalam tasmāt idam sa aṅgam sāma jānīyāt yaḥ jānīte sa umṛta tvam ca gacchati iti ukta artham

original: sāvitrādimantrāṇāṃ hmadayādyaṅgasthāne prāptānām atra ādāveva aṅgatvavidhānārthamapakarṣastu upakramopasaṃhārābhyāṃ vidyaikye tātparyaṃ darśayati | sāvitrīṃ praṇavaṃ yajurlakṣmīṃ strīśūdrāya strī ca śūdra ca strīśūdram tasmai strīśūdrāya necchantīti niṣedhaṃ kurvan pradhānopāsanāyāṃ strīśūdrasyāpyadhikāraṃ darśayati |
analyzed: sāvitra ādi mantrāṇām hma dayā ādi aṅga sthāne prāptānām atra ādau eva aṅga tva vidhāna artham apakarṣaḥ tu upakrama upasaṃhārābhyām vidyā aikye tātparyam darśayati sāvitrīm praṇavam yajuḥ lakṣmīm strī śūdrāya strī ca śūdra ca strī śūdram tasmai strī śūdrāya na icchanti iti niṣedham kurvan pradhāna upāsanāyām strī śūdrasya api adhikāram darśayati

original: dvātiṃraśadakṣaraṃ sāma jānīyāditi dvātiṃraśadakṣarāṇāṃ sāmasaṃbandhaṃ vidhatte | yo jānīte ityādyuktārtham | sāvitrīṃ lakṣmīṃ yajuḥ praṇavaṃ yadi jānīyāt strīśūdraḥ, sa mṛtaḥ adhaḥ narakaṃ gacchatīti pratyavāyadarśanena niṣedhameva draḍhayati | tasmātsarvadā na ācaṣṭe iti kadācidapi na ācaṣṭe ityācāryasya niṣedhaṃ darśayati |

original: yadyācaṣṭe ca ācāryaḥ, tenaiva kathanena mṛtaḥ adhaḥ gacchatīti pratyavāyadarśanena niṣedhameva draḍhayatīti ||

original: kṣīrodārṇavaśāyinaṃ nṛkesariṃ yogidhyeyaṃ paramaṃ padaṃ sāma jānīyādyo jānīte so'mṛtatvaṃ ca gacchati vīraṃ prathamasyārdhāntyaṃ taṃsaṃ dvitīyasyārdhāntyaṃ haṃbhī tṛtīyasyārdhāntyaṃ mṛtyuṃ caturthasyārdhāntyaṃ sāma jānīyādyo jānīte so'mṛtatvaṃ ca gacchati tasmādidaṃ sāma yena kenacidācāryamukhena yo jānīte sa tenaiva śarīreṇa saṃsārānmucyate
analyzed: kṣīroda arṇava śāyinam nṛkesarim yogi dhyeyam paramam padam sāma jānīyāt yaḥ jānīte sa umṛta tvam ca gacchati vīram prathamasya ardha antyam taṃsam dvitīyasya ardha antyam haṃbhī tṛtīyasya ardha antyam mṛtyum caturthasya ardha antyam sāma jānīyāt yaḥ jānīte sa umṛta tvam ca gacchati tasmāt idam sāma yena kenacid ācārya mukhena yaḥ jānīte sa tena eva śarīreṇa saṃsārāt mucyate

original: mocayati mumukṣurbhavati japāttenaiva śarīreṇa devatādarśanaṃ karoti tasmādidameva mukhyaṃ dvāraṃ kalau nānyeṣāṃ bhavati tasmādidaṃ sāṅgaṃ sāma jānīyādyo jānīte sa mumukṣurbhavati|| 5||
analyzed: mocayati mumukṣuḥ bhavati japāt tena eva śarīreṇa devatā darśanam karoti tasmāt idam eva mukhyam dvāram kalau na anyeṣām bhavati tasmāt idam sa aṅgam sāma jānīyāt yaḥ jānīte sa mumukṣuḥ bhavati

original: sa hovāca prajāpatiragnirvai vedā idaṃ sarvaṃ vi vāni bhūtāni prāṇā vā indriyāṇi paśavo'nnamamṛtaṃ samrāṭsvarāḍvirāṭtatsāmnaḥ prathamaṃ pādaṃ jānīyādṛgyajuḥsāmātharvarūpaḥ sūryo'ntarādityo hiraṇmayaḥ puruṣastatsāmno dvitīyaṃ pādaṃ jānīyādya oṣadhīnāṃ prabhavati tārāpatiḥ somastatsāmnastṛtīyaṃ pādaṃ jānīyātsa brāhṛā sa śivaḥ sa hariḥ sa indraḥ
analyzed: sa ha uvāca prajāpatiḥ agniḥ vai vedāḥ idam sarvam vi bhūtāni prāṇāḥ vai indriyāṇi paśavaḥ unnam amṛtam samrāj svarāj virāj tat sāmnaḥ prathamam pādam jānīyāt ṛc yajuḥ sāma atharva rūpaḥ sūryaḥ antarādityaḥ hiraṇmayaḥ puruṣaḥ tat sāmnaḥ dvitīyam pādam jānīyāt yaḥ oṣadhīnām prabhavati tārāpatiḥ somaḥ tat sāmnaḥ tṛtīyam pādam jānīyāt sa brāhṛā sa śivaḥ sa hariḥ saḥ indraḥ

original: so'gniḥ so'kṣaraḥ paramaḥ svarāṭtatsāmna caturthaṃ pādaṃ jānīyādyo jānīte so'mṛtatvaṃ ca gacchati | oṃ ugraṃ prathamasyādyaṃ jvalaṃ dvitīyasyādyaṃ nṛsiṃ tṛtīyasyādyaṃ mṛtyuṃ caturthasyādyaṃ sāma jānīyādyo jānīte so'mṛtatvaṃ ca gacchati tasmādidaṃ sāma yatra kutracinnācaṣṭe yadi dātumapekṣate putrāya śuśrūṣave dāsyatyanyasmai śiṣyāya ceti || 4 ||

original: tathā yakṣagandharvādiguṇaviśiṣṭamantarikṣaṃ śiro'ntarvartitvena sarvavedamayaḥ sūryo hiraṇmayaḥ puruṣastatsāmno dvitīyapādasya śiromantrasya ca tadaṅgasya sāvitramantrasya ca daivatamiti pārame varaṃ śiro vyākhyātam |

original: satyaṃ bhavatu yaugikaḥ, tathāpyubhayoddhāre sāmoddhārastu siddha eva | evaṃ rūḍhervaidikaprayogācca sāmoddhāre sthite dvātiṃraśadakṣaraṃ sāma jānīyāditi sāmānyākāreṇa sāmasaṃbandhe siddhe viśeṣākāreṇa mūlamantrākṣarāṇāṃ sāmasaṃbandhaṃ vidhātumāha -- ugraṃ prathamasyādyamityādinā | atra hi sāmagānāṃ haste mukhasvaranirṇayo draṣṭavyaḥ |
analyzed: satyam bhavatu yaugikaḥ tathā api ubhaya uddhāre sāma uddhāraḥ tu siddhaḥ eva evam rūḍheḥ vaidika prayogāt ca sāma uddhāre sthite dvātiṃraśat akṣaram sāma jānīyāt iti sāmānya ākāreṇa sāma saṃbandhe siddhe viśeṣa ākāreṇa mūlamantra akṣarāṇām sāma saṃbandham vidhātum āha ugram prathamasya ādyam ityādinā atra hi sāmagānām haste mukha svara nirṇayaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ

original: saptadhā hi svaraḥ ṣaḍjādibhedena | tatra hastagatasvarānusāreṇa mukhena gītyuccāraṇam; tatra hastāṅguṣṭhottamaparvaṇaḥ krauṣṭakasaṃjñaṃ uccairbhāve kṛte sarvodāttāṃ trimātraṃ caturmātrāṃ pañcamātrāṃ vā kṛtvā vihitākṣareṣu gītiṃ gāyet; tāmādyaṃ nirapekṣaṃ svaramityācakṣate;
analyzed: saptadhā hi svaraḥ ṣaḍja ādi bhedena tatra hasta gata svara anusāreṇa mukhena gīti uccāraṇam tatra hasta aṅguṣṭha uttama parvaṇaḥ krauṣṭaka saṃjñam uccairbhāve kṛte sarva udāttām tri mātram catur mātrām pañca mātrām vā kṛtvā vihita akṣareṣu gītim gāyet tām ādyam nirapekṣam svaram iti ācakṣate

original: tato'ṅguṣṭhottamaparvaṇaḥ vakrībhāve kṛte pūrvodāttāpekṣayā anudāttām uttarāpekṣayā udāttām evamevāṅguṣṭhena tarjanīmadhyamaparvasparśe kṛte tatsaṃnihitāṅgulisparśa upakaniṣṭhikāsparśe kaniṣṭhakāmadhyamaparvasparśe kṛte pūrvapūrvāpekṣayā uttarottarāpekṣayā udāttānudāttātmikāṃ vihitākṣareṣu gītimuccārya aṅguṣṭhena kaniṣṭhikāmūlaparvasparśe kṛte

analyzed: sarva anudāttām gītim uccārayet tam tu antyam svaram iti ācakṣate evam mukha hastābhyām ṣaḍja ādayaḥ yathākramam sapta svarāḥ niṣpādyante saḥ eṣa sāmagānām sarva sāma sādhāraṇaḥ svara nirṇayaḥ

original: tata ca, ugraṃ prathamasya ādyaṃ sarvodāttaṃ sāmapadānuṣaṅgāt ukte akṣaradvaye ādyam ādyasvarātmakaṃ sāma jānīyāditi vidhīyate, anyathā prathamapādasya ādyam akṣaradvayaṃ jānīyāt ityetasya dvitīyopaniṣaduktapadoddhārādeva jñātatvāt ṭha aprāpte śāstramarthavat ' iti nyāyo bādhitaḥ syāt, sāmapadasya vyarthatā syāt, ubhayavidhāne ca vākyabhedaḥ syāt
analyzed: ca ugram prathamasya ādyam sarva udāttam sāma pada anuṣaṅgāt ukte akṣara dvaye ādyam ādya svara ātmakam sāma jānīyāt iti vidhīyate anyathā prathama pādasya ādyam akṣara dvayam jānīyāt iti etasya dvitīya upaniṣad ukta pada uddhārāt eva jñāta tvāt aprāpte śāstram arthavat iti nyāyaḥ bādhitaḥ syāt sāma padasya vyartha tā syāt ubhaya vidhāne ca vākya bhedaḥ syāt

original: | veditavyasāmasaṃbandhasvaraviśeṣe vihite anirdhāritasvaraviśeṣakaṃ sāma kathaṃ vidhātuṃ śakyeta ? tasmāt mūlamantroktaprathamapādākṣaradvayasya ādyaśabdoktasvaraviśeṣātmakasāmasaṃbandha eva vidhīyate | evamuttareṣvapi triṣu vākyeṣu yojanīyam | jvalaṃ dvitīyasya pādasya ādyaṃ sāma gītiṃ jānīyāt | nṛsiṃ tṛtīyasya ādyamityuktārtham |
analyzed: veditavya sāma saṃbandha svara viśeṣe vihite anirdhārita svara viśeṣakam sāma katham vidhātum śakyeta tasmāt mūlamantra ukta prathama pāda akṣara dvayasya ādya śabda ukta svara viśeṣa ātmaka sāma saṃbandhaḥ eva vidhīyate evam uttareṣu api triṣu vākyeṣu yojanīyam jvalam dvitīyasya pādasya ādyam sāma gītim jānīyāt nṛsim tṛtīyasya ādyam iti ukta artham

original: mṛtyuṃ caturthasya ādyamityādi gacchatītyantam uktārtham | yasmādidaṃ sāma paramarahasyataram, tasmādidaṃ sāma yatra kutracitpuṃsi na ācaṣṭe iti kathayiturniṣedhaḥ | yadi dātumapekṣate putrāya śuśrūṣave śuśrūṣāratāya ācāryopasarpaṇena śraṇecchāvate dāsyati dadyādityarthaḥ | anyasmai śiṣyāya prāguktalakṣaṇāya ca iti |
analyzed: mṛtyum caturthasya ādyam ityādi gacchati iti antam ukta artham yasmāt idam sāma parama rahasyataram tasmāt idam sāma yatra kutracid puṃsi na ācaṣṭe iti kathayituḥ niṣedhaḥ yadi dātum apekṣate putrāya śuśrūṣave śuśrūṣā ratāya ācārya upasarpaṇena dāsyati dadyāt iti arthaḥ anyasmai śiṣyāya prāk ukta lakṣaṇāya ca iti

original: itiśabdaḥ sāmadātṛpratigrahītroḥ adhikārasamāpta dyotayati ||
analyzed: iti śabdaḥ sāma dātṛ pratigrahītroḥ adhikāra samāpta dyotayati

original: evaṃ tāvatsāmnā saha dātṛpratigrahītroḥ saṃbandhaṃ vidhāya śrīkṣīrodārṇavaśāyino nṛkesariṇo yogivadāsīnasya śayānasya vā dhyeyasya āśrayāśrayilakṣaṇasaṃbandhaviśeṣopāsanāṃ kṛtsnaphalavatīṃ vidhātumāha --
analyzed: evam tāvat sāmnā saha dātṛ pratigrahītroḥ saṃbandham vidhāya śrī kṣīroda arṇava śāyinaḥ nṛ kesariṇaḥ yogi vat āsīnasya śayānasya vā dhyeyasya āśraya āśrayi lakṣaṇa saṃbandha viśeṣa upāsanām kṛtsna phalavatīm vidhātum āha

original: oṃ ṛtaṃ satyaṃ paraṃ brāhṛ puruṣaṃ nṛkesarivigraham| kṛṣṇapiṅgalamūdhrvaretaṃ virūpākṣaṃ śaṃkaraṃ nīlalohitamumāpatiṃ paśupatiṃ pinākinaṃ hramitadyutimīśānaḥ sarvavidyānāmīśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ brāhṛādhipatibrrāhṛṇo'dhipatiryo yajurvedavācyastaṃ sāma jānīyādyo jānīte so'mṛtatvaṃ ca gacchati|
analyzed: om ṛtam satyam param puruṣam nṛ kesari vigraham kṛṣṇa piṅgalam ūdhrva retam virūpākṣam śaṃkaram nīlalohitam umāpatim paśupatim pinākinam hramita dyutim īśānaḥ sarva vidyānām īśvaraḥ sarva bhūtānām brāhṛa adhipati brrāhṛṇa adhipatiḥ yaḥ yajurveda vācyaḥ tam sāma jānīyāt yaḥ jānīte sa umṛta tvam ca gacchati

original: mahā prathamāntārdhasyādyaṃrvato dvitīyāntārdhasyādyaṃ ṣaṇaṃ tṛtīyāntārdhasyādyaṃ namā caturthāntārdhasyādyaṃ sāma jānīyādyo jānīte so'mṛtatvaṃ ca gacchati| tasmādidaṃ saccidānandamayaṃ paraṃ brāhṛ tamevaṃ vidvānamṛta iha bhavati| tasmādidaṃ sāṅgaṃ sāma jānīyādyo jānīte so'mṛtatvaṃ ca gacchati|| 6||
analyzed: mahā prathama anta ardhasya ādyam ṣaṇam tṛtīya anta ardhasya ādyam namā caturtha anta ardhasya ādyam sāma jānīyāt yaḥ jānīte sa umṛta tvam ca gacchati tasmāt idam saccidānanda mayam param brāhṛ tam evam vidvān amṛtaḥ iha bhavati tasmāt idam sa aṅgam sāma jānīyāt yaḥ jānīte sa umṛta tvam ca gacchati

original: kṣīrodārṇavaśāyinaṃ nṛkesariṃ yogidhyeyaṃ paramaṃ padaṃ sāma jānīyādyo jānīte so'mṛtatvaṃ ca gacchati vīraṃ prathamasyārdhāntyaṃ taṃsaṃ dvitīyasyārdhāntyaṃ haṃbhī tṛtīyasyārdhāntyaṃ mṛtyuṃ caturthasyārdhāntyaṃ sāma jānīyādyo jānīte so'mṛtatvaṃ ca gacchati tasmādidaṃ sāma yena kenacidācāryamukhena yo jānīte sa tenaiva śarīreṇa saṃsārānmucyate
analyzed: kṣīroda arṇava śāyinam nṛkesarim yogi dhyeyam paramam padam sāma jānīyāt yaḥ jānīte sa umṛta tvam ca gacchati vīram prathamasya ardha antyam taṃsam dvitīyasya ardha antyam haṃbhī tṛtīyasya ardha antyam mṛtyum caturthasya ardha antyam sāma jānīyāt yaḥ jānīte sa umṛta tvam ca gacchati tasmāt idam sāma yena kenacid ācārya mukhena yaḥ jānīte sa tena eva śarīreṇa saṃsārāt mucyate

original: mocayati mumukṣurbhavati japāttenaiva śarīreṇa devatādarśanaṃ karoti tasmādidameva mukhyaṃ dvāraṃ kalau nānyeṣāṃ bhavati tasmādidaṃ sāṅgaṃ sāma jānīyādyo jānīte sa mumukṣurbhavati || 5 ||
analyzed: mocayati mumukṣuḥ bhavati japāt tena eva śarīreṇa devatā darśanam karoti tasmāt idam eva mukhyam dvāram kalau na anyeṣām bhavati tasmāt idam sa aṅgam sāma jānīyāt yaḥ jānīte sa mumukṣuḥ bhavati

original: kṣīrodārṇavaśāyinaṃ nā cāsau kesarī ca nṛkesarī taṃ nṛkesariṇam | nṛkesarimiti chāndasam | yogivadāsīnaṃ śeṣabhogamastakaparivṛtaṃ rahasyakalpāntaraparyālocanayā asminneva sthāne śākhāntaraśrutyantaraparyālocanayā āsīnaṃ śeṣabhogamūrdhāvṛtam | dviśākhagāminī iyamupaniṣat bhṛguśākhāyām āṅgirasaśākhāyāṃ ca | paramaṃ padaṃ paramāśrayabhūtam |
analyzed: kṣīroda arṇava śāyinam nā ca asau kesarī ca nṛ kesarī tam nṛ kesariṇam nṛ kesarim iti chāndasam yogi vat āsīnam śeṣa bhoga mastaka parivṛtam rahasya kalpa antara paryālocanayā asmin eva sthāne śākhā antara śruti antara paryālocanayā āsīnam śeṣa bhoga mūrdha āvṛtam dvi śākhā gāminī iyam upaniṣad bhṛgu śākhāyām āṅgirasa śākhāyām ca paramam padam parama āśraya bhūtam

original: jānīyāditi sarvatrānuṣajyate | sāmetyādi gacchatītyantam uktārthaṃ bhavati | yatsāma jānīyāt taduktaguṇaviśiṣṭe nṛkesariṇi sāṅgaṃ nyastaṃ jānīyādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: jānīyāt iti sarvatra anuṣajyate sāma ityādi gacchati ityantam ukta artham bhavati yat sāma jānīyāt tad ukta guṇa viśiṣṭe nṛ kesariṇi sāṅgam nyastam jānīyāt iti arthaḥ

original: idānīṃ sāmno dvitīyoddhāramakṣarāṇāṃ svaraviśeṣasaṃbandhārthamāha -- vīraṃ prathamasyārdhāntyaṃ prathamapadoktākṣaradvaya ādyārdhe ṭha prathamātikrame kāraṇābhāvāt ' iti nyāyena antyam antyasvarātmakaṃ sāma jānīyāt ityanuṣajyate | ata eva asminneva sthāne śākhāntare pāṭhāntare vīraṃ prathamādyārdhasya antyamiti |
analyzed: idānīm sāmnaḥ dvitīya uddhāram akṣarāṇām svara viśeṣa saṃbandha artham āha vīram prathamasya ardha antyam prathama pada ukta akṣara dvaye ādya ardhe prathama atikrame kāraṇa abhāvāt iti nyāyena antyam antya svara ātmakam sāma jānīyāt iti anuṣajyate atas eva asmin eva sthāne śākhā antare pāṭha antare vīram prathama ādya ardhasya antyam iti

original: atrāpi vidhānaviṣaye prāgukte codyasamādhāne | tato vīro anudāttātmikā gītiḥ; raṃ madhyavartisvarātmakā gītiḥ; evamuttareṣvapi taduddhāvākyeṣu yojanīyam | taṃsaṃ dvitīyasyārdhāntyam ityuktārtham | tam anudāttātmikā gītiḥ; haṃsabhī tṛtīyasyārdhāntyam | tṛtīyādyārdhasya antyamiti pāṭhāntaram | ham anudāttātmikā gītiḥ;
analyzed: atra api vidhāna viṣaye prāk ukte codya samādhāne tatas vīraḥ anudātta ātmikā gītiḥ raṃ madhya varti svara ātmakā gītiḥ evam uttareṣu api tad uddhā vākyeṣu yojanīyam taṃsam dvitīyasya ardha antyam iti ukta artham tam anudātta ātmikā gītiḥ haṃsabhī tṛtīyasya ardha antyam tṛtīya ādya ardhasya antyam iti pāṭha antaram ham anudātta ātmikā gītiḥ

original: bhī madhyavartisvarātmikā gītiḥ; mṛ anudāttātmikā gītiḥ; tyuṃ pāriśeṣyānmadhyavartisvarātmikā gītiḥ; caturthasyārdhāntyam ityuktārtham | mṛtyuṃ caturthādyārdhasya antyamiti pāṭhāntaram | sāmetyādi gacchatītyantam uktārtham | yasmātsāmaikadeśaparijñānāt
analyzed: madhya varti svara ātmikā gītiḥ mṛ anudātta ātmikā gītiḥ tyuṃ pāriśeṣyāt madhya varti svara ātmikā gītiḥ caturthasya ardha antyam iti ukta artham mṛtyum caturtha ādya ardhasya antyam iti pāṭha antaram sāma ityādi gacchati iti antam ukta artham yasmāt sāma eka deśa parijñānāt

original: kṛtsnaphalāvāptiḥ tatra kṛtsnasāmaparijñāne kimutetyāha -- tasmādidaṃ vihitākṣareṣūddhṛtaṃ kṛtsnaṃ sāma yena kenacit yena kenāpi sāmoddhāravākyakadambakenāpi yo jānīte ityanuṣaṅgaḥ | ācāryamukhena yo jānīte ityācāryamukhopāyāntarayorvikalpaḥ | yadvā ācāryaśabdo vedamabhidhatte, ṭha tasmādācāryavacaḥ pramāṇam ' ityādau prayogāt;
analyzed: kṛtsna phala avāptiḥ tatra kṛtsna sāma parijñāne kim uta iti āha tasmāt idam vihita akṣareṣu uddhṛtam kṛtsnam sāma yena kenacid yena kena api sāma uddhāra vākya kadambakena api yaḥ jānīte iti anuṣaṅgaḥ ācārya mukhena yaḥ jānīte iti ācārya mukha upāya antarayoḥ vikalpaḥ yat vā ācārya śabdaḥ vedam abhidhatte tasmāt ācārya vacaḥ pramāṇam iti ādau prayogāt

original: ācāryamukhena vedamukhena sāmoddhāravākyakadambakenetyarthaḥ | sa tenaiva svayameva sāmaparijñānena saṃsārānmucyate, mocayati anyaṃ vā sāma jñāpayan | sāmaparijñānāt sarāgo'pi mumukṣurbhavati japāt, saṃkhyānupādānāt sakṛdeva sāmajapāt |
analyzed: ācārya mukhena veda mukhena sāma uddhāra vākya kadambakena iti arthaḥ sa tena eva svayam eva sāma parijñānena saṃsārāt mucyate mocayati anyam vā sāma jñāpayan sāma parijñānāt sa rāgaḥ upi mumukṣuḥ bhavati japāt saṃkhyā anupādānāt sakṛt eva sāma japāt

original: yatsāṅgena sāmnā pārame varaṃ śarīraṃ kṣīrodārṇavaśāyītyādipadakadambakavyākṛtam, tenaiva śarīreṇa devatādarśanaṃ karoti devatā pratyakṣā bhavati | tasmādidameva sāṅgaṃ sāmaiva mukhyaṃ dvāraṃ devatādarśane tavdyākṛtau ca; kalau pāpabahulyena anyeṣāṃ sāmarahitānāṃ kevalamūlamantra parijñātṝṇāṃ devatādarśanaṃ jhaṭiti na bhavatītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: yat sa aṅgena sāmnā pārame varam śarīram kṣīroda arṇava śāyi ityādi pada kadambaka vyākṛtam tena eva śarīreṇa devatā darśanam karoti devatā pratyakṣā bhavati tasmāt idam eva sa aṅgam sāma eva mukhyam dvāram devatā darśane ca kalau pāpa bahulyena anyeṣām sāma rahitānām kevala mūlamantra parijñātṝṇām devatā darśanam jhaṭiti na bhavati iti arthaḥ

original: yasmādidaṃ sāṅgaṃ sāma devatādarśane devatākāravyākṛtau ca mukhyameva dvāram, tasmādidaṃ sāṅgaṃ sāma jānīyāt; mumukṣurbhavati mānuṣānandārūḍho'pi etatparijñānāt mānuṣānandaṃ vihāya mokṣepsurbhavati | yadvā mumukṣuḥ etajjānīyāt ityanvayaḥ | tasya bhavatīti phalanirdeśaḥ | bhū sattāyāmiti dhātoḥ rūpam |
analyzed: yasmāt idam sa aṅgam sāma devatā darśane devatā ākāra vyākṛtau ca mukhyam eva dvāram tasmāt idam sa aṅgam sāma jānīyāt mumukṣuḥ bhavati mānuṣa ānanda ārūḍhaḥ api etad parijñānāt mānuṣa ānandam vihāya mokṣa īpsuḥ bhavati yat vā mumukṣuḥ etat jānīyāt iti anvayaḥ tasya bhavati iti phala nirdeśaḥ sattāyām iti dhātoḥ rūpam

original: atra kecitprāguktamākāraṃ mantravarṇātpṛthaktvena upāsyamācakṣate; tadayuktam, evaṃ tarhi upakramopasaṃhārābhyāṃ nṛsiṃhabrāhṛvidyaikyamavagataṃ bādhyeta | nṛsiṃhapadavyākhyānāvasare nṛsiṃha eva āsītparame vara iti nṛsiṃhe varayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyamavagataṃ bādhyeta | tasmāt trinetrādyākāraviśiṣṭaḥ asyāṃ vidyāyāṃ nṛsiṃha evopāsya iti siddham |
analyzed: atra kecid prāc uktam ākāram mantra varṇāt pṛthaktvena upāsyam ācakṣate tat ayuktam evam tarhi upakrama upasaṃhārābhyām nṛsiṃha brāhṛ vidyā aikyam avagatam bādhyeta nṛsiṃha pada vyākhyāna avasare nṛsiṃhaḥ eva āsīt parame vare iti nṛsiṃhe varayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyam avagatam bādhyeta tasmāt trinetra ādi ākāra viśiṣṭaḥ asyām vidyāyām nṛsiṃhaḥ eva upāsyaḥ iti siddham

original: athedānīṃ tṛtīyaṃ sāmoddhāramāha -- ma pāriśeṣyānmadhyasvaravartigītiḥ; hā sarvodāttātmikā gītiḥ; prathamāntārdhasya ādyamiti | prathamapādoktākṣaradvaye antyārdhasya ādyasvaram ādyasvarayuktaṃ sāma jānīyāt ityanuṣajyate | rva pāriśeṣyānmadhyasvaravartigītiḥ; to sarvodāttātmikā gītiḥ; dvitīyāntārdhasya ādyamityuktārtham | ṣa
analyzed: atha idānīm tṛtīyam sāma uddhāram āha pāriśeṣyāt madhya svara varti gītiḥ hā sarva udātta ātmikā gītiḥ prathama anta ardhasya ādyam iti prathama pāda ukta akṣara dvaye antya ardhasya ādya svaram ādya svara yuktam sāma jānīyāt iti anuṣajyate pāriśeṣyāt madhya svara varti gītiḥ sarva udātta ātmikā gītiḥ dvitīya anta ardhasya ādyam iti ukta artham ṣaṣ adhika ardhasya ādyam iti ukta artham ṣaṣ adhika ardhasya ādyam iti ukta artham

original: pāriśeṣyānmadhyasvaravartigītiḥ; ṇam, sarvodāttātmikā gītiḥ; tṛtīyāntārdhasya ādyamityuktārtham | na pāriśeṣyānmadhyasvaravartigītiḥ; mā sarvodāttātmikā gītiḥ; caturthāntārdhasya ādyamityuktārtham | sāmetyādi gacchatītyantam uktārtham |
analyzed: pāriśeṣyāt madhya svara varti gītiḥ sarva udātta ātmikā gītiḥ tṛtīya anta ardhasya ādyam iti ukta artham na pāriśeṣyāt madhya svara varti gītiḥ mā sarva udātta ātmikā gītiḥ caturtha anta ardhasya ādyam iti ukta artham sāma ityādi gacchati ityantam ukta artham

original: nanu atra akṣaradvayamadhye antārdhasyetyantasya akṣarasyārdhaṃ dīrghādimātrā tasyā ādyasvarasaṃbandhaḥ kasmānna vidhīyate ? tanna, ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣātkarmadhārayasya balīyastvāt | antaṃ ca tadardhaṃ ca antārdhaṃ prathamāpekṣayā dvitīyamakṣaram antaṃ ca tadardhaṃ ceti;
analyzed: nanu atra akṣara dvaya madhye anta ardhasya iti antasya akṣarasya ardham dīrgha ādi mātrā tasyāḥ ādya svara saṃbandhaḥ kasmāt na vidhīyate tat na ṣaṣṭhī tatpuruṣāt karmadhārayasya balīyaḥ tvāt antam ca tad ardham ca anta ardham prathama apekṣayā dvitīyam akṣaram antam ca tad ardham ca iti

original: anyathā antasyākṣarasya mātrādi ardhamiti ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣaḥ, ṭha etayā nipādasthapatiṃ yājayet ' iti nyāyāt | nanu atitucchametat, mātrāyāmapyādhārāpekṣayā karmadhārayasaṃbhavāt | satyam | ṭha dvātiṃraśadakṣaraṃ sāma ' ityatra dvātiṃraśadakṣarāṇāmeva svarātmakasāmasaṃbandhaḥ śrūyate, na mātrāṇām;
analyzed: anyathā antasya akṣarasya mātrā ādi ardham iti ṣaṣṭhī tatpuruṣaḥ etayā nipāda sthapatim yājayet iti nyāyāt nanu ati tuccham etat mātrāyām api ādhāra apekṣayā karmadhāraya saṃbhavāt satyam dvātiṃraśat akṣaram sāma iti atra dvātiṃraśat akṣarāṇām eva svara ātmaka sāma saṃbandhaḥ śrūyate na mātrāṇām

original: tasmādantārdhaśabdena dvitīyākṣarasyaiva ādyasvarasaṃbandho vidhīyata iti siddham | yasmātsāmaikadeśo'pi kṛtsnaphalāvāptau kṣamaḥ, kimuta kṛtsnasāmajñānam | tasmādidaṃ saccidānandamayaṃ paraṃ brāhṛ, tādṛśanṛsiṃhapratipādakamūlamantrābhivyañjakatvāt paraṃ brāhṛ jānīyādityanuṣajyate |
analyzed: tasmāt anta ardha śabdena dvitīya akṣarasya eva ādya svara saṃbandhaḥ vidhīyate iti siddham yasmāt sāma eka deśaḥ api kṛtsna phala avāptau kṣamaḥ kim uta kṛtsna sāma jñānam tasmāt idam saccidānanda mayam param brāhṛ tādṛśa nṛsiṃha pratipādaka mūlamantra abhivyañjaka tvāt param brāhṛ jānīyāt iti anuṣajyate

original: sāmābhivyaktamūlamantrapratipādyo'yaṃ nṛsiṃhākārasaccidānandaṃ paraṃ brāhṛetyekaḥ saṃbandhaḥ | yadvā saccidānandamayaṃ brāhṛetyekaḥ | prāṅmantravarṇāt brāhṛākāratā pratipāditāpi adṛḍhā syāditi śaṅkā, tavdyāvṛttyarthamidamucyate -- saccidānandamayaṃ brāhṛ jānīyāditi |
analyzed: sāma abhivyakta mūlamantra pratipādyaḥ yam nṛsiṃha ākāra saccidānandam param brāhṛ iti ekaḥ saṃbandhaḥ yat vā saccidānanda mayam brāhṛ iti ekaḥ prāk mantra varṇāt brāhṛ ākāra tā pratipāditā api adṛḍhā syāt iti śaṅkā idam ucyate saccidānanda mayam brāhṛ jānīyāt iti

original: taṃ nṛsiṃhakāramamum evamuktaprakāreṇa vidvān jānan amṛte kṣīre ṭha pañcāmṛtānyānaya ' ityādāvamṛtaśabdasya kṣīre dṛṣṭatvāt, ihaiva loke utkṛṣṭo bhavatītyarthaḥ | yadvā evaṃ pañcāṅganyāse kṛte ihaiva jīvanmukto bhavati ānando bhavatītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: tam nṛsiṃha kāram amum evam ukta prakāreṇa vidvān jānan amṛte kṣīre pañcāmṛtāni ānaya ityādau amṛta śabdasya kṣīre dṛṣṭa tvāt iha eva loke utkṛṣṭaḥ bhavati iti arthaḥ yat vā evam pañcāṅga nyāse kṛte iha eva jīvanmuktaḥ bhavati ānandaḥ bhavati iti arthaḥ

original: yasmātsāṅgaṃ sāma kṛtsnanṛsiṃhabrāhṛvidyāpratipādakamūlamantrābhivyañjakam, tasmādidamityādi gacchatītyantam uktārtham ||
analyzed: yasmāt sa aṅgam sāma kṛtsna nṛsiṃha brāhṛ vidyā pratipādaka mūlamantra abhivyañjakam tasmāt idam ityādi gacchati ityantam ukta artham

original: asya sāmnaḥ uktaprakāreṇa vi varuāṣṭṛtvaṃ darśayitumāha --
analyzed: asya sāmnaḥ ukta prakāreṇa vi varuāṣṭṛ tvam darśayitum āha

original: evaṃ tāvat yadaṅgam upāsyadevatākāravyākṛtau kṣamam, tadevāṅgaṃ nirdiśan āha -- omiti | etaccaturthopaniṣadi spaṣṭīkariṣyati -- omityetadakṣaram ityādinā | nṛkesarivigraho vyākhyātaḥ;
analyzed: evam tāvat yat aṅgam upāsya devatā ākāra vyākṛtau kṣamam tat eva aṅgam nirdiśan āha om iti etat caturtha upaniṣadi spaṣṭīkariṣyati om iti etat akṣaram ityādinā nṛkesari vigrahaḥ vyākhyātaḥ

original: sa na svamāyayā līlāvigrahaḥ, kiṃ tu karmavipākajanmānubhavarūpāṇāṃ kevalatiryagrūpāṇāṃ matsyakūrmādīnāṃ kevalātiryagrūpāṇāṃ vāmanādīnāṃ līlārūpatvenaiva dṛṣṭatvāt asya ca tadvilakṣaṇatvāt na svamāyālīlāvigrahatā syāditi imāmāśaṅkā mantravarṇādapanetuṃ mantramāha -- ṛtaṃ satyaṃ paraṃ brāhṛ puruṣaṃ nṛkesarivigraham |
analyzed: sa na sva māyayā līlā vigrahaḥ kiṃ tu karma vipāka janma anubhava rūpāṇām kevala tiryagrūpāṇām matsya kūrma ādīnām kevala atiryagrūpāṇām vāmana ādīnām līlā rūpa tvena eva dṛṣṭa tvāt asya ca tad vilakṣaṇa tvāt na sva māyā līlā vigrahatā syāt iti imām āśaṅkāḥ mantra varṇāt apanetum mantram āha ṛtam satyam param puruṣam nṛ kesari vigraham

original: nā ca puruṣa ca kesarī ca siṃha ca nṛkesarī | tatra puruṣamityanūdya satyaṃ paraṃ brāhṛ jānīyāditi vidhīyate | etaduktaṃ bhavati -- satyasya parabrāhṛṇaḥ svamāyayā līlāvigrahaṃ puruṣākāram ṛtamiti paramārthaṃ jānīyāditi yāvat |
analyzed: nā ca puruṣa ca kesarī ca siṃha ca nṛkesarī tatra puruṣam iti anūdya satyam param jānīyāt iti vidhīyate etat uktam bhavati satyasya para brāhṛṇaḥ sva māyayā līlā vigraham puruṣa ākāram ṛtam iti paramārtham jānīyāt iti yāvat

original: yadvā, ṛtaṃ satyaṃ paraṃ brāhṛ brāhṛātmakaṃ puruṣākāram omityoṃkāreṇa vyākhyātam, ṛtamiti dhananāma ṛtamayaṃ hiraṇyamayaṃ hiraṇyamayaṃ jānīyādityarthaḥ | ata eva sato bandhumiti bandhuriti dhananāma brāhṛṇo vivartaṃ hiraṇmayam asati brāhṛṇi hmadi niravindanniti kai icavdyākhyātam | kṛṣṇapiṅgalaṃ kṛṣṇapiṅgale akṣiṇī yasya taṃ tathoktam |
analyzed: yat vai ṛtam satyam param brāhṛ brāhṛ ātmakam puruṣa ākāram om iti oṃkāreṇa vyākhyātam ṛtam iti dhana nāma ṛta mayam hiraṇya mayam hiraṇya mayam jānīyāt iti arthaḥ atas eva sataḥ bandhum iti bandhuḥ iti dhana nāma brāhṛṇaḥ vivartam hiraṇmayam asati brāhṛṇi niravindan iti kai niravindan iti kai kṛṣṇa piṅgalam kṛṣṇa piṅgale akṣiṇī yasya tam tathā uktam

original: ūdhrvaretamiti cchāndasam | ūdhrvaretaskaṃ yogārūḍhamāsīnaṃ virūpākṣaṃ lalāṭanetram, lalāṭanetreṇa raudratā prāpnoti tavdyāvṛttyarthaṃ śaṃkaraṃ sukhakaraṃ varadābhayahastaṃ śaṃkarasāhacaryānnīlalohitamiti nīlakaṇṭham urvaritapradeśe lohitam | nīlalohitau varṇau lalāṭanetrayorthathāyogyatayāsya dhṛtau tathoktam | kalpāntare tu vetavarṇam;
analyzed: ūdhrva retam iti chāndasam ūdhrva retaskam yoga ārūḍham āsīnam virūpa akṣam lalāṭa netram lalāṭa netreṇa raudra tā prāpnoti śaṃkaram sukha karam vara da abhaya hastam śaṃkara sāhacaryāt nīla lohitam iti nīlakaṇṭham urvarita pradeśe lohitam nīla lohitau varṇau lalāṭa netrayoḥ dhṛtau tathā uktam kalpa antare tu veta varṇam

analyzed: evam suvarṇa lohita śukla ākārāṇām vikalpaḥ kāmanā vaśā vdi avasthitaḥ umāpatim umā gaurī tasyāḥ patiḥ tam śriyam lakṣmīm iti sapta śaktayaḥ vakṣyante paśupatiḥ paśūnām prāṇinām patiḥ yat vā paśūnām vedānām gāyatrī ādīnām paśavaḥ vai chandāṃsi iti śruteḥ pinākinam pinākadhanuḥ hastam hi iti ni amita dyutim amita prakāśam
