original: yasmātsarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ nā vīryatamaḥ śreṣṭhatama ca siṃho vīryatamaḥ śreṣṭhatama ca tasmānnṛsiṃha āsītparame varo jagaddhitaṃ vā etadrūpaṃ yadakṣaraṃ bhavati | pra tadviṣṇuḥ stavate vīryāya mṛgo nabhīmaḥ kucaro giriṣṭhāḥ | yasyoruṣu triṣu vikramaṇeṣvadhi kṣiyanti bhuvanāni vi vā | tasmāducyate nṛsiṃhamiti |
analyzed: yasmāt sarveṣām bhūtānām nāḥ vīryatamaḥ śreṣṭhatama ca siṃhaḥ vīryatamaḥ śreṣṭhatama ca tasmāt nṛsiṃhaḥ āsīt parame varaḥ jagat hitam vai etat rūpam yat akṣaram bhavati pra tat viṣṇuḥ stavate vīryāya mṛgaḥ nabhīmaḥ kucaraḥ giriṣṭhāḥ yasya uruṣu triṣu vikramaṇeṣu adhi kṣiyanti bhuvanāni vi vā tasmāt ucyate nṛsiṃham iti

original: atha kasmāducyate bhīṣaṇamiti yasmātsvamahimnā yasya rūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve lokāḥ sarve devāḥ sarvāṇi bhūtāni bhītyā palāyante svayaṃ yataḥ kuta icanna bibheti | bhīṣāsmādvātaḥ pavate bhīṣodeti sūryaḥ | bhīṣāsmādagni cendra ca mṛtyurdhāvati pañcamaḥ | tasmāducyate bhīṣaṇamiti | atha kasmāducyate bhadramiti |
analyzed: atha kasmāt ucyate bhīṣaṇam iti yasmāt sva mahimnā yasya rūpam dṛṣṭvā sarve lokāḥ sarve devāḥ sarvāṇi bhūtāni bhītyā palāyante svayam yatas kutas ican na bibheti bhīṣā asmāt vātaḥ pavate bhīṣā udeti sūryaḥ bhīṣā asmāt agni ca indra ca mṛtyuḥ dhāvati pañcamaḥ tasmāt ucyate bhīṣaṇam iti atha kasmāt ucyate bhadram iti

original: yasmātsvayaṃ bhadro bhūtvā sarvadā bhadraṃ dadāti rocano rocamānaḥ śobhanaḥ śobhamānaḥ kalyāṇaḥ | bhadraṃ karṇebhiḥ śṛṇuyāma devā bhadraṃ paśyemākṣabhiryajatrāḥ | sthirairaṅgaistuṣṭuvāsaṃstanūbhivryaśema devahitaṃ yadāyuḥ | tasmāducyate bhadramiti | atha kasmāducyate mṛtyumṛtyumiti | yasmātsvabhaktānāṃ smṛta eva mṛtyumapamṛtyuṃ ca mārayati |
analyzed: yasmāt svayam bhadraḥ bhūtvā sarvadā bhadram dadāti rocanaḥ rocamānaḥ śobhanaḥ śobhamānaḥ kalyāṇaḥ bhadram karṇebhiḥ śṛṇuyāma devāḥ bhadram paśyema akṣabhiḥ yajatrāḥ sthiraiḥ aṅgaiḥ tuṣṭuva āsan tanūbhiḥ yaśema deva hitam yat āyuḥ tasmāt ucyate bhadram iti atha kasmāt ucyate mṛtyu mṛtyum iti yasmāt sva bhaktānām smṛtaḥ eva mṛtyum apamṛtyum ca mārayati

original: ya ātmadā baladā yasya vi va upāsate praśiṣaṃ yasya devāḥ | yasya cchāyāmṛtaṃ yo mṛtyumṛtyuḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema | tasmāducyate mṛtyumṛtyumiti | atha kasmāducyate namāmīti yasmādyaṃ sarve devā namanti mumukṣavo brāhṛvādina ca | pra nūnaṃ brāhṛṇaspatirmantraṃ vadatyukthyam | yasminnindro varuṇo mitro aryamā devā okāṃsi cakrire |
analyzed: yaḥ ātma dāḥ bala dāḥ yasya vi vaḥ upāsate praśiṣam yasya devāḥ yasya chāyā amṛtam yaḥ mṛtyu mṛtyuḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema tasmāt ucyate mṛtyu mṛtyum iti atha kasmāt ucyate namāmi iti yasmāt yam sarve devāḥ namanti mumukṣavaḥ ca pra nūnam brāhṛṇaspatiḥ mantram vadati ukthyam yasmin indraḥ varuṇaḥ mitraḥ aryamā devāḥ okāṃsi cakrire

original: tasmāducyate namāmīti | atha kasmāducyate'hamiti | ahamasmi prathamajā ṛtā 3sya pūrvaṃ devebhyo amṛtasya nā 3bhāyi | yo mā dadāti sa ideva mā 3vāḥ | ahamannamannamadantamā 3dmi | ahaṃ vi vaṃ bhuvanamabhyabhavā 3m | suvarna jyotīḥ | ya evaṃ vedetyupaniṣat || 4 ||
analyzed: tasmāt ucyate namāmi iti atha kasmāt ucyate iham iti aham asmi prathama jāḥ ṛtā asya pūrvam devebhyaḥ amṛtasya na abhāyi yaḥ mā dadāti saḥ id eva mā vāḥ aham annam annam adantam ā admi aham vi vam bhuvanam abhyabhavām suvar na jyotīḥ yaḥ evam veda iti upaniṣad

original: iti dvitīyopaniṣat ||
analyzed: iti dvitīyā upaniṣad

original: yadarthapratipādakagūḍhopādhinā padajñānamabhūt tameva gūḍhopādhiṃ vivṛṇoti praśnottarābhyām | sa ca atra bahutaro vyākhyeyaḥ sāṅgasāmābhivyaktasāṅgamūlamantraṃ pratipādya | sa ca mūlamantraḥ padatrayātmakaḥ prathamaḥ pādaḥ padadvayātmako dvitīyaḥ patatrayātmakastṛtīyaḥ tatsaṃkhyākapada eva caturtha ityekādaśapadātmakaḥ |
analyzed: yad artha pratipādaka gūḍha upādhinā pada jñānam abhūt tam eva gūḍha upādhim vivṛṇoti praśna uttarābhyām sa ca atra bahutaraḥ vyākhyeyaḥ sa aṅga sāma abhivyakta sa aṅga mūlamantram pratipādya sa ca mūlamantraḥ pada traya ātmakaḥ prathamaḥ pādaḥ pada dvaya ātmakaḥ dvitīyaḥ patatraya ātmakaḥ tṛtīyaḥ tad saṃkhyāka padaḥ eva caturthaḥ iti ekādaśa pada ātmakaḥ

original: evamekādaśapadātmake mantre pañcāṅganyāsānantaramukte mantre dvitīyānteṣu navasu padeṣu mantrāntyaṃ padadvayaṃ tṛtīyapādādyaṃ ca padamapi tritayamapi adhastaneṣūparitaneṣu ca tṛtīyapādādyapadādanyatrānuṣajyate, tṛtīyapādādyapade dvitayamanuṣajyate, evaṃ kriyākārakādyanvayasaṃbandhaśuddhiḥ |
analyzed: evam ekādaśa pada ātmake mantre pañcāṅganyāsa anantaram ukte mantre dvitīya anteṣu navasu padeṣu mantra antyam pada dvayam tṛtīya pāda ādyam ca padam api tritayam api adhastaneṣu uparitaneṣu ca tṛtīya pāda ādya padāt anyatra anuṣajyate tṛtīya pāda ādya pade dvitayam anuṣajyate evam kriyā kāraka ādi anvaya saṃbandha śuddhiḥ

original: tatra pañcāṅganyāsānantaraṃ paṭhitatvātpadoddhāratadarthakathanasya sarveṣveva pādeṣu sāṅgeṣvarthaḥ kathanīya ityādye pāde padatrayātmake sāṅge lokādyagnyādinā sāmopaniṣadyupāsye sāmāṅgapraṇavena ca mūlamantrahmadayāṅgavyākhyāne prāpte tatraikaikaṃ padaṃ bahutareṣvartheṣu vyākhyeyam |
analyzed: tatra pañcāṅga nyāsa anantaram paṭhita tvāt pada uddhāra tad artha kathanasya sarveṣu eva pādeṣu sa aṅgeṣu arthaḥ kathanīyaḥ iti ādye pāde pada traya ātmake sa aṅge loka ādi agni ādinā sāma upaniṣadi upāsye sāma aṅga praṇavena ca mūla mantra hma dayā aṅga vyākhyāne prāpte tatra ekaikam padam bahutareṣu artheṣu vyākhyeyam

original: tathoparitanaṛcaḥ ekādaśapadasaṃbandhinyaḥ praśnottarāntarālavartibrāāhṛṇavartinyaḥ
analyzed: tathā uparitana ṛcaḥ ekādaśa pada saṃbandhinyaḥ praśna uttara antarāla varti brāhmaṇa vartinyaḥ

original: ṭhatadeṣābhyuktā ' ityevaṃ brāāhṛṇoktārthe sākṣitvenodbhāvitā mahācakre nyaste dvātiṃraśadvyūhanṛsiṃhātmake brāhṛṇi ekaikamūlamantrapadavyākhyānaparatvena varṇanīyāḥ | tathā brāāhṛṇamekaikamūlamantrapadavyākhyānaparatvena mahācakranābhivartikṣīrodārṇavasaṃbandhimūlanṛsiṃhavyūhe brāhṛṇi prāguktaguṇaviśiṣṭe vyākhyeyam |
analyzed: iti evam brāāhṛṇa ukta arthe sākṣi tvena udbhāvitāḥ mahācakre nyaste dvātiṃraśat vyūha nṛsiṃha ātmake brāhṛṇi ekaika mūla mantra pada vyākhyāna para tvena varṇanīyāḥ tathā brāāhṛṇam ekaika mūla mantra pada vyākhyāna para tvena mahācakra nābhi varti kṣīroda arṇava saṃbandhi mūla nṛsiṃha vyūhe brāhṛṇi prāc ukta guṇa viśiṣṭe vyākhyeyam

original: ata eva tatra sākṣitvenodbhāvanam ṛgbrāāhṛṇayoḥ tattatpadavyākhyānāvasare vibhāgakramaṃ ca spaṣṭaṃ pradarśayiṣyāmaḥ |
analyzed: atas eva tatra sākṣi tvena udbhāvanam ṛk brāāhṛṇayoḥ tad tad pada vyākhyāna avasare vibhāga kramam ca spaṣṭam pradarśayiṣyāmaḥ

original: tatra tāvadekaikaṃ padaṃ dhātūpasargādiyogena bahutaramarthajātaṃ kathaṃ vadiṣyati prajāpatiḥ, kathaṃ ca vyākhyāsyatyasmānvyutpannānprati -- ityevaṃ devāḥ vismayena ha harṣitāḥ vai prajāpatimabrāuvanniti sarvapadasādhāraṇaṃ vyākhyānaṃ pṛṣṭvā atha anantaraṃ kasmātprakṛtipratyayavibhāgāt anākhyātātmakaṃ prathamapadamucyate vyākhyāyate ubhayatrāpi
analyzed: tatra tāvat ekaikam padam dhātu upasarga ādi yogena bahutaram artha jātam katham vadiṣyati prajāpatiḥ katham ca vyākhyāsyati asmān vyutpannān prati iti evam devāḥ vismayena ha harṣitāḥ vai prajāpatim abrāuvan iti sarva pada sādhāraṇam vyākhyānam pṛṣṭvā atha anantaram kasmāt prakṛti pratyaya vibhāgāt anākhyāta ātmakam prathama padam ucyate vyākhyāyate ubhayatra api

original: mūlanṛsiṃhavyūhe dvātiṃraśannṛsiṃhavyūhe ca ugramiti | itiśabdaḥ praśnasamāpta dyotayati | sa prajāpatiḥ tāndevānparameśvaropāsanāniṣṭhān vivakṣitārthapraṣṭṝn dṛṣṭvā harṣitaḥ uttaramuvāca | evamuttareṣvapi praśnottareṣu yojyam | yasmātsvamahimnā svatantraśaktyā māyayā tasyā ātmatantratvādeva svātantryam |
analyzed: mūla nṛsiṃha vyūhe ca ugram iti iti śabdaḥ praśna samāpta dyotayati sa prajāpatiḥ tān devān parameśvara upāsanā niṣṭhān vivakṣita artha praṣṭṝn dṛṣṭvā harṣitaḥ uttaram uvāca evam uttareṣu api praśna uttareṣu yojyam yasmāt sva mahimnā svatantra śaktyā māyayā tasyāḥ ātma tantra tvāt eva svātantryam

original: svamahimneti ca vacanaṃ sarvaśaktimattṛtīyapādādyapadānuṣaṅgaṃ darśayati | evaṃ tattatpadavyākhyānāvasare | sarvālm̐lākān pṛthivyādīnpārthivatvāvāntarajātibhedabhinnān sarvāndevān agnyādīn sapraṇavavyākhyānapakṣe ṛgbrāhṛādigārhapatyāntān praṇavaprathamamātrāpratipāditān sarvānātmanaḥ viśvādīn sāmāṅgapraṇavavyākhyāne vakṣyamāṇān sarvāṇi bhūtāni
analyzed: sva mahimnā iti ca vacanam sarva śaktimat tṛtīya pāda ādya pada anuṣaṅgam darśayati evam tad tad pada vyākhyāna avasare sarva alm̐lākān pṛthivī ādīn pārthiva tva avāntara jāti bheda bhinnān sarvān devān agni ādīn sa praṇava vyākhyāna pakṣe ṛk brāhṛa ādi gārhapatya antān praṇava prathama mātrā pratipāditān sarvān ātmanaḥ viśva ādīn sāmāṅga praṇava vyākhyāne vakṣyamāṇān sarvāṇi bhūtāni

original: udgṛhṇāti, udityavyayam u ityetasya nipātasya sthāne, varṇasāmyāt anvityupasargasyārthe, graha ityayaṃ gṛhṇātīti bhāvavyutpattyā, anugṛhṇātītyarthaḥ | ajaruām anavarataṃ tathā ca utpūrvako gṛhṇātiśabdaḥ sṛṣṭivimocanavasatiṣu vartate | udgrāhrate udgṛhrate ityātmanepadāt prayojakakartṛtvaṃ sākṣātkartṛtvaṃ ca ityuktamevārthaṃ draḍhayati |
analyzed: udgṛhṇāti ud iti avyayam u iti etasya nipātasya sthāne varṇa sāmyāt anu iti upasargasya arthe grahaḥ iti ayam gṛhṇāti iti bhāva vyutpattyā anugṛhṇāti iti arthaḥ anavaratam tathā ca ut pūrvakaḥ gṛhṇāti śabdaḥ sṛṣṭi vimocana vasatiṣu vartate udgṛhrate iti ātmanepadāt prayojaka kartṛ tvam sākṣāt kartṛ tvam ca iti uktam eva artham draḍhayati

original: tataścāyamarthaḥ -- pūrvoktārthānugrāhaka ruāṣṭṛtvaṃ ca vipūrvakasya sṛjaterupasaṃhārārthatvena tadarthatvaṃ vimocanārthatvaṃ vā avasthitikārayitṛtvamanugrahe prayojakatvamiti mūlanṛsiṃhavyūhahmadayāntarvartitvena
analyzed: tatas ca ayam arthaḥ pūrva ukta artha anugrāhaka ca vi pūrvakasya sṛjateḥ upasaṃhāra ārthatvena tad arthatvam vimocana arthatvam vā avasthiti kārayitṛ tvam anugrahe prayojaka tvam iti mūla nṛsiṃha vyūha hma dayā antarvarti tvena

original: upāsyam | evaṃ mūlanṛsiṃhagūḍhahmadayopāsāparatvena ugrapadaṃ vyākhyāya athedānīṃ tadeva padaṃ dvātiṃraśadvyūhopāsanāparatvena vyākhyātum ṛcamāha | stuhīti stotāraṃ pratyakṣīkṛtyāha parokṣīkṛtya stutyam | śrutam ṭha yau vai nṛsiṃhaḥ ' ityādimantravarṇaireva śrutaṃ dvātiṃraśannṛsiṃhavyūham |
analyzed: upāsyam evam mūlanṛsiṃha gūḍha hma dayā upāsā paratvena ugra padam vyākhyāya atha idānīm tat eva padam dvātiṃraśat vyūha upāsanā paratvena vyākhyātum ṛcam āha stuhi iti stotāram pratyakṣīkṛtya āha parokṣīkṛtya stutyam śrutam yau vai nṛsiṃhaḥ ityādi mantra varṇaiḥ eva śrutam dvātiṃraśat nṛsiṃha vyūham

original: gartasadaṃ garte mahācakre, gṛṇāteḥ stutikarmaṇo gīyate stūyate iti vyutpattyārgatam, sīdatīti gartasadam | yuvānaṃ prasiddham | mṛgaṃ siṃharūpam | nabhīmam abhayaṃkaram | upahatnum anugrahārthaṃ sarvatropagamaśīlam | ugraṃ dvātiṃraśannṛsiṃhavyūharūpam | atrāpi saśaktikanṛsiṃhapadasyānuṣaṅgaḥ | stuhītyevaṃ saṃbandhaḥ |
analyzed: garta sadam garte mahācakre gṛṇāteḥ stuti karmaṇaḥ gīyate stūyate iti vyutpattyā ārgatam sīdati iti garta sadam yuvānam prasiddham mṛgam siṃha rūpam nabhīmam abhayaṃkaram upahatnum anugraha artham sarvatra upagama śīlam ugram atra api sa śaktika nṛsiṃha padasya anuṣaṅgaḥ stuhi iti evam saṃbandhaḥ

original: evaṃ parokṣataḥ stute dvātiṃraśannṛsiṃhavyūhe tatsāmathryādakṣaraśravaṇayuktatvācca tacchaØtvā pratyakṣo hi abhūt sa vyūhaḥ upāsakāyeti pratyakṣīkṛtvā āha uttarārdhena -- he siṃha dvātiṃraśadvyūha stavānaḥ stūyamānaḥ tvaṃ mṛḍa sukhaya jaritre stotrakatrre | yadvā caturthī dvitīyārthe | te tava senāḥ asmat asmattaḥ anyaṃ nivapantu vināśayantu |
analyzed: evam parokṣatas stute dvātiṃraśat nṛsiṃha vyūhe tad sāmathryāt akṣara śravaṇa yukta tvāt ca tat śañtvā pratyakṣaḥ hi abhūt sa vyūhaḥ upāsakāya iti pratyakṣīkṛtvā āha uttara ardhena he siṃha dvātiṃraśat vyūha stavānaḥ stūyamānaḥ tvam mṛḍa sukhaya jaritre stotra katrre yat vā caturthī dvitīyā arthe te tava senāḥ asmat asmattaḥ anyam nivapantu vināśayantu

original: yadvā svānugrahaṃ labdhvā parānugrahaṃ prārthayate -- te tava senāḥ tadvyūharūpāḥ asmadanyaṃ nipūrvako vapatiranugrahārthe vartate anugṛhṇantvityarthaḥ | yasmādeva prāguktena prakāreṇobhayopāsye ugrapadaṃ kṣamam, tasmāducyate ugramiti | itiśabdaḥ uttarasamāpta dyotayati |
analyzed: yat vā sva anugraham labdhvā para anugraham prārthayate te tava senāḥ tad vyūha rūpāḥ asmat anyam ni pūrvakaḥ vapatiḥ anugraha arthe vartate anugṛhṇantu iti arthaḥ yasmāt eva prāguktena prakāreṇa ubhaya upāsye ugra padam kṣamam tasmāt ucyate ugram iti iti śabdaḥ uttara samāpta dyotayati

original: evaṃ prathamapadamubhayopāsane kṣamamiti vijñāya athedānīṃ dvitīyaṃ padamubhayopāsye vyākhyātuṃ dvitīyo devapraśnaḥ; sa ca
analyzed: evam prathama padam ubhaya upāsane kṣamam iti vijñāya atha idānīm dvitīyam padam ubhaya upāsye vyākhyātum dvitīyaḥ devapraśnaḥ sa ca

original: prathamadevapraśnena vyākhyātaḥ; atha kasmāducyate vīramiti | sa hovāca prajāpatiriti prāguktamanuṣajya uttaram | yasmātsvamahimnetyādi sarvāṇi bhūtānītyantamuktārtham | viramati virāmayati vividhaprakāreṇa prāguktānprati ramati | ram krīḍāyām | tathaiva tānākrīḍayati | kathaṃ krīḍayatītyapekṣite āha -- ajaruāmityādi vāsayatītyantamuktārtham |
analyzed: prathama deva praśnena vyākhyātaḥ atha kasmāt ucyate vīram iti sa ha uvāca prajāpatiḥ iti prāc uktam anuṣajya uttaram yasmāt sva mahimnā ityādi sarvāṇi bhūtāni iti antam ukta artham viramati virāmayati vividha prakāreṇa prāc uktān prati ramati ram krīḍāyām tathā eva tān ākrīḍayati katham krīḍayati iti apekṣite āha vāsayati ityantam ukta artham

original: etaduktaṃ bhavati -- sṛṣṭisthitilayavimocanakartṛtvarūpāḥ brāhṛādikriyāḥ krīḍāḥ prāguktārthāḥ | ataḥ mūlanṛsiṃhavyūhahmadayaṃ krīḍāyuktamupāsyam | evaṃ mūlanṛsiṃhopāsanāparatvena dvitīyaṃ padaṃ vyākhyāya dvātiṃraśannṛsiṃhavyūhopāsanāyāṃ tadeva padaṃ vyākhyātumardharcamāha -- yato vīra iti |
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati sṛṣṭi sthiti laya vimocana kartṛ tva rūpāḥ brāhṛ ādi kriyāḥ krīḍāḥ prāk ukta arthāḥ atas mūla nṛsiṃha vyūha hma dayam krīḍā yuktam upāsyam evam mūla nṛsiṃha upāsanā paratvena dvitīyam padam vyākhyāya tat eva padam vyākhyātum ardharcam āha yatas vīraḥ iti

original: devakāmaḥ tāṃstān brāhṛādidevān svena rūpeṇāvatārayituṃ kāmayate iti devakāmaḥ | yadvā nṛsiṃhavyūhameva dhṛtvā brāhṛādirūpaṃ prakaṭayati kvacidāyudhaiḥ kvacidviścarūpopapattinyāyena ṭha yo vai nṛsiṃho devo bhagavānyaśca brāhṛā ' ityādiṣu ṭha yo vai nṛsiṃho devo bhagavānye cāṣṭau vasavaḥ ' ityādiṣu ca padeṣu |
analyzed: deva kāmaḥ tān tān brāhṛ ādi devān svena rūpeṇa avatārayitum kāmayate iti deva kāmaḥ yat vā nṛsiṃha vyūham eva dhṛtvā brāhṛ ādi rūpam prakaṭayati kvacid āyudhaiḥ kvacid viśca rūpa upapatti nyāyena yaḥ vai nṛsiṃhaḥ devaḥ bhagavān yaḥ ca brāhṛāḥ ityādiṣu yaḥ vai nṛsiṃhaḥ devaḥ bhagavān ye ca aṣṭau vasavaḥ ityādiṣu ca padeṣu

original: evaṃ devakāmo jāyate yato vīraḥ śūraḥ, yadvā vīraḥ vividhāvatārarūpeṇa ramaṇīyasaṃsāraśīlo vīraḥ, karmaṇyaḥ tattadavataraṇarūpakarmaśīlaḥ upāsakānugrahaṇe | sudakṣaḥ pūjitabalaḥ, yadvā pūjitaḥ | yuktagrāvā yukto grāvabhiryuktagrāvā, some adhvayrvādirūpaḥ, ṭha yo vai nṛsiṃho devo bhagavānyaśca sarvam ' ityādimantravarṇāt |
analyzed: evam deva kāmaḥ jāyate yatas vīraḥ śūraḥ yat vā vīraḥ vividha avatāra rūpeṇa ramaṇīya saṃsāra śīlaḥ vīraḥ karmaṇyaḥ tad tad avataraṇa rūpa karma śīlaḥ upāsaka anugrahaṇe su dakṣaḥ pūjita balaḥ yat vā pūjitaḥ yukta grāvā yuktaḥ grāvabhiḥ yukta grāvā some yaḥ vai nṛsiṃhaḥ devaḥ bhagavān yaḥ ca sarvam iti ādi mantra varṇāt

original: yasmāduktaprakāreṇa ubhayopāsye vīrapadaṃ kṣamam, tasmāducyate
analyzed: yasmāt ukta prakāreṇa ubhaya upāsye vīra padam kṣamam tasmāt ucyate

original: vīramiti | itiśabdaḥ uttarasamāpta dyotayati | athedānīṃ tṛtīyapadaṃ vyākhyātuṃ devapraśnaḥ; sa ca uktārthaḥ | sarvatra praśnavākyeṣu athaśabdaḥ tattadānantaryārthaḥ | atha kasmāducyate mahāviṣṇum | itiśabdaḥ anuṣaktapraśnasamāpta dyotayati | sa hovāca prajāpatiḥ ityanuṣajyottaram |
analyzed: vīram iti iti śabdaḥ uttara samāpta dyotayati atha idānīm tṛtīya padam vyākhyātum devapraśnaḥ sa ca ukta arthaḥ sarvatra praśna vākyeṣu atha śabdaḥ tad tad ānantarya arthaḥ atha kasmāt ucyate mahā viṣṇum iti śabdaḥ anuṣakta praśna samāpta dyotayati sa ha uvāca prajāpatiḥ iti anuṣajya uttaram

original: sa ityatrāpi svamahimnetyanuṣaṅgācchaktimannṛsiṃhapadasyānuṣaṅgaḥ | sarvālm̐lokānvyāpnoti vyāpayatītyatra sarvalokapadāddevātmabhūtānāṃ saṃgrahaḥ prāgbaddhakramatvenāvagatānāṃ tadādinyāyena | viṣṇuriti viṣlṛ vyāptāviti dhātoḥ rūpam | tacca vyāpakatvaṃ nirupapadatvena mahattvaṃ prāptamiti mahacchabdena tadeva dṛḍhīkṛtam |
analyzed: saḥ iti atra api sva mahimnā iti anuṣaṅgāt śaktimat nṛsiṃha padasya anuṣaṅgaḥ sarvān lm̐lokān vyāpnoti vyāpayati iti atra sarva loka padāt deva ātma bhūtānām saṃgrahaḥ prāk baddha krama tvena avagatānām tad ādi nyāyena viṣṇuḥ iti vyāptau iti dhātoḥ rūpam tat ca vyāpaka tvam nirupapada tvena mahat tvam prāptam iti mahat śabdena tat eva dṛḍhīkṛtam

original: yadvā maha iti tejonāma maho vyāpakam | vyāpakatve dṛṣṭāntamāha -- snehaḥ tailādiḥ yathā palalapiṇḍaṃ māṃsapiṇḍam otam anusyūtaṃ protaṃ prakarṣeṇānusyūtam anuṣaktaṃ tādṛśaṃ piṇḍaṃ vyatiṣaktaḥ avayavasaṃbhinnaḥ vyāpyate vyāpayate -- iti dṛṣṭānte ātmanepadopādānāt vyāpnoti vyāpayatīti dāṣrṭāntike ca parasmaipadopādānāt ubhayapadī ayaṃ dhāturiti
analyzed: yat vā mahaḥ iti tejaḥ nāma mahaḥ vyāpakam vyāpaka tve dṛṣṭāntam āha snehaḥ taila ādiḥ yathā palala piṇḍam māṃsa piṇḍam otam anusyūtam protam prakarṣeṇa anusyūtam anuṣaktam tādṛśam piṇḍam vyatiṣaktaḥ avayava saṃbhinnaḥ vyāpyate vyāpayate iti dṛṣṭānte ātmanepada upādānāt vyāpnoti vyāpayati iti dāṣrṭāntike ca parasmaipada upādānāt ubhayapadī ayam dhātuḥ iti

original: darśayati | etaduktaṃ bhavati -- prāguktasarvalokādīn prati sākṣādvyāpakatvaṃ prayojakavyāpakatvaṃ ca mūlanṛsiṃhahmadaye upāsyamiti |
analyzed: darśayati etat uktam bhavati prāc ukta sarva loka ādīn prati sākṣāt vyāpaka tvam prayojaka vyāpaka tvam ca mūla nṛsiṃha hma daye upāsyam iti

original: evaṃ tāvatsāṅgamūlanṛsiṃhavyūhopāsanāparatvena mahāviṣṇupadaṃ tṛtīyaṃ vyākhyāya athedānīṃ tadeva padaṃ dvātiṃraśannṛsiṃhavyūhopāsyaparatvena vyākhyātum ṛcamāha -- yasmāt dvātiṃraśannṛsiṃhavyūhāt paraḥ utkṛṣṭaḥ na jātaḥ jāto'nyo nāsti sarvasyaivāntarbhāvāt yo vyūhaḥ sa viśvā sarvāṇi bhuvanāni bhūtāni āviveśa praviṣṭaḥ |
analyzed: evam tāvat sa aṅga mūla nṛsiṃha vyūha upāsanā para tvena mahāviṣṇu padam tṛtīyam vyākhyāya atha idānīm tat eva padam dvātiṃraśat nṛsiṃha vyūha upāsya para tvena vyākhyātum ṛcam āha yasmāt dvātiṃraśat nṛsiṃha vyūhāt paraḥ utkṛṣṭaḥ na jātaḥ jātaḥ anyaḥ na asti sarvasya eva antarbhāvāt yaḥ vyūhaḥ sa viśvā sarvāṇi bhuvanāni bhūtāni āviveśa praviṣṭaḥ

original: vyāptuṃ tattadrūpadhāraṇena viśvarūpāvataraṇena āvirbhavati prajayā āvirbhūtyā saha prajāpatirapi saṃvidānaḥ vijānan tamupāsyatayā trīṇi jyotīṃṣi gārhapatyādīn sacate sevate | sa prajāpatiḥ upāsanāṃ kurvan ṣoḍaśī kalā nirākārabrāhṛtayā babhūva |
analyzed: vyāptum tad tad rūpa dhāraṇena viśva rūpa avataraṇena āvirbhavati prajayā āvirbhūtyā saha prajāpatiḥ api saṃvidānaḥ vijānan tam upāsya tayā trīṇi jyotīṃṣi gārhapatya ādīn sacate sevate sa prajāpatiḥ upāsanām kurvan ṣoḍaśī kalā nirākāra brāhṛ tayā babhūva

original: tasya ca ādyasyopāsakasya prajāpateḥ anyasya vā upāsakasya ayamupāsanākramaḥ -- atra ca prakaraṇe mahācakranābhivartikṣīrodārṇavasaṃbandhyupāsyo mūlanṛsiṃhavyūha iti pūrvācāryāṇāṃ paribhāṣā saṃpradāyāgatā |
analyzed: tasya ca ādyasya upāsakasya prajāpateḥ anyasya vā upāsakasya ayam upāsanā kramaḥ atra ca prakaraṇe mahā cakra nābhi varti kṣīroda arṇava saṃbandhi upāsyaḥ mūla nṛsiṃha vyūhaḥ iti pūrva ācāryāṇām paribhāṣā saṃpradāya āgatā

original: tatra ca praṇavapūrvakaśaktibījoccāraṇapūrvakaṃ sāmābhivyaktadvātiṃraśadakṣareṣu nyasteṣu cakre yathāsaṃkhyam ekaikasminnakṣare praṇavasaṃpuṭite tattadvyūhamantraiḥ taṃ taṃ vyūhaṃ stutvā tathaivopāsyaḥ |
analyzed: tatra ca praṇava pūrvaka śakti bīja uccāraṇa pūrvakam sāma abhivyakta dvātiṃraśat akṣareṣu nyasteṣu cakre yathāsaṃkhyam ekaikasmin akṣare praṇava saṃpuṭite tad tad vyūha mantraiḥ tam tam vyūham stutvā tathā eva upāsyaḥ

original: evaṃ dvātiṃraśannṛsiṃhavyūhopāsanayā svātmānaṃ mahāviṣṇumupāsya sāṅgasāmābhivyaktasāṅgamūlamantreṇa nṛsiṃhavyūhe prakaraṇe śrutatvāt pañcāṅganyāsaṃ vidhāya saṃpradāyānusāreṇa tasminmahāviṣṇau ca tathaiva pañcāṅganyāsaṃ vidhāya tataḥ sāṅgopāsanam ārabheta |
analyzed: evam sva ātmānam mahāviṣṇum upāsya sa aṅga sāma abhivyakta sa aṅga mūlamantreṇa nṛsiṃha vyūhe prakaraṇe śruta tvāt pañcāṅga nyāsam vidhāya saṃpradāya anusāreṇa tasmin mahāviṣṇau ca tathā eva pañcāṅga nyāsam vidhāya tatas sa aṅga upāsanam ārabheta

original: tatra prathamapāde padatrayātmake prathamapadavyākhyānapratipāditaguṇaviśiṣṭaṃ śaktimannṛsiṃhapadapūrvakaṃ namaskriyāpadapūrvakāntyapadamuccaran sāmāṅgapraṇavamantrahmadayamantrapratipāditaguṇaviśiṣṭaṃ mūlanṛsiṃhavyūhamupāsya dvātiṃraśannṛsiṃhavyūham ṛkpratipāditam upāsīta |
analyzed: tatra prathama pāde pada traya ātmake prathama pada vyākhyāna pratipādita guṇa viśiṣṭam śaktimat nṛsiṃha pada pūrvakam namaskriyā pada pūrvaka antya padam uccaran sāma aṅga praṇava mantra hmadaya mantra pratipādita guṇa viśiṣṭam mūla nṛsiṃha vyūham upāsya dvātiṃraśat nṛsiṃha vyūham ṛc pratipāditam upāsīta

original: evaṃ pratipadaṃ mūlanṛsiṃhavyūhopāsanapūrvakaṃ dvātiṃraśannṛsiṃhavyūhopāsanam | ata eva hmadayādyaṅgamantrāṇāmarthaṃ vyācakṣāṇairasmābhiruktaṃ prapañcāgamaśāstre ṭha hmadayaṃ buddhigamyatvātpraṇāmaḥ syānnamaḥpadam | kriyate hmadaye nāto buddhigamyā namaskriyā ' iti |
analyzed: evam pratipadam mūla nṛsiṃha vyūha upāsana pūrvakam atas eva hmadaya ādi aṅgamantrāṇām artham vyācakṣāṇaiḥ asmābhiḥ uktam prapañca āgama śāstre hmadayam buddhi gamya tvāt praṇāmaḥ syāt namaḥ padam kriyate hmadaye na atas buddhi gamyā namaskriyā iti

original: evaṃ dvitīyatṛtīyacaturthapādeṣu tattatpadopāsanāṃ prāguktāṃ kṛtsnāṃ vidhāya mahāviṣṇurūpāntyaśabdapratipāditarūpe vā upāsyarūpe vā sāyujyatayā saccidānandarūpe vā athavā yathāntaḥkaraṇaśuddhiyogyatayā samādhinā vā tiṣṭheta upāsakaḥ | ādyadvitīyopāsanayoḥ sāmamūlamantrapraṇavānāṃ vaikalpikajapapūrvakatvenāvasthānam |
analyzed: evam dvitīya tṛtīya caturtha pādeṣu tad tad pada upāsanām prāguktām kṛtsnām vidhāya mahāviṣṇu rūpa antya śabda pratipādita rūpe vā upāsya rūpe vā sāyujya tayā saccidānanda rūpe vā athavā yathā antaḥkaraṇa śuddhi yogya tayā samādhinā vā tiṣṭheta upāsakaḥ ādya dvitīya upāsanayoḥ sāma mūla mantra praṇavānām vaikalpika japa pūrvaka tvena avasthānam

original: tathā yatra yatra mūlamantrasmṛtiḥ tatra tatra praṇavaśaktibījasaṃpuṭīkaraṇam, tatrāpi īṣanmūlamantrajapapūrvakaḥ praṇavajapaḥ śreyān, tasya sarvotkṛṣṭatvātsarvamantrajapapratyāmnāyatvena vihitatvāt ṭha yaḥ praṇavamadhīte sa sarvamadhīte ' iti śruteḥ |
analyzed: tathā yatra yatra mūlamantra smṛtiḥ tatra tatra praṇava śakti bīja saṃpuṭīkaraṇam tatra api īṣat mūlamantra japa pūrvakaḥ praṇava japaḥ śreyān tasya sarva utkṛṣṭa tvāt sarva mantra japa pratyāmnāya tvena vihita tvāt yaḥ praṇavam adhīte sa sarvam adhīte iti śruteḥ

original: antyayorupāsanayorantyasāmani nirākāratayāvasthitau na japo nānyacintanaṃ samādhāvevāvasthitiriti paramarahasyaviveko na kasyacitpratipādanīya iti sthitam | yasmādidaṃ mahāviṣṇupadam ubhayopāsyapratipādanakṣamam, tasmāducyate mahāviṣṇumiti | itiśabdaḥ tṛtīyapadapraśnottarasamāpta dyotayati | evaṃ prathamapādaḥ vyākhyātaḥ |
analyzed: antyayoḥ upāsanayoḥ antyasāmani nirākāra tayā avasthitau na japaḥ na anya cintanam samādhau eva avasthitiḥ iti parama rahasya vivekaḥ na kasyacid pratipādanīyaḥ iti sthitam yasmāt idam mahāviṣṇu padam ubhaya upāsya pratipādana kṣamam tasmāt ucyate mahāviṣṇum iti iti śabdaḥ dyotayati evam prathama pādaḥ vyākhyātaḥ

original: evaṃ prathamapādopāsanāṃ sāṅgāṃ vidhāya tathaiva dvitīyapādopāsanāṃ vidhātuṃ tadādyaṃ padam, mantrāpekṣayā caturthaṃ ca padam, vyākhyātuṃ praśnopakramaḥ; sa ca uktārthaḥ; atha kasmāducyate jvalantamiti | itiśabdo vyākhyātaḥ | sa hovāca prajāpatirityanuṣajyottaram |
analyzed: evam prathama pāda upāsanām sa aṅgām vidhāya tathā eva dvitīya pāda upāsanām vidhātum tad ādyam padam mantra apekṣayā caturtham ca padam vyākhyātum praśna upakramaḥ sa ca ukta arthaḥ atha kasmāt ucyate jvalantam iti iti śabdaḥ vyākhyātaḥ sa ha uvāca prajāpatiḥ iti anuṣajya uttaram

original: yaḥ svamahimnā svādhīnamāyayā sarvālm̐lokānantarikṣagatānpūrvoktānbhāvinaśca sarvān lokān tadantargatānsarvāndevān yakṣagandharvādīn sarvānātmanaḥ ṛgyajuḥsāmātharvarūpānpuruṣānanyānṛṣīnsāmāṅgasāvitramantravyākhyātāṃ ca sarvāṇi bhūtāni etānpūrvoktānvakṣyamāṇāṃśca svatejasā jvalati svakīyaprakāśena, jvālayati etānapi prakāśayati, śiro'ntargataṃ tejo
analyzed: yaḥ sva mahimnā svādhīna māyayā sarvān mālokān antarikṣa gatān pūrva uktān bhāvinaḥ ca sarvān lokān tad antargatān sarvān devān yakṣa gandharva ādīn sarvān ātmanaḥ ṛk yajuḥ sāma atharva rūpān puruṣān anyān ṛṣīn sāma aṅga sāvitra mantra vyākhyātām ca sarvāṇi bhūtāni etān pūrva uktān vakṣyamāṇān ca sva tejasā jvalati svakīya prakāśena jvālayati etān api prakāśayati śiraḥ ntargatam tejaḥ ca sva antargatam tejaḥ ca sva antargatam

original: vyākhyātam, sarvāṅgāṅgivyāpitayāṅgānāmanyonyasaṃbandhaśravaṇāt ṭha tasmādvyatiṣaktānyaṅgāni bhavanti ' iti śruteḥ | evaṃ sākṣātprayojakatvena ca svaparasaṃbandhitayā śiro'ṅgāntargatatejaḥsaṃbandhe siddhe'pi etadeva āvedayitum ubhayapaditvena dhātuṃ prayuṅkte, prākparasmaipadam idānīmātmanepadam, jvālyate jvālayate iti |
analyzed: vyākhyātam sarva aṅga aṅgi vyāpi tayā aṅgānām anyonya saṃbandha śravaṇāt tasmāt vyatiṣaktāni aṅgāni bhavanti iti śruteḥ evam sākṣāt prayojaka tvena ca sva para saṃbandhi tayā śiraḥ oṅga antargata tejaḥ saṃbandhe siddhe api etat eva āvedayitum ubhayapadi tvena dhātum prayuṅkte prāk parasmaipadam idānīm ātmanepadam jvālyate jvālayate iti

original: evaṃ mūlanṛsiṃhavyūhopāsye caturthaṃ padaṃ vyākhyāya dvātiṃraśannṛsiṃhavyūhe vyākhyātum ṛcamāha -- savitā savitṛmaṇḍalavadvartulatayā sthitatvāt savitāyaṃ dvātiṃraśannṛsiṃhavyūhaḥ; ata eva prasavitā sarvakarmānuṣṭhāne abhyanujñātā, etadvyūhopāsanapūrvakatvāt itaropāsanasya |
analyzed: evam mūla nṛsiṃha vyūha upāsye caturtham padam vyākhyāya dvātiṃraśat nṛsiṃha vyūhe vyākhyātum ṛcam āha savitā savitṛ maṇḍala vat vartula tayā sthita tvāt savitā ayam dvātiṃraśat nṛsiṃha vyūhaḥ atas eva prasavitā sarva karma anuṣṭhāne abhyanujñātā etad vyūha upāsana pūrvaka tvāt itara upāsanasya

original: dīptaḥ dīpayandīpyamānaḥ yathā ayaṃ savitā rātritamovināśanena dīptaḥ prakāśamānaḥ karmānuṣṭhāne abhyanujñātā, tathā ayaṃ dvātiṃraśannṛsiṃhavyūhaḥ upāsitaḥ upāsakāya mūlanṛsiṃhavyūhopāsakājñānarātritamovināśanena dīptaḥ prakāśamānaḥ pradhānopāsanābhyanujñātā | dīpayandīpyamānaḥ iti śatṛśānacpratyayau vartamānakālārthau uktamevārthaṃ draḍhayataḥ |
analyzed: dīptaḥ dīpayan dīpyamānaḥ yathā ayam savitā rātri tamaḥ vināśanena dīptaḥ prakāśamānaḥ karma anuṣṭhāne abhyanujñātā tathā ayam dvātiṃraśat nṛsiṃha vyūhaḥ upāsitaḥ upāsakāya mūlanṛsiṃha vyūha upāsaka ajñāna rātri tamaḥ vināśanena dīptaḥ prakāśamānaḥ pradhāna upāsana abhyanujñātā dīpayan dīpyamānaḥ iti śatṛ śānac pratyayau vartamāna kāla arthau uktam eva artham draḍhayataḥ

original: jvalañjvalitā prakāśaṃ kurvanprakāśayitā | yadvā ubhayatrāpi jvalañśabdo dahanārthe vartamāno'pi ajñānadāhakatvena vyākhyeyaḥ | tatra lokādyajñānasya prakāśavattādāhakaḥ prakṛte ca upāsakājñānadāhaka iti |
analyzed: jvalan jvalitā prakāśam kurvan prakāśayitā yat vā ubhayatra api jvalan śabdaḥ dahana arthe vartamānaḥ api ajñāna dāhaka tvena vyākhyeyaḥ tatra loka ādi ajñānasya prakāśavat tā dāhakaḥ prakṛte ca upāsaka ajñāna dāhakaḥ iti

original: jvalan prakāśanenājñānadahanaṃ kurvan jvalitā ajñānadahanakartā tapan tāpaṃ kurvan ajñānasya vitapan svayaṃ śāntaḥ saṃtapan saṃtāpaṃ kurvan ajñānasya | ete śatṛpratyayā vartamānakālāḥ santaḥ yasminkāle etadvyūhopāsanaṃ vartate tasminneva mahāviṣṇurupāsakaḥ prakāśātmako'dhikārī vartata iti darśayanti | rocanaḥ anudvegakaraḥ rocamānaḥ icchākaraḥ;
analyzed: jvalan prakāśanena ajñāna dahanam kurvan jvalitā ajñāna dahana kartā tapan tāpam kurvan ajñānasya vitapan svayam śāntaḥ saṃtapan saṃtāpam kurvan ajñānasya ete śatṛ pratyayāḥ vartamāna kālāḥ santaḥ yasmin kāle etat vyūha upāsanam vartate tasmin eva mahāviṣṇuḥ upāsakaḥ prakāśa ātmakaḥ ūdhikārī vartate iti darśayanti rocanaḥ anudvega karaḥ rocamānaḥ icchā karaḥ

original: ata eva śobhanaḥ śobhamānaḥ kalyāṇaḥ iti etaduktaṃ bhavati -- mūlanṛsiṃhavyūhasya śiro'ṅge unnate sthitaṃ tejaḥ sarvaprakāśakaṃ sarvājñānadāhakaṃ ca iti sāmāṅgasāvitramantreṇa vyākhyātamupāsyamiti | yasmādubhayopāsyapratipādanakṣamaṃ jvalantamiti padaṃ tasmādubhayopāsyaparatvenopasaṃharati -- tasmāducyate jvalantamiti | itiśabdo vyākhyātaḥ |
analyzed: atas eva śobhanaḥ śobhamānaḥ kalyāṇaḥ iti etat uktam bhavati mūla nṛsiṃha vyūhasya śiraḥ uṅge unnate sthitam tejaḥ sarva prakāśakam sarva ajñāna dāhakam ca iti sāmāṅga sāvitra mantreṇa vyākhyātam upāsyam iti yasmāt ubhaya upāsya pratipādana kṣamam jvalantam iti padam tasmāt ubhaya upāsya paratvena upasaṃharati tasmāt ucyate jvalantam iti iti śabdaḥ vyākhyātaḥ

original: athedānīṃ kramaprāptam, mūlamantrāpekṣayā pañcamaṃ padam, pādāpekṣayā dvitīyam, ubhayopāsye vyākhyātuṃ devapraśnaḥ -- atha kasmāducyate sarvatomukhamiti; sa ca uktārthaḥ | sa hovāca prajāpatirityanuṣajyottaram | yasmāt svamahimneti anuṣajya vyākhyeyam | anindriyo'pīti sendriyasya vyākhyātavigrahasya tadabhimānarāhityāt anindriyatvam;
analyzed: atha idānīm krama prāptam mūlamantra apekṣayā pañcamam padam pāda apekṣayā dvitīyam ubhaya upāsye vyākhyātum deva praśnaḥ atha kasmāt ucyate sarvatomukham iti sa ca ukta arthaḥ sa ha uvāca prajāpatiḥ iti anuṣajya uttaram yasmāt sva mahimnā iti anuṣajya vyākhyeyam anindriya upi iti sa indriyasya vyākhyāta vigrahasya tad abhimāna rāhityāt anindriya tvam

original: anindriyo'pyayaṃ mūlanṛsiṃhavyūhaḥ sarvataḥ paśyati sarvataḥ śrṛṇotīti buddhīndriyopalakṣaṇam, sarvato gacchati sarvata ādatte sarvagaḥ sarvatastiṣṭhatīti karmendriyopalakṣaṇam, evamubhayendriyābhimānarahito'pyayaṃ vyūhaḥ ubhayendriyajanyakāryakaraṇaśaktimāñśiro'ṅge upāsya iti darśayati |
analyzed: anindriyaḥ api ayam mūla nṛsiṃha vyūhaḥ sarvatas paśyati sarvatas śrṛṇoti iti buddhīndriya upalakṣaṇam sarvatas gacchati sarvatas ādatte sarvagaḥ sarvatas tiṣṭhati iti karmendriya upalakṣaṇam evam ubhaya indriya abhimāna rahitaḥ api ayam vyūhaḥ ubhaya indriya janya kārya karaṇa śaktimān śiraḥ oṅge upāsyaḥ iti darśayati

original: evamidaṃ sarvatomukhapadaṃ mūlanṛsiṃhopāsyaparatvena vyākhyāya athedānīṃ dvātiṃraśannṛsiṃhopāyasparatvena ṛcā vyācaṣṭe -- ekaḥ purastāt prāk brāhṛā nṛsiṃhākāro babhūva, idaṃ sarvaṃ yato babhūva, bhuvanasya gopā goptā nṛsiṃha eva viṣṇurbabhūva |
analyzed: evam idam sarvatomukha padam mūlanṛsiṃha upāsya paratvena vyākhyāya atha idānīm ṛcā vyācaṣṭe ekaḥ purastāt prāk ṛcā vyācaṣṭe ekaḥ purastāt prāk nṛsiṃha ākāraḥ babhūva idam sarvam yatas babhūva bhuvanasya gopāḥ goptā nṛsiṃhaḥ eva viṣṇuḥ babhūva

original: yam apyeti layaṃ gacchati sāṃparāye pralayakāle bhuvanaṃ sarvaṃ sa nṛsiṃha eva maheśvaro babhūveti baddhakramakāṇāṃ vyūhānāṃ trayāṇāṃ prathamata evopādānena tadādinyāyena itareṣāmekonatiṃraśadvyūhānāṃ grahaṇamasminmantre | namāmi namaskaromi taṃ vyūham ahaṃ namāmītyetatpadadvayamatra vadan sarvapadavyākhyāne anuṣaktamiti darśayati |
analyzed: yam apyeti layam gacchati sāṃparāye pralaya kāle bhuvanam sarvam sa nṛsiṃhaḥ eva maheśvaraḥ babhūva iti baddha kramakāṇām vyūhānām trayāṇām prathamatas eva upādānena tad ādi nyāyena itareṣām ekonatiṃraśat vyūhānām grahaṇam asmin mantre namāmi namaskaromi tam vyūham aham namāmi iti etat pada dvayam atra vadan sarva pada vyākhyāne anuṣaktam iti darśayati

original: sarvatra svamahimnetyupādānāt tatra tatra śaktimannṛsiṃhapadamapyetadanuṣaktam | sarvatomukhamiti sarvato nṛsiṃhākārāṇi mukhāni yasya sa tathoktaḥ taṃ nṛsiṃhaṃ sarvatomukhaṃ namāmyahamityarthaḥ | yasmādidaṃ padamubhayopāsyapratipādane śaktaṃ tadubhayapratipādakatvena tasmādityupasaṃharati -- tasmāducyate sarvatomukhamiti |
analyzed: sarvatra sva mahimnā iti upādānāt tatra tatra śaktimat nṛsiṃha padam api etat anuṣaktam sarvatomukham iti sarvatas nṛsiṃha ākārāṇi mukhāni yasya sa tathā uktaḥ tam nṛsiṃham sarvatomukham namāmi aham iti arthaḥ yasmāt idam padam ubhaya upāsya pratipādane śaktam tad ubhaya pratipādaka tvena tasmāt iti upasaṃharati tasmāt ucyate sarvatomukham iti

original: etaduktaṃ bhavati -- dvitīyapāde śiro'ṅgaviśiṣṭaḥ pratipāditasarvaprakāśakatvasarvājñānadāhakatvobhayendriyābhimānarahitatvobhayendriyakāryakaraṇaśaktimatvaguṇaviśiṣṭaḥ sāmāṅgasavitṛmantravyākhyātaguṇaviśiṣṭaḥ mūlanṛsiṃhavyūhaḥ upāsyaḥ, tata itaro vyūha iti | evamādyādaṅgādunnatapradeśasthitatvācchirasaḥ śirastvam unnatatvam |
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati dvitīya pāde śiraḥ oṅga viśiṣṭaḥ pratipādita sarva prakāśaka tva sarva ajñāna dāhaka tva ubhaya indriya abhimāna rahita tva ubhaya indriya kārya karaṇa śaktimatva guṇa viśiṣṭaḥ sāma aṅga savitṛ mantra vyākhyāta guṇa viśiṣṭaḥ mūla nṛsiṃha vyūhaḥ upāsyaḥ tatas itaraḥ vyūhaḥ iti evamādyāt aṅgāt unnata pradeśa sthita tvāt śirasaḥ śiraḥ tvam unnata tvam

original: ata eva śira ādityaḥ sarvotkṛṣṭaḥ prakāśaḥ
analyzed: atas eva śiraḥ ādityaḥ sarva utkṛṣṭaḥ prakāśaḥ

original: tasmai unnatāya unnatasthāyādityāya sarvotkṛṣṭāya prakāśāya svāheti prapañcavilāpanam; tasmātprapañcākārāt tadākārāṃ budiṃdha pratyāhmatya nṛsiṃhākārameva upāsīta ityevaṃ śiro'ṅgamantrasyārthaḥ, ṭha yo vai nṛsiṃho devo bhagavānyaśca sarvam ' iti śruteḥ |
analyzed: tasmai unnatāya unnata sthāya ādityāya sarva utkṛṣṭāya prakāśāya svāhā iti prapañca vilāpanam tasmāt prapañca ākārāt tad ākārām nṛsiṃha ākāram eva upāsīta iti evam śiraḥ aṅga mantrasya arthaḥ yaḥ vai nṛsiṃhaḥ devaḥ bhagavān yaḥ ca sarvam iti śruteḥ

original: ata evoktaṃ śiro'ṅgamantrārthaṃ vyācakṣāṇaiḥ asmābhiḥ prapañcāgamaśāstre -- ṭha tuṅgārthatvācchiro'ṅgasya viṣayāharaṇe tviṣaḥ | śiromantreṇa cottuṅgaviṣayāhmatirīritā ' iti |
analyzed: atas eva uktam śiraḥ aṅga mantra artham vyācakṣāṇaiḥ asmābhiḥ prapañca āgama śāstre tuṅga artha tvāt śiraḥ oṅgasya viṣaya āharaṇe tviṣaḥ śiromantreṇa ca uttuṅga viṣayā āhmatiḥ īritā iti

original: evaṃ dvitīye pāde sāṅgopāsanāmabhidhāya tathaiva tṛtīyapādopāsanāmabhidhātuṃ tadādyaṃ padam, ṣaṣṭhaṃ ca mūlamantrāpekṣayā, uktopāsye vyākhyātuṃ devapraśnaḥ atha kasmāducyate nṛsiṃhamiti; sa ca uktārthaḥ | sa hovāca prajāpatirityanuṣajyottaram | atra ca yasmācchabdaprayogāt svamahimneti asya anuṣaṅgaṃ darśayati |
analyzed: evam dvitīye pāde sāṅga upāsanām abhidhāya tathā eva tṛtīya pāda upāsanām abhidhātum tad ādyam padam ṣaṣṭham ca mūlamantra apekṣayā ukta upāsye vyākhyātum deva praśnaḥ atha kasmāt ucyate nṛsiṃham iti sa ca ukta arthaḥ sa ha uvāca prajāpatiḥ iti anuṣajya uttaram atra ca yasmāt śabda prayogāt sva mahimnā iti asya anuṣaṅgam darśayati

original: yasmātsarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ madhye nā puruṣākāro vīryavattamaḥ tataḥ sarvātiśāyinaḥ śreṣṭhatamaśca siṃho vīryavattamaḥ śreṣṭhatamaścetyuktārtham | tataśca ubhayātmarūpapradarśanena yadyadrūpaṃ kāmayate tattaddhāraṇe līlayaiva śakto'yamiti darśayati | yasmādevaṃ tasmānnṛsiṃhaḥ parameśvara āsīdityanvayaḥ |
analyzed: yasmāt sarveṣām bhūtānām madhye nā puruṣa ākāraḥ vīryavattamaḥ tatas sarva atiśāyinaḥ śreṣṭhatamaḥ ca siṃhaḥ vīryavattamaḥ śreṣṭhatamaḥ ca iti ukta artham tatas ca ubhaya ātma rūpa pradarśanena yat yat rūpam kāmayate tat tat dhāraṇe līlayā eva śaktaḥ iyam iti darśayati yasmāt evam tasmāt nṛsiṃhaḥ parameśvaraḥ āsīt iti anvayaḥ

original: na ca nṛsiṃhe parameśvara āsīdityanvayaḥ, vaiyadhikaraṇyāpatteḥ, sāmānādhikaraṇyānvayopapattau satyāṃ vaiyadhikaraṇyānupapatteḥ | tasmānnṛsiṃhaḥ parameśvarastrinetro nīlakaṇṭhaḥ pinākīti siddham |
analyzed: na ca nṛsiṃhe parameśvaraḥ āsīt iti anvayaḥ vaiyadhikaraṇya āpatteḥ sāmānādhikaraṇya anvaya upapattau satyām vaiyadhikaraṇya anupapatteḥ tasmāt nṛsiṃhaḥ parameśvaraḥ trinetraḥ nīlakaṇṭhaḥ pinākī iti siddham

original: ṛtaṃ satyamiti prāgvyākhyātaṃ mantravarṇācca uktaṃ jagaddhitaṃ jagato hitaṃ jagaddhitam aniṣṭanirasanena, vai prasiddham, etadrūpaṃ prāgupāsyatvena yaduktamakṣaraṃ bhavati yadakṣaramavināśaṃ cidrūpaṃ nirākāraṃ tadeva sākāramupāsakānugrahāya bhavatītyanvayaḥ |
analyzed: ṛtam satyam iti prāk vyākhyātam mantra varṇāt ca uktam jagat hitam jagataḥ hitam jagat hitam aniṣṭa nirasanena vai prasiddham etat rūpam prāk upāsya tvena yat uktam akṣaram bhavati yat akṣaram avināśam cit rūpam nirākāram tat eva sa ākāram upāsaka anugrahāya bhavati iti anvayaḥ

original: evaṃ nṛsiṃhapadaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ mūlanṛsiṃhavyūhopāsye vyākhyāya tadeva padam ṛcā dvātiṃraśannṛsiṃhavyūhe vyācaṣṭe -- viṣṇuḥ mṛgaḥ siṃhaḥ prastavate stutiṃ prāpnoti stutimantraiḥ tadvīryāya tattatsāmathryāya nabhīmaḥ na bhayaṃkaraḥ | kucaraḥ kutrāyaṃ na carati sarvadevavigraheṣu līlayā svayaṃ vicarati sarvadevalīlāvigrahadhārītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: evam nṛsiṃha padam ṣaṣṭham mūla nṛsiṃha vyūha upāsye vyākhyāya tat eva padam ṛcā dvātiṃraśat nṛsiṃha vyūhe vyācaṣṭe viṣṇuḥ mṛgaḥ siṃhaḥ prastavate stutim prāpnoti stuti mantraiḥ tad vīryāya tad tad sāmathryāya nabhīmaḥ na bhayaṃkaraḥ kucaraḥ kutra ayam na carati sarva deva vigraheṣu līlayā svayam vicarati sarva deva līlā vigraha dhārī iti arthaḥ

original: giriṣṭhāḥ giriḥ parvataḥ tatstha īśvarātmaka ityarthaḥ; yadvā giriṣu vāgrūpāsu stutiṣu yadyadrūpamabhilaṣan stotā kāmayate tattadrūpaṃ svasminsthāpayatīti giriṣṭhāḥ | yasya triṣu vikramaṇeṣu vigraheṣu vividhaṃ kramaṇaṃ vikramaṇaṃ teṣu brāhṛviṣṇumaheśvarātmakeṣu | adhi ityuparibhāve | adhyuruṣu bahulīlāvigraheṣu |
analyzed: giriṣṭhāḥ giriḥ parvataḥ tad sthaḥ īśvara ātmakaḥ iti arthaḥ yat vā giriṣu vāc rūpāsu stutiṣu yat yat rūpam abhilaṣan stotā kāmayate tat tat rūpam svasmin sthāpayati iti giriṣṭhāḥ yasya triṣu vikramaṇeṣu vigraheṣu vividham kramaṇam vikramaṇam teṣu brāhṛ viṣṇu maheśvara ātmakeṣu adhi iti upari bhāve adhi uruṣu bahu līlā vigraheṣu

original: bhuvanāni sarvāṇi kṣiyanti nivasanti, svabhāvataḥ tāni jñānapūrvakāṇi nivasanti vinivasanti -- eṣu līlāvigraheṣu vayaṃ tiṣṭhāma iti | tarhi kṣiyatiraiśvaryakarma eaiśvaryaṃ prāpnuvantīti | evaṃ nānāvidhavikramaṇāvataraṇe vīryāya sāmathryāya taddarśanāya viṣṇurmṛgaḥ siṃhaḥ prastavate prakarṣeṇa stutiṃ labhata ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: bhuvanāni sarvāṇi kṣiyanti nivasanti svabhāvataḥ tāni jñāna pūrvakāṇi nivasanti vinivasanti eṣu līlā vigraheṣu vayam tiṣṭhāmaḥ iti tarhi prāpnuvanti iti evam nānāvidha vikramaṇa avataraṇe vīryāya sāmathryāya tad darśanāya viṣṇuḥ mṛgaḥ siṃhaḥ prastavate prakarṣeṇa stutim labhate iti arthaḥ

original: yasmāścedamubhayopāsye nṛsiṃhapadaṃ vyākhyātaṃ tasmādityupasaṃharati -- tasmāducyate nṛsiṃhamiti | evamubhayāpekṣayā ādyaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ nṛsiṃhapadam ubhayopāsye vyākhyāya athedānīm ubhayāpekṣayā dvitīyaṃ saptamaṃ ca padaṃ vyākhyātuṃ praśnaḥ -- atha kasmāducyate bhīṣaṇamiti | sa hovāca prajāpatirityanuṣajyottaram |
analyzed: yasmāt ca idam ubhaya upāsye nṛsiṃha padam vyākhyātam tasmāt iti upasaṃharati tasmāt ucyate nṛsiṃham iti evam ubhaya apekṣayā ādyam ṣaṣṭham nṛsiṃha padam ubhaya upāsye vyākhyāya atha idānīm ubhaya apekṣayā dvitīyam saptamam ca padam vyākhyātum praśnaḥ atha kasmāt ucyate bhīṣaṇam iti sa ha uvāca prajāpatiḥ iti anuṣajya uttaram

original: yasmācchabdopādānātsvamahimnetyanupaṅgaḥ | yasmātsvamahimnā yasya mūlanṛsiṃhavyūhasvarūpaṃ sāṅgaṃ śikhāṅgayuktaṃ maulipradeśe cāndratejorāśiyuktaṃ sāmāṅgayajurlakṣmīmantravyākhyātaṃ bhūrbhuvaḥsvarmaharlokacatuṣṭayasaṃpiṇḍitatejorāśiyuktam apradhṛṣyatejomayaṃ rūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve devāstadaṅgadyunivāsino vasurudrādityāḥ sarvāṇi bhūtānīmāni bhītyā
analyzed: yasmāt śabda upādānāt sva mahimnā iti anupaṅgaḥ yasmāt sva mahimnā yasya mūla nṛsiṃha vyūha svarūpam sa aṅgam śikhā aṅga yuktam mauli pradeśe cāndra tejaḥ rāśi yuktam sāma aṅga yajuḥ lakṣmī mantra vyākhyātam bhūḥ bhuvaḥ svar mahar loka catuṣṭaya saṃpiṇḍita tejaḥ rāśi yuktam apradhṛṣya tejaḥ mayam rūpam dṛṣṭvā sarve devāḥ tad aṅga dyuni vāsinaḥ vasu rudra ādityāḥ sarvāṇi bhūtāni imāni bhītyā

original: bhayena palāyante palāyanaṃ kurvanti, svayaṃ devaḥ yasmātkasmādapi na bibheti niratiśayābhayaguṇaviśiṣṭa upāsyaḥ | evam uktopāsye bhīṣaṇapadaṃ vyākhyāya tadeva padaṃ dvitīye vyūhe kṛtvā vyācaṣṭe -- bhīṣetyādi | bhīṣā bhītyā asmānmūlavyūhāt vātaḥ vāyuḥ pavate vāti | vātapadopādānāt pañcamahābhūtavyūhaḥ upalakṣitaḥ |
analyzed: bhayena palāyante palāyanam kurvanti svayam devaḥ yasmāt kasmāt api na bibheti niratiśaya abhaya guṇa viśiṣṭaḥ upāsyaḥ evam ukta upāsye bhīṣaṇa padam vyākhyāya tat eva padam dvitīye vyūhe kṛtvā vyācaṣṭe bhīṣā ityādi bhīṣā bhītyā asmāt mūlavyūhāt vātaḥ vāyuḥ pavate vāti vāta pada upādānāt pañca mahābhūta vyūhaḥ upalakṣitaḥ

original: bhīṣodeti sūryaḥ iti somasūryavyūhau upalakṣitau | bhīṣāsmādagniśca ityāgneyo vyūhaḥ | indraśceti sarvavyūhaḥ | mṛtyurdhāvati pañcama iti mṛtyuvyūhaḥ |
analyzed: bhīṣā udeti sūryaḥ iti soma sūrya vyūhau upalakṣitau bhīṣā asmāt agniḥ ca iti āgneyaḥ vyūhaḥ indraḥ ca iti sarva vyūhaḥ mṛtyuḥ dhāvati pañcamaḥ iti mṛtyu vyūhaḥ

original: tatra asyāmṛci yadyapi pañcānāṃ vyūhānāmupādānam, tathāpi tadādinyāyena sarvasaṃkalanatayā bhiyo darśanāt vātādityādīnāṃ svasvarūpeṇa bhayadarśanamukhena sarveṣāṃ brāhṛādīnāṃ saṃgrahaṇāt bhayābhāvarūpasya nṛsiṃhasya praveśanena vā tattadrūpadhāraṇena vā ubhayarūpateti, dvirūpatvamasti sarveṣām |
analyzed: tatra asyām ṛci yadi api pañcānām vyūhānām upādānam tathā api tad ādi nyāyena sarva saṃkalanatayā bhiyaḥ darśanāt vāta āditya ādīnām sva svarūpeṇa bhaya darśana mukhena sarveṣām brāhṛ ādīnām saṃgrahaṇāt bhaya abhāva rūpasya nṛsiṃhasya praveśanena vā tad tad rūpa dhāraṇena vā ubhaya rūpa tā iti dvi rūpa tvam asti sarveṣām

original: tatra ekaikasya devasya tattadrūpadhāraṇena ubhayarūpaṃ darśayan bhūtānāṃ devānāṃ ca svāntarbhāvena ubhayarūpaṃ pradarśayati | ityubhayarūpeṇa sarvaṃ dvātiṃraśadvyūhaṃ saṃgṛhṇātīyamṛgiti tattvārthaḥ | yasmādevamubhayopāsye bhīṣaṇapadaṃ vyākhyātaṃ tasmādityupasaṃharati -- tasmāducyate bhīṣaṇamiti |
analyzed: tatra ekaikasya devasya tad tad rūpa dhāraṇena ubhaya rūpam darśayan bhūtānām devānām ca sva antarbhāvena ubhaya rūpam pradarśayati iti ubhaya rūpeṇa sarvam dvātiṃraśat vyūham saṃgṛhṇāti iyam ṛc iti tattva arthaḥ yasmāt evam ubhaya upāsye bhīṣaṇa padam vyākhyātam tasmāt iti upasaṃharati tasmāt ucyate bhīṣaṇam iti

original: evamuktopāsye prāguktapadaṃ vyākhyāya athedānīmubhayāpekṣayā tṛtīyamaṣṭamaṃ ca padamubhayopāsye vyākhyātuṃ devapraśnaḥ -- atha kasmāducyate bhadramiti | sa hovāca prajāpatirityanuṣajyottaram | yasmātpadopādānāt svamahimnetyanuṣaṅgaḥ |
analyzed: evam ukta upāsye prāc ukta padam vyākhyāya atha idānīm ubhaya apekṣayā tṛtīyam aṣṭamam ca padam ubhaya upāsye vyākhyātum deva praśnaḥ atha kasmāt ucyate bhadram iti sa ha uvāca prajāpatiḥ iti anuṣajya uttaram yasmāt pada upādānāt sva mahimnā iti anuṣaṅgaḥ

original: svayaṃ bhadro bhūtvā bhajanīyo māṅgaliko bhūtvā sarvadā bhadraṃ māṅgalikaṃ dadāti bhadradātṛsvarūpaṃ ca mūlavyūhe upāsyamiti darśayati | rocano dīptiyuktaḥ | rocamānaḥ śikhāṅgena ruciṃ dīpta kurvan, śānacpratyayāntatvāt | tadaṅgaṃ dvitīyatejorūpādaṅgādadhikataratejorūpam |
analyzed: svayam bhadraḥ bhūtvā bhajanīyaḥ māṅgalikaḥ bhūtvā sarvadā bhadram māṅgalikam dadāti bhadra dātṛ svarūpam ca mūlavyūhe upāsyam iti darśayati rocanaḥ dīpti yuktaḥ rocamānaḥ śikhā aṅgena rucim dīpta kurvan śānac pratyaya anta tvāt tad aṅgam dvitīya tejaḥ rūpāt aṅgāt adhikatara tejaḥ rūpam

original: ataśca nānābharaṇayuktamauligataṃ tejaḥ tadantargatānāṃ devānāṃ ca svatejasā abhibhavatītyevamupāsyam | ata evoktamasmābhiḥ śikhāṅgamantraṃ vyācakṣāṇaiḥ
analyzed: atas ca nānā ābharaṇa yukta mauli gatam tejaḥ tad antargatānām devānām ca sva tejasā abhibhavati iti evam upāsyam atas eva uktam asmābhiḥ śikhā aṅgamantram vyācakṣāṇaiḥ

original: prapañcāgamaśāstre -- ṭha śikhā tejaḥ samuddiṣṭaṃ vaṣaḍityaṅgamucyate | tattejo'sya tataḥ proktā śikhā mantreṇa mantriṇaḥ ' iti | niratiśayatejo'vayavaḥ śikhetyarthaḥ, ṭha yasya jñānamayī śikhā ' iti śruteḥ | śobhanaḥ svarūpeṇa, śobhamānaḥ śikhāṅgatejasā, ata eva kalyāṇaḥ māṅgalikamūlanṛsiṃhavyūhaḥ |
analyzed: prapañca āgama śāstre śikhā tejaḥ samuddiṣṭam vaṣaṭ iti aṅgam ucyate tat tejaḥ sya tatas proktā śikhā mantreṇa mantriṇaḥ iti niratiśaya tejaḥ vayavaḥ śikhā iti arthaḥ yasya jñāna mayī śikhā iti śruteḥ śobhanaḥ sva rūpeṇa śobhamānaḥ śikhā aṅga tejasā atas eva kalyāṇaḥ māṅgalika mūla nṛsiṃha vyūhaḥ

original: evamuktopāsye aṣṭamaṃ padaṃ vyākhyāya athedānīṃ tenaiva padena dvātiṃraśadvyūham ṛcā vyācaṣṭe -- bhadraṃ karṇebhiriti | iyamṛk prārambhe śāntipāṭhe vyākhyātā | tanūbhireva ebhistanūmantraireva sthirairaṅgairiti viśeṣaḥ | pañcamāṅgāntarbhāvātstutimantrāṇāmeva ubhayopāsye vyākhyānaṃ tasmādityupasaṃharati -- tasmāducyate bhadramiti |
analyzed: evam ukta upāsye aṣṭamam padam vyākhyāya atha idānīm tena eva padena dvātiṃraśadvyūham ṛcā vyācaṣṭe bhadram karṇebhiḥ iti iyam ṛc prārambhe śānti pāṭhe vyākhyātā tanūbhiḥ eva ebhiḥ tanū mantraiḥ eva sthiraiḥ aṅgaiḥ iti viśeṣaḥ pañcama aṅga antarbhāvāt stuti mantrāṇām eva ubhaya upāsye vyākhyānam tasmāt iti upasaṃharati tasmāt ucyate bhadram iti

original: itiśabdo vyākhyātaḥ | evaṃ tṛtīyapāde tattatpadavyākhyānena sāṅgopāsanāmabhidhāya tathaiva caturthapādopāsanāmabhidhātuṃ tadādyapadaṃ mūlamantrāpekṣayā navamaṃ ca padam ubhayopāsye vyākhyātuṃ devapraśnaḥ -- atha kasmāducyate mṛtyumṛtyumiti | sa hovāca prajāpatirityanuṣajyottaram | yasmāt svamahimnetyanuṣaṅgaḥ |
analyzed: iti śabdaḥ vyākhyātaḥ evam tṛtīya pāde tad tad pada vyākhyānena sāṅga upāsanām abhidhāya tathā eva caturtha pāda upāsanām abhidhātum tad ādya padam mūlamantra apekṣayā navamam ca padam ubhaya upāsye vyākhyātum deva praśnaḥ atha kasmāt ucyate mṛtyu mṛtyum iti sa ha uvāca prajāpatiḥ iti anuṣajya uttaram yasmāt sva mahimnā iti anuṣaṅgaḥ

original: svabhaktānāṃ bhaja sevāyāṃ svasevakānām ananyabhāvena smṛta eva upāsita eva mṛtyuṃ sākṣātkālaprāptam apamṛtyuṃ ca avāntaraprāptaṃ jātakarmaṇi gaṇitaśāstranirṇītāyuḥparimāṇāt tadantarā mṛtyuḥ apamṛtyuḥ taṃ ca ananyabhāvena upāsakānām aprārthita eva mārayati vināśayatītyevaṃrupaṃ kavacamaṅgamupāsyam |
analyzed: sva bhaktānām bhaja sevāyām sva sevakānām ananya bhāvena smṛtaḥ eva upāsitaḥ eva mṛtyum sākṣāt kāla prāptam apamṛtyum ca avāntara prāptam jātakarmaṇi gaṇita śāstra nirṇīta āyuḥ parimāṇāt tad antarā mṛtyuḥ apamṛtyuḥ tam ca ananya bhāvena upāsakānām a prārthitaḥ eva mārayati vināśayati iti evaṃrupam kavacam aṅgam upāsyam

original: tasya sāmāṅgamantreṇa nṛsiṃhagāyatryā nṛsiṃharūpeṇa vyākhyātatvāt svān tadupāsakān svasvarūpānsaṃpādya mṛtyumapamṛtyuṃ ca mārayatītyarthaḥ,
analyzed: tasya sāma aṅga mantreṇa nṛsiṃhagāyatryā nṛsiṃha rūpeṇa vyākhyāta tvāt svān tad upāsakān sva svarūpān saṃpādya mṛtyum apamṛtyum ca mārayati iti arthaḥ

original: ṭhayo vai nṛsiṃho devo bhagavānyaśca jīvaḥ ' iti mantravarṇāt | idaṃ prāguktaṃ padaṃ mūlanṛsiṃhavyūhopāsyaparatvena vyākhyāya athedānīṃ tenaiva padena dvātiṃraśadvyūham ṛcā vyācaṣṭe | yo dvātiṃraśannṛsiṃhavyūha ātmadāḥ ātmānaṃ dadātītyātmadāḥ svasvarūpadātā sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ svarūpaṃ datvā dhārayatītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: vai nṛsiṃhaḥ devaḥ bhagavān yaḥ ca jīvaḥ iti mantra varṇāt idam prāc uktam padam mūlanṛsiṃha vyūha upāsya paratvena vyākhyāya atha idānīm tena eva padena dvātiṃraśat vyūham ṛcā vyācaṣṭe yaḥ dvātiṃraśat nṛsiṃha vyūhaḥ ātma dāḥ ātmānam dadāti iti ātma dāḥ sva svarūpa dātā sarveṣām devānām sva rūpam da tvā dhārayati iti arthaḥ

original: baladāḥ sāmathryadātā svopāsakānāṃ svasvarūpadhāraṇe śakiṃta dadātītyarthaḥ | yasya praśiṣaṃ mūlanṛsiṃhavyūhasya aṅgacatuṣṭayapraśiṣaṃ prakarṣeṇa śiṣyata iti praśiṣaṃ prorvaritaṃ dvātiṃraśadvyūhaṃ viśve devāḥ sarve devāḥ upāsate upāsta kurvantītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: bala dāḥ sāmathrya dātā sva upāsakānām sva svarūpa dhāraṇe dadāti iti arthaḥ yasya praśiṣam mūlanṛsiṃha vyūhasya aṅga catuṣṭaya praśiṣam prakarṣeṇa śiṣyate iti praśiṣam prorvaritam dvātiṃraśat vyūham viśve devāḥ sarve devāḥ upāsate upāsta kurvanti iti arthaḥ

original: yasya cchāyāmṛtam, chāyeti gṛhanāma, chāyaivāmṛtaṃ chāyāmṛtaṃ mahācakram, tadantarbhāvādasya vyūhasya; yo vyūho mṛtyumṛtyuḥ mṛtyorapi mṛtyuḥ, ṭha mṛtyuryasyopasecanam ' iti śruteḥ | kaṃ prajāpatiṃ brāhṛṇo vyūham, tadādinyāyena baddhakramakatvāt sarvaṃ saṃgṛhṇāti; devam, ṭha devo dānādvā dyotanādvā dīpanādvā ' iti yāskavacanāt |
analyzed: yasya chāyā amṛtam chāyā iti gṛha nāma chāyā eva amṛtam chāyā amṛtam mahācakram tad antarbhāvāt asya vyūhasya yaḥ vyūhaḥ mṛtyu mṛtyuḥ mṛtyoḥ api mṛtyuḥ mṛtyuḥ yasya upasecanam iti śruteḥ kam prajāpatim brāhṛṇaḥ vyūham tad ādi nyāyena baddha kramaka tvāt sarvam saṃgṛhṇāti devam devaḥ dānāt vā dyotanāt vā dīpanāt vā iti yāska vacanāt

original: haviṣā haviṣpradānena homena naivedyena vā arcanena | ata eva vakṣyati mahācakraprakaraṇe -- ṭha anuṣṭubhā homaṃ kuryāt anuṣṭubhā arcanam ' iti | vidhema paricarema | yadvā ṭha vidhatirdānakarma 'iti yāskavacanāt brāāhṛvyūhaprabhṛtivyūhāya havirdadmaḥ -- iti vibhaktivyatyayaḥ kaśabde devaśabde ca |
analyzed: haviṣā haviṣpradānena homena naivedyena vā arcanena atas eva vakṣyati mahācakra prakaraṇe anuṣṭubhā homam kuryāt anuṣṭubhā arcanam iti vidhema paricarema yat vā vidhatiḥ dāna karma iti yāska vacanāt brāāhṛ vyūha prabhṛti vyūhāya haviḥ dadmaḥ iti vibhakti vyatyayaḥ ka śabde deva śabde ca

original: tasminpakṣe vidhatiḥ paricaraṇakarmeti tattvārthaḥ | evaṃ prāguktopāsye mṛtyumṛtyupadaṃ vyākhyātaṃ tasmādityupasaṃharati -- tasmāducyate mṛtyumṛtyumiti | evaṃ prāguktapadaṃ prāguktopāsye vyākhyāya athedānīmubhayāpekṣayā dvitīyaṃ daśamaṃ ca padaṃ vyākhyātuṃ devapraśnaḥ -- atha kasmāducyate namāmīti | sa hovāca prajāpatirityanuṣajyottaram |
analyzed: tasmin pakṣe vidhatiḥ paricaraṇa karma iti tattva arthaḥ evam prāgukta upāsye mṛtyu mṛtyu padam vyākhyātam tasmāt iti upasaṃharati tasmāt ucyate mṛtyu mṛtyum iti evam prāgukta padam prāgukta upāsye vyākhyāya atha idānīm ubhaya apekṣayā dvitīyam daśamam ca padam vyākhyātum deva praśnaḥ atha kasmāt ucyate namāmi iti sa ha uvāca prajāpatiḥ iti anuṣajya uttaram

original: yasmāt svamahimnetyanuṣaṅgaḥ | namāmītyasyā ākhyātapadatvāt asmadarthaṃ pratyayārthaṃ vihāya prakṛtyarthaṃ vyācaṣṭe | tathā ca asya prāktanasarvapadārthasaṃbandhinaḥ sarvatrānuṣaṅgaḥ | yasmācchabdopādānāt svamahimnetyanuṣaṅgaḥ prakṛtyarthena |
analyzed: yasmāt sva mahimnā iti anuṣaṅgaḥ namāmi iti asyāḥ ākhyāta pada tvāt asmad artham pratyaya artham vihāya prakṛti artham vyācaṣṭe tathā ca asya prāktana sarva padārtha saṃbandhinaḥ sarvatra anuṣaṅgaḥ yasmāt śabda upādānāt sva mahimnā iti anuṣaṅgaḥ prakṛti arthena

original: yasmāt yaṃ sarve devāḥ prāguktaviśeṣaṇaṃ mūlanṛsiṃhavyūhaṃ sarve pṛthivyantarikṣabrāhṛlokanivāsinaḥ mahācakropāsakāśca namanti namaskurvanti -- iti sarvanamaskāryaguṇaviśiṣṭaḥ upāsyaḥ iti darśayati | tathā ca dvividhopāsakānāṃ devānāmadhikāriviśeṣaṇamāha -- mumukṣavo brāhṛvādinaśca iti, abrāhṛvādina iti anyathā dvaividhyāsaṃbhavāt |
analyzed: yasmāt yam sarve devāḥ prāc ukta viśeṣaṇam mūlanṛsiṃha vyūham sarve pṛthivī antarikṣa brāhṛ loka nivāsinaḥ mahācakra upāsakāḥ ca namanti namaskurvanti iti sarva namaskārya guṇa viśiṣṭaḥ upāsyaḥ iti darśayati tathā ca dvividha upāsakānām devānām adhikāri viśeṣaṇam āha mumukṣavaḥ brāhṛ vādinaḥ ca iti a brāhṛ vādinaḥ iti anyathā dvaividhya asaṃbhavāt

original: yadvā mumukṣavo brāhṛvādino muktāśca līlayā vigrahaṃ parigṛhra namantītyanuṣaṅgaḥ | etaduktaṃ bhavati -- brāhṛloke ṭha sa brāhṛā sa śivaḥ sa hariḥ ' ityādimantravarṇopāttasāmāṅganṛsiṃhagāyatryā vyākhyātanṛsiṃhavyūhaḥ caturthakavacāṅgāśrayatvenopāsyaḥ | tacca kavacaṃ sarvānetānupāsyānsaṃgṛhṇātītyaṅgacatuṣṭayāntargatānanyāṃ ca |
analyzed: yat vā mumukṣavaḥ brāhṛ vādinaḥ muktāḥ ca līlayā vigraham namanti iti anuṣaṅgaḥ etat uktam bhavati brāhṛ loke sa sa śivaḥ sa hariḥ ityādi mantra varṇa upātta sāma aṅga nṛsiṃha gāyatryā vyākhyāta nṛsiṃha vyūhaḥ caturtha kavaca aṅga āśraya tvena upāsyaḥ tat ca kavacam sarvān etān upāsyān saṃgṛhṇāti iti aṅga catuṣṭaya antargatān anyām ca

original: ata evoktamasmābhiḥ kavacāṅgamantrārthaṃ vyācakṣāṇaiḥ prapañcasāre -- ṭha kavacagraha ityasmāddhātoḥ kavacasaṃbhavaḥ | huṃ tejastejasā tena gṛhrate kavacaṃ tataḥ ' iti |
analyzed: atas eva uktam asmābhiḥ kavaca aṅga mantra artham vyācakṣāṇaiḥ prapañcasāre kavaca grahaḥ iti asmāt dhātoḥ kavaca saṃbhavaḥ hum tejaḥ tejasā tena gṛhrate kavacam tatas iti

original: evaṃ prakṛtyarthasahitena ca padārthaṃ pratipādya sādhāraṇarūpaṃ sarvanamaskāryatvaguṇamabhidhāya athedānīṃ sāmādimantrasādhāraṇatvena punaḥ prakṛtyartham ṛcā vyācaṣṭe -- pra nūnamiti | ukthyaṃ praśastaṃ brāhṛṇaspatiḥ brāhṛṇaḥ sākārasya nirākārasya ca patiḥ upadeśadvārā pātā pālayitā |
analyzed: evam prakṛti artha sahitena ca padārtham pratipādya sādhāraṇa rūpam sarva namaskārya tva guṇam abhidhāya atha idānīm sāma ādi mantra sādhāraṇa tvena punar prakṛti artham ṛcā vyācaṣṭe pra nūnam iti ukthyam praśastam brāhṛṇaspatiḥ brāhṛṇaḥ sa ākārasya nirākārasya ca patiḥ upadeśa dvārā pātā pālayitā

original: nūnaṃ niścitaṃ mantraṃ sāmarājaṃ stuhītyādi ya ātmadā ityantaṃ dvātiṃraśadvyūhapratipādakaṃ mantrajātam | yasminprāgukte mantre indro mitro varuṇo'ryamā devā okāṃsi gṛhāṇyupāsanāya cakrire kṛtavanta ityarthaḥ | anenaitaddarśayati -- yathā deve upāsye gurau ca bhaktiḥ tathā mantre'pīti |
analyzed: nūnam niścitam mantram sāmarājam stuhi ityādi yaḥ ātma dāḥ ityantam dvātiṃraśat vyūha pratipādakam mantra jātam yasmin prāgukte mantre indraḥ mitraḥ varuṇoḥ yamāḥ devāḥ okāṃsi gṛhāṇi upāsanāya cakrire kṛtavantaḥ iti arthaḥ anena etat darśayati yathā deve upāsye gurau ca bhaktiḥ tathā mantre api iti

original: taduktam -- ṭha gurau deve ca mantre ca sadṛśī bhaktiriṣyate ' iti | tatra ca mantrasya namaskāryatvaśravaṇāt | evaṃ namāmītyetadākhyātapadamuktopāsye vyākhyātaṃ tasmādityupasaṃharati -- tasmāducyate
analyzed: tat uktam gurau deve ca mantre ca sadṛśī bhaktiḥ iṣyate iti tatra ca mantrasya namaskārya tva śravaṇāt evam namāmi iti etat ākhyāta pada mukta upāsye vyākhyātam tasmāt iti upasaṃharati tasmāt ucyate

original: namāmīti | evaṃ namāmīti padaṃ prakṛtyarthasaṃbandhitvena vyākhyāya athedānīmahamiti kartṛpadaṃ sarvasādhāraṇyena vyākhyātuṃ devapraśnaḥ -- atha kasmāducyate'hamiti | tatra ākhyātottamapuruṣaprayogādarthādeva ahamiti prāpte punaḥ prayogaḥ sa ca kasmāditi codyābhiprāyeṇa | sa hovāca prajāpatirityanuṣajyottaram |
analyzed: namāmi iti evam namāmi iti padam prakṛti artha saṃbandhi tvena vyākhyāya atha idānīm aham iti kartṛ padam sarva sādhāraṇyena vyākhyātum deva praśnaḥ atha kasmāt ucyate iham iti tatra ākhyāta uttama puruṣa prayogāt arthāt eva aham iti prāpte punar prayogaḥ sa ca kasmāt iti codya abhiprāyeṇa sa ha uvāca prajāpatiḥ iti anuṣajya uttaram

original: pañcāṅgopāsanākartṛphalaṃ nirdiśyate tādātmyalakṣaṇam | na ca mumukṣoretadaniṣṭamiti vācyam, eaiśvarye sati etatphalāvāpteḥ | ya iha sthātumapekṣate tasya tādātmyalakṣaṇaṃ sarvaiśvaryaṃ dadāti dehānte devaḥ paraṃ brāhṛ tārakamiti śruteḥ phalapadamidaṃ na tu upāsakapadam | tacca pṛthaksāmābhivyaktaṃ mantreṇa vyācaṣṭe |
analyzed: pañcāṅga upāsanā kartṛ phalam nirdiśyate tādātmya lakṣaṇam na ca mumukṣoḥ etat aniṣṭam iti vācyam sati etad phala avāpteḥ yaḥ iha sthātum apekṣate tasya tādātmya lakṣaṇam sarva aiśvaryam dadāti dehānte devaḥ param brāhṛ tārakam iti śruteḥ phala padam idam na tu upāsaka padam tat ca pṛthak sāma abhivyaktam mantreṇa vyācaṣṭe

original: tacca sarvapadeṣvanuṣajyamānaṃ sarvapadajātaṃ sāmābhivyaktameva vyākhyātamiti niyamaṃ darśayati | tathā ca prāguktā sarvopāsanā sāmapūrvikaiveti |

original: samānamanyat | dvitīyaḥ pādastaijasastriṣvapi sthāneṣu tattvāpratibodhalakṣaṇaḥ svāpo'viśiṣṭa iti pūrvābhyāṃ suṣuptaṃ vibhajate -- yatra supto na kaṃcanetyādi | na hi suṣupte pūrvayoriva anyathāgrahaṇalakṣaṇaṃ svapnadarśanaṃ kāmo vā kaścana vidyate | tadetatsuṣuptaṃ sthānamasyeti suṣuptasthānaḥ sthānadvayapravibhaktamanaspanditaṃ dvaitajātam |
analyzed: samānam anyat dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ taijasaḥ triṣu api sthāneṣu tattva apratibodha lakṣaṇaḥ svāpaḥ viśiṣṭaḥ iti pūrvābhyām suṣuptam vibhajate yatra suptaḥ na kaṃcana ityādi na hi suṣupte pūrvayoḥ iva anyathā grahaṇa lakṣaṇam svapna darśanam kāmaḥ vā kaścana vidyate tat etat suṣuptam sthānam asya iti suṣupta sthānaḥ sthāna dvaya pravibhaktam an a spanditam dvaita jātam

original: tadyathā rūpāparijñānena avivekāpannaṃ naiśatamograstamivāhaḥ sphuṭaprapañcam ekībhūtamucyate | ata eva svapnajāgranmanaḥspandanāni prajñānāni ghanībhūtānīveyamavasthā vivekarūpatvātprajñānaghana ucyate | yathā rātrau naiśena tamasā avibhajyamānaṃ sarvaṃ ghanamiva tadvat prajñānaghanaḥ | evaśabdāt jātyantaraṃ nāstītyarthaḥ |

original: manaso viṣayaviṣayyākāraspandanāyāsaduḥkhābhāvāt ānandamayaḥ ānandaprāyaḥ na ānanda eva, anātyantikatvāt -- yathā loke nirāyāsasthitau mukhyānandabhugucyate, ṭha eṣa paramānandaḥ ' iti śruteḥ | svapnādipratibodhe cetaḥ prati dvārībhūtatvāt cetomukhaḥ bodhalakṣaṇaṃ vā ceto mukhaṃ dvāramasya svapnādyāgamanaṃ prati iti cetomukhaḥ |
