original: antarālavyāpārapratiṣedhena ubhayatra yugapatprajñārthaṃ vyāpāre prāpte, taṃ niṣedhati -- na prajñamiti | evaṃ sarvato manovyāpārapratiṣedhāt avyākṛtaṃ manaḥ avidyamānam asadiva tiṣṭheta tatpratiṣedhati -- nāprajñamiti |
analyzed: antarāla vyāpāra pratiṣedhena ubhayatra yugapad prajñā artham vyāpāre prāpte tam niṣedhati na prajñam iti evam sarvatas manaḥ vyāpāra pratiṣedhāt avyākṛtam manaḥ avidyamānam asat iva tiṣṭheta tat pratiṣedhati na aprajñam iti

original: tatsthitipratiṣedhāt ajñānasākṣike svapne prāpte, taṃ niṣedhati -- na prajñānaghanamiti | atha ṣaṭpratiṣedhaiḥ praṇavavidyāṅgabhūtaiḥ upāsyapratikūlaṃ pratiṣidhya vyāvṛtya yadupāsye mano'vyāvṛttaṃ kāryaṃ tadupāsyaṃ vastu nirdiśati -- adṛṣṭamiti | na hi īdṛśamupāsyaṃ kvaciddṛṣṭaṃ puruṣākārameva vā tiryagākārameva vā yathā gopālakūrmādi |
analyzed: tad sthiti pratiṣedhāt ajñāna sākṣike svapne prāpte tam niṣedhati na prajñāna ghanam iti atha ṣaṣ pratiṣedhaiḥ praṇava vidyā aṅga bhūtaiḥ upāsya pratikūlam pratiṣidhya vyāvṛtya yat upāsye manaḥ vyāvṛttam kāryam tat upāsyam vastu nirdiśati adṛṣṭam iti na hi īdṛśam upāsyam kvacid dṛṣṭam puruṣa ākāram eva vā tiryak ākāram eva vā yathā gopāla kūrma ādi

original: tattu ubhayarūpaṃ nṛsiṃhātmakaṃ trinetraṃ pinākahastamiti | ata eva avyavahāryam | ata eva alakṣaṇamiti | na lakṣaṇaṃ liṅgaṃ vidyate yasya tadalakṣaṇam | ata eva acintyam anumānena tarkeṇa vā | ata eva avyapadeśyaṃ niyatākāropāsyapratipādakaiḥ śabdaiḥ |
analyzed: tat tu ubhaya rūpam nṛsiṃha ātmakam trinetram pinākahastam iti atas eva avyavahāryam atas eva alakṣaṇam iti na lakṣaṇam liṅgam vidyate yasya tat alakṣaṇam atas eva acintyam anumānena tarkeṇa vā atas eva avyapadeśyam niyata ākāra upāsya pratipādakaiḥ śabdaiḥ

original: ata eva ekātmapratyayasāram ekasminsarveṣāmātmanāṃ pratyayaḥ ekātmapratyayaḥ sa eva sāraṃ yasya tat tathoktam | athavā eka eva ātmā upāsyopāsakayoḥ ityevaṃ pratyayaḥ | śeṣaṃ pūrvavat |
analyzed: atas eva eka ātma pratyaya sāram ekasmin sarveṣām ātmanām pratyayaḥ eka ātma pratyayaḥ saḥ eva sāram yasya tat tathā uktam athavā ekaḥ eva ātmā upāsya upāsakayoḥ iti evam pratyayaḥ śeṣam pūrvavat

original: ata eva prapañcopaśamaṃ prāguktena nyāyena manaso hi bāhradarśanasmaraṇavyāpārābhāvāt vyāvṛttatvācca svāpābhāvādityupāsyavyatirekeṇa prapañcāpratīteḥ prapañcopaśamamiti | śivaṃ śaṃkaraṃ caturthaṃ turīyapādaṃ manyante ardhamātrānādātmakamiti tathopāsyam | pratyagātmatayā upāsyamāha -- sa upāsya ātmā pratyagātmetyevaṃ vijñeyo draṣṭavyaḥ ||
analyzed: atas eva prapañca upaśamam prāguktena nyāyena manasaḥ hi bāhra darśana smaraṇa vyāpāra abhāvāt vyāvṛtta tvāt ca svāpa abhāvāt iti upāsya vyatirekeṇa prapañca apratīteḥ prapañca upaśamam iti śivam śaṃkaram caturtham turīya pādam manyante ardha mātrā nāda ātmakam iti tathā upāsyam pratyagātma tayā upāsyam āha saḥ upāsyaḥ ātmā pratyagātmā iti evam vijñeyaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ

original: evamiyaṃ praṇavavidyā ṣaṭpratiṣedhavatī saptaśaktikahmadayāṅgabījamukhavatī aṅginā manovyāpāraṃ sthiraṃ kurvatī asyāṃ vidyāyām upakārakavatī asakṛdāvartanīyā omupāsakeneti tātparyārthaḥ |
analyzed: evam iyam praṇava vidyā ṣaṣ pratiṣedhavatī sapta śaktika hma dayā aṅga bīja mukhavatī aṅginā manaḥ vyāpāram sthiram kurvatī asyām vidyāyām upakārakavatī asakṛt āvartanīyā om upāsakena iti tātparyārthaḥ

original: evaṃ tāvatsāmāṅgapraṇavavidyāṃ nṛsiṃhabrāhṛvidyopakāriṇīmabhidhāya athedānīṃ tadupakāriṇīmeva śiro'ṅgavyākhyātrīṃ sāmāṅgasavitṛpratipādyāṃ vidyāṃ nṛsiṃhabrāhṛvidyāṅgabhūtāmāha --
analyzed: evam tāvat sāma aṅga praṇava vidyām nṛsiṃha brāhṛ vidyā upakāriṇīm abhidhāya atha idānīm tad upakāriṇīm eva śiraḥ oṅga vyākhyātrīm sāma aṅga savitṛ pratipādyām vidyām nṛsiṃha brāhṛ vidyā aṅga bhūtām āha

original: athaśabdaḥ kramaprāptānantaryārthaḥ | mantre savitṛpadābhāve'pi sāvitrīti vadan savitṛkālīnaprakāśavat suṣuptaprakāśavacca bāhrābhyantaratamonirvārakatvāt ayaṃ śiro'ṅgaprakāśo nibiḍāvidyānivartaka iti darśayati | gāyatrī, aṣṭākṣaratvāt tāṃ gāyatrīṃ yajuṣā vyācaṣṭe; yā yajuṣā proktā tayā sarvamidaṃ vyāptam | śiro'ṅgaṃ vyākhyātam upāsyaṃ ca |
analyzed: athaśabdaḥ krama prāpta ānantarya arthaḥ mantre savitṛ pada abhāve pi sāvitrī iti vadan savitṛ kālīna prakāśa vat suṣupta prakāśa vat ca bāhra abhyantara tamaḥ nirvāraka tvāt ayam śiraḥ oṅga prakāśaḥ nibiḍa avidyā nivartakaḥ iti darśayati gāyatrī aṣṭa akṣara tvāt tām gāyatrīm yajuṣā vyācaṣṭe yā yajuṣā proktā tayā sarvam idam vyāptam śiraḥ oṅgam vyākhyātam upāsyam ca

original: akṣarāṇi gaṇayati | ghṛṇiriti dve akṣare | sūrya iti trīṇi, pṛthagrephagaṇanāt | āditya iti trīṇi | etadvai sāvitrasyāṣṭākṣaraṃ padaṃ śriyā abhiṣiktamiti | śryādibhistadādinyāyena saptabhiḥ śaktibhiḥ vigrahavatībhiḥ maṇigaṇakhacitairhemakumbhairamṛtapūrṇaiḥ śiraḥ abhiṣiktamityarthaḥ | ya upāsakaḥ evamupāste tasya phalaṃ nirdiśati |
analyzed: akṣarāṇi gaṇayati ghṛṇiḥ iti dve akṣare sūryaḥ iti trīṇi pṛthak repha gaṇanāt ādityaḥ iti trīṇi etat vai sāvitrasya aṣṭa akṣaram padam śriyā abhiṣiktam iti śrī ādibhiḥ tad ādi nyāyena saptabhiḥ śaktibhiḥ vigrahavatībhiḥ maṇi gaṇa khacitaiḥ hema kumbhaiḥ amṛta pūrṇaiḥ śiraḥ abhiṣiktam iti arthaḥ yaḥ upāsakaḥ evam upāste tasya phalam nirdiśati

original: śriyā haiva abhiṣicyate prāguktābhiḥ śaktibhiḥ prāguktena prakāreṇa so'pyabhiṣicyata ityarthaḥ | tadetadṛcā abhyuktam uktārtham | ṛco niṣeduḥ nitarāṃ sevanaṃ kṛtavatyaḥ | ṛggrahaṇam upalakṣaṇārtham | yadvā ṛca iti ṣaṣṭhī | ṛcaḥ saīmityādikāyā nayāḥ pratipāditāḥ śaktayaḥ, vedā vā;
analyzed: śriyā ha eva abhiṣicyate prāc uktābhiḥ śaktibhiḥ prāc uktena prakāreṇa saḥ api abhiṣicyate iti arthaḥ tat etat ṛcā abhyuktam ukta artham ṛcaḥ niṣeduḥ nitarām sevanam kṛtavatyaḥ ṛc grahaṇam upalakṣaṇa artham yat vai ṛcaḥ iti ṣaṣṭhī ṛcaḥ saīm ityādikāyāḥ nayāḥ pratipāditāḥ śaktayaḥ vedāḥ vā

original: na kevalaṃ śaktayaḥ, api tu viśve devāḥ sarve devāḥ adhi iti upari śirasi akṣare na kṣarati na vilīnaṃ bhavati parame vyoman vyomani sarvābhiṣekadvāratvāt paramaṃ mokṣadvāratvācca vyoma yasmiñśirasi | ya upāsakaḥ tacchiro vedadevadevībhiḥ prāguktena prakāreṇa abhiṣiktaṃ na veda na jānāti kimṛcā ṛgvedādinā kariṣyati |
analyzed: na kevalam śaktayaḥ api tu viśve devāḥ sarve devāḥ adhi iti upari śirasi akṣare na kṣarati na vilīnam bhavati parame vyoman vyomani sarva abhiṣeka dvāra tvāt paramam mokṣa dvāra tvāt ca vyoma yasmin śirasi yaḥ upāsakaḥ tat śiraḥ veda deva devībhiḥ prāguktena prakāreṇa abhiṣiktam na veda na jānāti kim ṛcā ṛgveda ādinā kariṣyati

original: yadvā sariṃ pāhi iti anayā ṛcā kiṃ kariṣyati | ya it itthameva tadabhiṣiktaṃ śiraḥ viduḥ upāsate ta ime upāsakāḥ samāsate samyakprakāreṇa āsate sukhinaḥ ityarthaḥ | ṛggatam ṛkpadaṃ vyācaṣṭe | na ha vai etasya ṛcā na yajuṣā na sāmnā arthaḥ prayojanam asti yaḥ sāvitrīṃ śiraḥśikhāṃ sādhanabhūtāṃ vedeti | tataśca ayamarthaḥ |
analyzed: yat vā sarim pāhi iti anayā ṛcā kim kariṣyati ye id ittham eva tad abhiṣiktam śiraḥ viduḥ upāsate te ime upāsakāḥ samāsate samyak prakāreṇa āsate sukhinaḥ iti arthaḥ ṛc gatam ṛc padam vyācaṣṭe na ha vai etasya ṛcā na yajuṣā na sāmnā arthaḥ prayojanam asti yaḥ sāvitrīm śiraḥ śikhām sādhana bhūtām veda iti tatas ca ayam arthaḥ

original: aṣṭākṣarāṃ sāvitrīṃ paṭhitvā prāguktāḥ sarve vedadevādayaḥ abhiṣiñcatīti sāvitrasya aṣṭākṣaraṃ padam aṣṭāvakṣarāṇyabhiṣecanāya yasmiñśirasi tadaṣṭākṣaraṃ śiraḥ tadeva padam āśrayaḥ iti tattvārthaḥ |
analyzed: aṣṭa akṣarām sāvitrīm paṭhitvā prāc uktāḥ sarve veda deva ādayaḥ abhiṣiñcati iti sāvitrasya aṣṭa akṣaram padam aṣṭau akṣarāṇi abhiṣecanāya yasmin śirasi tat aṣṭa akṣaram śiraḥ tat eva padam āśrayaḥ iti tattvārthaḥ

original: evaṃ tāvannṛsiṃhabrāhṛvidyāṃ śiro'ṅgopakāriṇīṃ sāvitrābhiṣecanīṃ vidyāmabhidhāya athedānīṃ tadupakāriṇīṃ śikhāṅgadvārā sāmāṅgamahālakṣmīvidyāmāha -- oṃ bhūrlakṣmīriti praṇavavidyāpuraḥsarā etāḥ śaktayo bhūrityādyā vyāhmatayaḥ | bhūḥ, bhū sattāyāmiti sattāyāmatra vartate |
analyzed: evam tāvat nṛsiṃhabrāhṛ vidyām śiraḥ uṅga upakāriṇīm sāvitra abhiṣecanīm vidyām abhidhāya atha idānīm tad upakāriṇīm śikhā aṅga dvārā sāma aṅga mahālakṣmī vidyām āha om bhūḥ lakṣmīḥ iti praṇava vidyā puraḥsarāḥ etāḥ śaktayaḥ bhūḥ ityādyāḥ vyāhmatayaḥ bhūḥ bhū sattāyām iti sattāyām atra vartate

original: ata evoktamasmābhiḥ saptavyāhmatīvryācakṣāṇaiḥ prapañcasāre -- ṭha bhūḥpadāttu vyāhmatayo bhūḥśabdaḥ sati vartate | tatpadaṃ saditi proktaṃ sanmātratvācca bhūrataḥ || bhūtatvātkāraṇatvācca bhuvaḥśabdasya saṃgatiḥ | sarvasya svīkaraṇātsvātmatayā svaritīritam | mahattvācca mahastvācca mahacchabdaḥ samīritaḥ ' tataśca yathāsaṃkhyaṃ bhūrlakṣmīriti |
analyzed: atas eva uktam asmābhiḥ sapta vyāhmatī vryācakṣāṇaiḥ prapañcasāre bhūḥ padāt tu vyāhmatayaḥ bhūḥ śabdaḥ sati vartate tat padam sat iti proktam sat mātra tvāt ca bhūḥ atas bhūta tvāt kāraṇa tvāt ca bhuvaḥ śabdasya saṃgatiḥ sarvasya svīkaraṇāt sva ātma tayā svar iti īritam mahat tvāt ca mahaḥ tvāt ca mahat śabdaḥ samīritaḥ tatas ca yathāsaṃkhyam bhūḥ lakṣmīḥ iti

original: sanmātrabrāhṛṇo vyāpikā śaktirbhūrlakṣmīrityucyate | kāraṇamātrarūpasya brāhṛṇaḥ śaktirbhuvarlakṣmīriti | sarvatra svātmatayā avasthitasya brāhṛṇaḥ śaktiḥ suvaḥkālakarṇītyucyate | mahābhūtaprakāśakātmakasya bhuvabrrāhṛṇaḥ śaktirmahālakṣmīriti | saikaikā śaktiḥ tadaṅgaṃ śikhākhyaṃ tejomayaṃ
analyzed: vyāpikā śaktiḥ bhūḥ lakṣmīḥ iti ucyate kāraṇa mātra rūpasya brāhṛṇaḥ śaktiḥ bhuvarlakṣmīḥ iti sarvatra sva ātma tayā avasthitasya brāhṛṇaḥ śaktiḥ suvar kālakarṇī iti ucyate mahābhūta prakāśaka ātmakasya bhuva brrāhṛṇaḥ śaktiḥ mahālakṣmīḥ iti sā ekaikā śaktiḥ tad aṅgam śikhā ākhyam tejaḥ mayam

original: suṣumnāmṛtamayaṃ somarūpeṇopāsyatvāttasya pādasya, ṭha ya oṣadhīnāṃ prabhavati tārāpatiḥ somastatsāmnastṛtīyaṃ pādaṃ jānīyāt ' iti śruteḥ | somaḥ candraḥ ṭha suṣumnaḥ sūryaraśmiścandramā ' iti śruteḥ | naḥ asmān pracodayāditi cuda preraṇe prerayatu | tadaṅgamekaikā vigrahavatī śaktiḥ amṛtaruāvaṇāya prerayatu |
analyzed: suṣumna amṛta mayam soma rūpeṇa upāsya tvāt tasya pādasya yaḥ oṣadhīnām prabhavati tārā patiḥ somaḥ tat sāmnaḥ tṛtīyam pādam jānīyāt iti śruteḥ somaḥ candraḥ suṣumnaḥ sūrya raśmiḥ candramāḥ iti śruteḥ naḥ asmān pracodayāt iti preraṇe prerayatu tad aṅgam ekaikā vigrahavatī śaktiḥ amṛtaruāvaṇāya prerayatu

original: abhiṣektrīṇāṃ śaktīnāṃ śikhādhiṣṭhātrīḥ śaktīḥ prati anayā ṛcā gāyatryā yajurmahālakṣmyāḥ prārthanārūpaṃ vacanam | tataśca tadaṅgamamṛtaruāāvi amṛtarūpamupāsyamiti | athavā saikaikā śaktiḥ tadaṅgaṃ naḥ pracodayāditi naḥ prerayatu | asaṃvivādamevāṅgaṃ kuryāditi |
analyzed: abhiṣektrīṇām śaktīnām śikhā adhiṣṭhātrīḥ śaktīḥ prati anayā ṛcā gāyatryā yajuḥ mahālakṣmyāḥ prārthanā rūpam vacanam tatas ca tad aṅgam amṛta rūpam upāsyam iti athavā sā ekaikā śaktiḥ tad aṅgam naḥ pracodayāt iti naḥ prerayatu asaṃvivādam eva aṅgam kuryāt iti

original: eṣā vai mahālakṣmīḥ yajurgāyatrī mahatīnāṃ mahālakṣmyādīnāṃ pratipādakatvāt mahālakṣmīḥ sāvitramantre atra na yajuriti vadan sāmāṅgatve'pi gītirahitamaṅgadvayamiti darśayati | praṇavāntarbhāvāya akṣarāṇi gaṇayati caturviṃśadakṣarā bhavatīti | caturviśaditi cchāndasam | gāyatrī vā idaṃ tṛtīyamaṅgaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtsnaṃ yadidaṃ kiṃca |
analyzed: eṣā vai mahā lakṣmīḥ yajuḥ gāyatrī mahatīnām mahālakṣmī ādīnām pratipādaka tvāt mahā lakṣmīḥ sāvitra mantre atra na yajuḥ iti vadan sāma aṅga tve pi gīti rahitam aṅga dvayam iti darśayati praṇava antarbhāvāya akṣarāṇi gaṇayati caturviṃśat akṣarā bhavati iti caturviśat iti chāndasam gāyatrī vai idam tṛtīyam aṅgam sarvam kṛtsnam yat idam kiṃca

original: yasmādevaṃ tasmāt ya etāṃ śikhāṃ pārameśvarīṃ mahālakṣmīṃ yājuṣīṃ prāguktavigrahaśaktyupāsyāṃ veda upāste, tasya phalaṃ nirdiśati -- mahatīṃ śriyamaśnuta iti; mahatīṃ śriyaṃ prāpnotītyarthaḥ | etadgāyatryuktāḥ śaktayaḥ vigrahavatyaḥ abhiṣecanaśaktīnāmupakārāya amṛtamayīṃ śikhām amṛtaruāvaṇāya tadbandhanāya vā upāste iti tattvārthaḥ |
analyzed: yasmāt evam tasmāt yaḥ etām śikhām pārameśvarīm mahā lakṣmīm yājuṣīm prāc ukta vigraha śakti upāsyām vede upāste tasya phalam nirdiśati mahatīm śriyam aśnute iti mahatīm śriyam prāpnoti iti arthaḥ etat gāyatrī uktāḥ śaktayaḥ vigrahavatyaḥ abhiṣecana śaktīnām upakārāya amṛta mayīm śikhām tad bandhanāya vā upāste iti tattvārthaḥ

original: evaṃ tāvannṛsiṃhabrāhṛvidyopakāriṇīṃ sāmāṅgatṛtīyāṅgavidyāmabhidhāya athedānīṃ sāmāṅgacaturthāṅgavidyāṃ nṛsiṃhagāyatrīmāha | oṃ praṇavaḥ vyākhyātaḥ tadaṅgaṃ kavacākhyaṃ pārameśvaram | dhīmahīti dhyāyemahi | kimarthaṃ vajranakhāya nṛsiṃhāya | tādathrye caturthī | tadarthaṃ vidmahe jānīmaḥ yataḥ tadevāṅgaṃ naḥ asmān siṃhaḥ pracodayāt ityuktārtham |
analyzed: evam tāvat nṛsiṃha brāhṛ vidyā upakāriṇīm sāma aṅga tṛtīya aṅga vidyām abhidhāya atha idānīm sāma aṅga caturtha aṅga vidyām nṛsiṃha gāyatrīm āha om praṇavaḥ vyākhyātaḥ tad aṅgam kavaca ākhyam pārameśvaram dhīmahi iti dhyāyemahi kimartham vajranakhāya nṛsiṃhāya tādathrye caturthī tad artham vidmahe jānīmaḥ yatas tat eva aṅgam naḥ asmān siṃhaḥ pracodayāt iti ukta artham

original: naraśabdaṃ vihāya siṃha iti vadan asyāṃ vidyāyāṃ siṃhākārasya prādhānyaṃ darśayati | itiśabdo mantrasamāpta dyotayati | eṣā vai nṛsiṃhagāyatrī nṛsiṃhārthakavacapratipādakatvādgāyatrī praṇavāntarbhāvaṃ darśayati | kavacāśritatadāvṛtahmadayāntargatānāṃ vedānāṃ devānāṃ yathāyogyatayā nidānaṃ mūlakāraṇaṃ bhavati | upāsakasya phalaṃ nirdiśati |
analyzed: nara śabdam vihāya siṃhaḥ iti vadan asyām vidyāyām siṃhākārasya prādhānyam darśayati iti śabdaḥ mantra samāpta dyotayati eṣā vai nṛsiṃha gāyatrī nṛsiṃha artha kavaca pratipādaka tvāt gāyatrī praṇava antarbhāvam darśayati kavaca āśrita tad āvṛta hma dayā antargatānām vedānām devānām yathāyogyatayā nidānam mūla kāraṇam bhavati upāsakasya phalam nirdiśati

original: ya evaṃ veda sa nidānavānbhavatīti | tataścāyamarthaḥ | pārameśvaraṃ kavacākhyamaṅgaṃ hmatsaṃbandhi sarvavedanidānatvenopāsyaṃ tatpratipādakatvāt ṛksaṃbandhi sarvavedadevanidānaṃ gāyatrī ucyate iti tattvārthaḥ ||
analyzed: yaḥ evam veda sa nidānavān bhavati iti tatas ca ayam arthaḥ pārameśvaram kavaca ākhyam aṅgam hmad saṃbandhi sarva veda nidāna tvena upāsyam tad pratipādaka tvāt ṛc saṃbandhi sarva veda deva nidānam gāyatrī ucyate iti tattvārthaḥ

original: evaṃ tāvannṛsiṃhabrāhṛvidyopakāriṇyaṅgacatuṣṭayavyāpinī mahācakrākhyām abhidhātuṃ tasmaścakre dvātiṃraśatpatre yathāsaṃkhyaṃ kṛtapraṇavasaṃpuṭe nyastamūlamantrākṣare ekaikasmin tattaddevatā nṛsiṃhavyūhaṃ stutimantravarṇasāmathryalabhyaṃ ca pradarśayituṃ tānmantrānpraśnottararūpākhyāyikayā ārabhate |
analyzed: evam tāvat nṛsiṃha brāhṛ vidyā upakāriṇī aṅga catuṣṭaya vyāpinī mahācakra ākhyām abhidhātum tasmaḥ cakre dvātiṃraśat patre yathāsaṃkhyam kṛta praṇava saṃpuṭe nyasta mūlamantra akṣare ekaikasmin tad tad devatā nṛsiṃha vyūham stuti mantra varṇa sāmathrya labhyam ca pradarśayitum tān mantrān praśna uttara rūpa ākhyāyikayā ārabhate

original: devā ha vai prajāpatimabrāuvannityādi sa hovāca prajāpatirityantaṃ spaṣṭārtham | atra hi sarve mantrāḥ praṇavādikāḥ tadādinyāyena praṇavaṃ mūlamantrākṣaraṃ punaḥ praṇavaṃ sarveṣu mantreṣu darśayati | atra hi mantreṣu yacchabdadvayena anyataḥ siddhamanūdya kutracicchabdasāmathryāt kutracit tasmai ityekavacanasāmathryāt eka eva vyūhaḥ pratīyate |
analyzed: devāḥ ha vai prajāpatim abrāuvan ityādi sa ha uvāca prajāpatiḥ iti antam spaṣṭa artham atra hi sarve mantrāḥ praṇava ādikāḥ tad ādi nyāyena praṇavam mūlamantra akṣaram punar praṇavam sarveṣu mantreṣu darśayati atra hi mantreṣu yat śabda dvayena anyatas siddham anūdya kutracid śabda sāmathryāt kutracid tasmai iti ekavacana sāmathryāt ekaḥ eva vyūhaḥ pratīyate

original: sa ca dvividhaḥ kvacidasādhāraṇāyudhaiḥ tattaddevatāgamyaḥ pratīyate kvacicca viśvarūpaḥ tenaiva nyāyena ubhayatrāpi nṛsiṃhākāraḥ yogārūḍhaḥ adhastanahastābhyāṃ varadābhayahastaḥ uparitanābhyāṃ tattaddevatāyudhadhārī kvacicchaṅkhacakragadādhārī ca ityetatsarvaṃ spaṣṭaṃ kariṣyāmaḥ |
analyzed: sa ca dvividhaḥ kvacid asādhāraṇa āyudhaiḥ tad tad devatā gamyaḥ pratīyate kvacid ca viśva rūpaḥ tena eva nyāyena ubhayatra api nṛsiṃha ākāraḥ yoga ārūḍhaḥ adhastana hastābhyām varada abhaya hastaḥ uparitanābhyām tad tad devatā āyudha dhārī kvacid śaṅkha cakra gadā dhārī ca iti etat sarvam spaṣṭam kariṣyāmaḥ

original: yathā atraiva nṛsiṃhākāravyūhā brāhṛviṣṇumaheśvarātmakāḥ ruāukruāuvaśaṅkhacakrapinākatriśūlairāyudhairgamyante nṛsiṃhātmakaḥ puruṣavyūhaḥ dvibhujaḥ daśa hastyā aṅgulayaḥ daśa pādyāḥ yāvāneva puruṣaḥ, iti śruteḥ ||
analyzed: yathā atra eva nṛsiṃha ākāra vyūhāḥ brāhṛ viṣṇu maheśvara ātmakāḥ ruāu kruāuva śaṅkha cakra pināka triśūlaiḥ āyudhaiḥ gamyante nṛsiṃha ātmakaḥ puruṣa vyūhaḥ dvi bhujaḥ daśa hastyāḥ aṅgulayaḥ daśa pādyāḥ yāvān eva puruṣaḥ iti śruteḥ

original: ata ūdhrvaṃ sarve nṛsiṃhavyūhāścaturbhujāḥ nṛsiṃhātmakāśca īśvaravyūhaḥ īśvarāyudhagamyaḥ pūrveṣāṃ pañcānāṃ yathāsaṃkhyaṃ pañcaśaktivyūhaḥ sarasvatīśrīgaurīprakṛtividyātmikāḥ striyaḥ svāyudhairgamyāḥ evaṃ mūlamantrākṣareṣu daśasu aiśānīṃ diśamārabhya praṇavasaṃpuṭiteṣu sarvābharaṇayuktāḥ śvetarūpā upāsyāḥ |
analyzed: atas ūdhrvam sarve nṛsiṃha vyūhāḥ catur bhujāḥ nṛsiṃha ātmakāḥ ca īśvara vyūhaḥ īśvara āyudha gamyaḥ pūrveṣām pañcānām yathā saṃkhyam pañca śakti vyūhaḥ sarasvatī śrī gaurī prakṛti vidyā ātmikāḥ striyaḥ sva āyudhaiḥ gamyāḥ evam mūlamantra akṣareṣu daśasu aiśānīm diśam ārabhya praṇava saṃpuṭiteṣu sarva ābharaṇa yuktāḥ śveta rūpāḥ upāsyāḥ

original: evaṃ vakṣyamāṇāḥ sarve vyūhāḥ yathāsaṃkhyaṃ mūlamantrākṣareṣu upāsyāḥ | praṇavavyūhaḥ ekena praṇavākṣareṇa vakṣasi cihnataḥ praṇavacatuṣṭayamātraḥ vāsudevavigrahaḥ saśākhavedavigrahaḥ pañcāgnivigrahaḥ saptavyāhmativigrahaḥ aṣṭalokapālavigrahaḥ vasurudrādityāṣṭagrahapañcamahābhūtavigrahāḥ ekaikasminnṛsiṃhavyūhe yathāsaṃkhyamantarbhūtāḥ upāsyāḥ iti
analyzed: evam vakṣyamāṇāḥ sarve vyūhāḥ yathāsaṃkhyam mūlamantra akṣareṣu upāsyāḥ praṇava vyūhaḥ ekena praṇava akṣareṇa vakṣasi cihnataḥ praṇava catuṣṭaya mātraḥ vāsudeva vigrahaḥ sa śākha veda vigrahaḥ pañca agni vigrahaḥ sapta vyāhmati vigrahaḥ aṣṭa lokapāla vigrahaḥ vasu rudra āditya aṣṭa graha pañca mahābhūta vigrahāḥ ekaikasmin nṛsiṃha vyūhe yathāsaṃkhyam antarbhūtāḥ upāsyāḥ iti

original: daśa vyūhāḥ viśvarūpāḥ upāsyāḥ | kālamanumṛtyuyamāntakaprāṇasūryasomavirāṭpuruṣajīvarūpacetanācetanasarvātmakā ityete vyūhāḥ aviśvarūpāḥ tattadasādhāraṇarūpagamyāḥ evamekaikavyūhaḥ upāsyaḥ tena tena mantreṇa stutyaḥ tato devaḥ svātmānaṃ svakīyaṃ rūpaṃ viśvarūpam aviśvarūpaṃ ca yathāyogyaṃ darśayati |
analyzed: daśa vyūhāḥ viśva rūpāḥ upāsyāḥ kāla manu mṛtyu yama antaka prāṇa sūrya soma virāj puruṣa jīva rūpa cetana acetana sarva ātmakāḥ iti ete vyūhāḥ aviśva rūpāḥ tad tad asādhāraṇa rūpa gamyāḥ evam ekaika vyūhaḥ upāsyaḥ tena tena mantreṇa stutyaḥ tatas devaḥ sva ātmānam svakīyam rūpam viśva rūpam aviśva rūpam ca yathāyogyam darśayati

original: yasmādevaṃ tasmāt ya upāsakaḥ etairmantraiḥ nityaṃ niyamena stauti, sa devaṃ viśvarūpamaviśvarūpaṃ ca paśyati sākṣātkaroti | so'mṛtatvamityādi mahopaniṣadityantaṃ
analyzed: yasmāt evam tasmāt yaḥ upāsakaḥ etaiḥ mantraiḥ nityam niyamena stauti sa devam viśva rūpam aviśva rūpam ca paśyati sākṣātkaroti sa umṛta tvam ityādi mahā upaniṣad ityantam

original: spaṣṭārtham | tatra amṛtatvaṃ ca gacchatīti phalasya dvirabhyāsaḥ stutimātrādeva paramaphalāvāpta mantrāṇāṃ ca sāmathryaṃ darśayati | mahopaniṣacchabdaḥ praṇavabāhulyamiti sarvaṃ nirmalam ||
analyzed: spaṣṭa artham tatra amṛta tvam ca gacchati iti phalasya dvis abhyāsaḥ stuti mātrāt eva parama phala avāpta mantrāṇām ca sāmathryam darśayati mahā upaniṣad śabdaḥ praṇava bāhulyam iti sarvam nirmalam

original: iti śrīmatparamahaṃsaparivrājakācāryasya
analyzed: iti śrīmat paramahaṃsa parivrājaka ācāryasya

original: śrīgovindabhagavatpūjyapādaśiṣyasya
analyzed: śrī govinda bhagavat pūjya pāda śiṣyasya

original: śrīmacchaṃkarabhagavataḥ kṛtau
analyzed: śrīmat śaṃkara bhagavataḥ kṛtau

original: nṛsiṃhapūrvatāpanīyopaniṣadbhāṣye
caturthopaniṣadbhāṣyaṃ saṃpūrṇam ||
analyzed: caturtha upaniṣad bhāṣyam saṃpūrṇam

original: devā ha vai prajāpatimabrāuvanmahācakraṃ nāma cakraṃ no brāūhi bhagava iti sārvakāmikaṃ mokṣadvāraṃ yadyogina upadiśanti sa hovāca prajāpatiḥ ṣaḍaraṃ vā etatsudarśanaṃ mahācakraṃ tasmātṣaḍaraṃ bhavati ṣaṭpatraṃ cakraṃ bhavati ṣaḍvā ṛtava ṛtubhiḥ saṃmitaṃ bhavati madhye nābhirbhavati nābhyāṃ vā ete'rāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ |
analyzed: devāḥ ha vai prajāpatim abrāuvan mahācakram nāma cakram naḥ brāūhi bhagavaḥ iti sārvakāmikam mokṣa dvāram yat yoginaḥ upadiśanti sa ha uvāca prajāpatiḥ ṣaṣ aram vai etat sudarśanam mahā cakram tasmāt ṣaṣ aram bhavati ṣaṣ patram cakram bhavati ṣaṭ vai ṛtavaḥ ṛtubhiḥ saṃmitam bhavati madhye nābhiḥ bhavati nābhyām vai etāḥ irāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ

original: māyayā vā etatsarvaṃ veṣṭitaṃ bhavati nātmānaṃ māyā spṛśati tasmānmāyayā bahirveṣṭitaṃ bhavati | athāṣṭāramaṣṭapatraṃ cakraṃ bhavatyaṣṭābhakṣarā vai gāyatrī gāyatryā saṃmitaṃ bhavati bahirmāyayā veṣṭitaṃ bhavati kṣetraṃ kṣetraṃ vā māyaiṣā saṃpadyate |
analyzed: māyayā vai etat sarvam veṣṭitam bhavati na ātmānam māyā spṛśati tasmāt māyayā bahis veṣṭitam bhavati atha aṣṭa āram aṣṭa patram cakram bhavati aṣṭābha akṣarā vai gāyatrī gāyatryā saṃmitam bhavati bahis māyayā veṣṭitam bhavati kṣetram kṣetram vā māyā eṣā saṃpadyate

original: atha dvādaśāraṃ dvādaśapatraṃ cakraṃ bhavati dvādaśākṣarā vai jagatī jagatyā saṃmitaṃ bhavati bahirmāyayā veṣṭitaṃ bhavati | atha ṣoḍaśāraṃ ṣoḍaśapatraṃ cakraṃ bhavati ṣoḍaśakalo vai puruṣaḥ puruṣa evedaṃ sarvaṃ puruṣeṇa saṃmitaṃ bhavati māyayā bahirveṣṭitaṃ bhavati |
analyzed: atha dvādaśa aram dvādaśa patram cakram bhavati dvādaśa akṣarā vai jagatī jagatyā saṃmitam bhavati bahis māyayā veṣṭitam bhavati atha ṣoḍaśa aram ṣoḍaśa patram cakram bhavati ṣoḍaśa kalaḥ vai puruṣaḥ puruṣaḥ eva idam sarvam puruṣeṇa saṃmitam bhavati māyayā bahis veṣṭitam bhavati

original: atha dvātiṃraśadaraṃ dvātiṃraśatpatraṃ cakraṃ bhavati dvātiṃraśadakṣarā vā anuṣṭubanuṣṭubhā saṃmitaṃ bhavati bahirmāyayā veṣṭitaṃ bhavatyarairvā etatsubaddhaṃ bhavati vedā vā ete'rāḥ patrairvā etatsarvataḥ parikrāmati cchandāṃsi vai patrāṇi || 1 ||
analyzed: atha dvātiṃraśat aram dvātiṃraśat patram cakram bhavati dvātiṃraśat akṣarā vai anuṣṭubh anuṣṭubhā saṃmitam bhavati bahis māyayā veṣṭitam bhavati araiḥ vai etat su baddham bhavati vedāḥ vai etāḥ irāḥ patraiḥ vai etat sarvatas parikrāmati chandāṃsi vai patrāṇi

original: devāḥ prākstutiśravaṇenātyantaharṣitāḥ prajāpatimabrāuvan -- mahācakraṃ nāma etannāmadheyayuktaṃ cakram; yadvā etannāmadheyayuktameva cakraṃ vartulamuttarādharabhāvena sthitaṃ saccatuṣṭayāṅgavyāpakamastrākhyamaṅgaṃ naḥ asmabhyaṃ brāūhi bhagavaḥ bhagavanniti saṃbodhanam | sārvakāmikaṃ sarvakāmasādhanatvāt sārvakāmikam;
analyzed: devāḥ prāk stuti śravaṇena atyanta harṣitāḥ prajāpatim abrāuvan mahācakram nāma etat nāmadheya yuktam cakram yat vā etat nāmadheya yuktam eva cakram vartulam uttara adhara bhāvena sthitam sat catuṣṭaya aṅga vyāpakam astra ākhyam aṅgam naḥ asmabhyam brāūhi bhagavaḥ bhagavan iti saṃbodhanam sārvakāmikam sarva kāma sādhana tvāt sārvakāmikam

original: athavā sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ brāhṛādīnāṃ vyūhāḥ svātmatayaiva svabhāvatayaiva kāmitā yasmaścakre nābhivatryādyavyūhena tatsārvakāmikam | ata eva mokṣadvāraṃ praṇavabahulatvānmūlamantrākṣarasaṃkhyātaḥ praṇavasaṃpuṭīkaraṇātpraṇavākṣarasaṃkhyā dviguṇā catuḥṣaṣṭiḥ |
analyzed: athavā sarveṣām devānām brāhṛ ādīnām vyūhāḥ sva ātma tayā eva svabhāva tayā eva kāmitāḥ yasmaḥ cakre tat sārvakāmikam atas eva mokṣadvāram praṇava bahula tvāt mūlamantra akṣara saṃkhyātaḥ praṇava saṃpuṭīkaraṇāt praṇava akṣara saṃkhyā dviguṇā catuḥṣaṣṭiḥ

original: asyāṃ ca vidyāyāṃ mokṣaḥ praṇavadvāraka eva, ṭha dehānte devaḥ paraṃ brāhṛ tārakaṃ vyācaṣṭe ' iti śruteḥ | tataścāyamarthaḥ -- mokṣasya praṇavākhyaṃ dvāraṃ yasmastattathoktam | yaccakraṃ yoginaḥ upadiśantyupāsakebhyaḥ | sa hovāca prajāpatirityuktārtham |
analyzed: asyām ca vidyāyām mokṣaḥ praṇava dvārakaḥ eva dehānte devaḥ param tārakam vyācaṣṭe iti śruteḥ tatas ca ayam arthaḥ mokṣasya praṇava ākhyam dvāram yasmaḥ tat tathā uktam yat cakram yoginaḥ upadiśanti upāsakebhyaḥ sa ha uvāca prajāpatiḥ iti ukta artham

original: ṣaḍaraṃ vā etatsudarśanaṃ mahācakraṃ mahācakrasyaiva nāmāntaraṃ sudarśanamantrayogāt sudarśanam | yadvā suṣṭhu darśanaṃ vidyate yasmastathoktam | etatpatrādhobhāge nālarūpaḥ araśabdavācyaḥ | ṣaḍarā vidyante yasmastat ṣaḍaram, yasmādevaṃ tasmāt ṣaḍaraṃ bhavati |
analyzed: ṣaṣ aram vai etat sudarśanam mahā cakram mahā cakrasya eva nāma antaram sudarśana mantra yogāt sudarśanam yat vā suṣṭhu darśanam vidyate yasmaḥ tathā uktam etad patra adhobhāge nāla rūpaḥ ara śabda vācyaḥ ṣaṣ arāḥ vidyante yasmaḥ tat ṣaṣ aram yasmāt evam tasmāt ṣaṣ aram bhavati

original: ṣaṭpatraṃ cakraṃ bhavati arāduparibhāgaḥ koṇatrayayuktaḥ patrākṛtiḥ patram, ṣaṭpatrāṇi vidyante yasmastattathoktam | etadeva stauti -- ṣaḍvā ṛtavaḥ ṛtubhiḥ saṃmitaṃ bhavati | etasmādarthavādāt arāḥ patrāṇi ca ṛtubuddhyopāsyāni bhavanti | arāṇāṃ pratiṣṭhārthaṃ sthānamāha -- madhye cakrasya madhye nābhiḥ vartulākārā bhavati |
analyzed: ṣaṣ patram cakram bhavati arāt upari bhāgaḥ koṇa traya yuktaḥ patra ākṛtiḥ patram ṣaṣ patrāṇi vidyante yasmaḥ tat tathā uktam etat eva stauti ṣaṭ vai ṛtavaḥ ṛtubhiḥ saṃmitam bhavati etasmāt arthavādāt arāḥ patrāṇi ca ṛtu buddhyā upāsyāni bhavanti arāṇām pratiṣṭhā artham sthānam āha madhye cakrasya madhye nābhiḥ vartula ākārā bhavati

original: nābhyāṃ vai ete arāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ prāguktāḥ, tadādinyāyena patrāṇi ca prāguktāni | māyayā prāguktena mūlamantraśaktyakṣareṇa etatṣaḍaraṃ ṣaṭpatraṃ sarvaṃ veṣṭitaṃ bhavati | yasmāt na ātmānaṃ cakrasya svarūpam arapatrātmakaṃ māyā spṛśati tasmānmāyayā bahirveṣṭitaṃ bhavati;
analyzed: nābhyām vai ete arāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ prāk uktāḥ tad ādi nyāyena patrāṇi ca prāk uktāni māyayā prāk uktena mūlamantra śakti akṣareṇa etat ṣaṣ aram ṣaṣ patram sarvam veṣṭitam bhavati yasmāt na ātmānam cakrasya svarūpam ara patra ātmakam māyā spṛśati tasmāt māyayā bahis veṣṭitam bhavati

original: yadvā pratyakacaitanyameva kevalaṃ śuddhaṃ cakrabuddhyopāsyaṃ yasmāt tasmādātmānaṃ pratyakcaitanyaṃ na māyā spṛśati māyāvinamiva | tasmānmāyayā bahirveṣṭitaṃ bhavati | aṣṭāram aṣṭapatraṃ cakraṃ dvādaśāraṃ dvādaśapatraṃ cakraṃ ṣoḍaśāraṃ ṣoḍaśapatraṃ cakraṃ dvātiṃraśadaraṃ dvātiṃraśatpatraṃ cakramiti catuṣṭayaṃ ṣaḍaraṣaṭpatracakreṇa vyākhyātam |
analyzed: yat vā pratyaka caitanyam eva kevalam śuddham cakra buddhyā upāsyam yasmāt tasmāt ātmānam pratyak caitanyam na māyā spṛśati māyāvinam iva tasmāt māyayā bahis veṣṭitam bhavati aṣṭa āram aṣṭa patram cakram dvādaśa aram dvādaśa patram cakram ṣoḍaśa aram ṣoḍaśa patram cakram dvātiṃraśat aram dvātiṃraśat patram cakram iti catuṣṭayam ṣaṣ ara ṣaṣ patra cakreṇa vyākhyātam

original: tatrāyaṃ viśeṣaḥ -- ādyapatre arāḥ patrāṇi ca ṛtubuddhyopāsyāni | dvitīyatṛtīyapañmameṣu arāḥ vedabuddhyā upāsyāḥ patrāṇi gāyatrījagatyanuṣṭubbuddhyā yathāsaṃkhyamupāsyāni | vedā eva arāḥ chandāṃsi vai patrāṇī -- ityarthavādāt | caturthe patre ṣoḍaśārāḥ ṣoḍaśapatrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśakalābuddhyā upāsyāni | kṣetraṃ kṣetraṃ vā māyaiṣā saṃpadyate |
analyzed: tatra ayam viśeṣaḥ ādya patre arāḥ patrāṇi ca ṛtu buddhyā upāsyāni dvitīya tṛtīya pañmameṣu arāḥ veda buddhyā upāsyāḥ patrāṇi gāyatrī jagatī anuṣṭubh buddhyā yathāsaṃkhyam upāsyāni vedāḥ eva arāḥ chandāṃsi vai patrāṇī iti arthavādāt caturthe patre ṣoḍaśa arāḥ ṣoḍaśa patrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa kalā buddhyā upāsyāni kṣetram kṣetram vā māyā eṣā saṃpadyate

original: iti aṣṭamādhyāyabhāṣyam ||
analyzed: iti aṣṭama adhyāya bhāṣyam

original: tacchabdena dvātiṃraśadaraṃ dvātiṃraśatpatraṃ cakram evaśabdena tadevāvadhṛtya tadeva cakraṃ tadādinyāyena sudarśanādiśabdairūdhrvaṃ cakracatuṣṭayamapi mahācakrātmakamiti darśayati | mahācakramiti sāmānādhikaraṇyācca | tasya madhye mahācakrasya madhye madhyavartinābhyāṃ veṣṭanarūpā hi nābhayo bhūmadhyāḥ tāḥ vyāvartayituṃ madhye nābhyāmityuktam |
analyzed: tad śabdena dvātiṃraśat aram dvātiṃraśat patram cakram evaśabdena tat eva avadhṛtya tat eva cakram tad ādi nyāyena sudarśana ādi śabdaiḥ ūdhrvam cakra catuṣṭayam api mahācakra ātmakam iti darśayati mahācakram iti sāmānādhikaraṇyāt ca tasya madhye mahācakrasya madhye madhya varti nābhyām veṣṭana rūpāḥ hi nābhayaḥ bhū madhyāḥ tāḥ vyāvartayitum madhye nābhyām iti uktam

original: tārakaṃ bhavati saṃsāratārakatvāt tārakaṃ praṇavākṣaraṃ bhavati | yadakṣaraṃ nārasiṃhamekākṣaraṃ tadbhavatīti akṣaram, jagaddhitaṃ vā etadrūpamakṣaramiti nṛsiṃhapadavyākhyānāvasare vyākhyātaṃ tadakṣaraśabdātpratyabhijñāyate | tathā nārasiṃhamiti taddhitātsāmaprabhṛtyupāsyaṃ sarvaṃ pratīyate |
analyzed: tārakam bhavati saṃsāra tāraka tvāt tārakam praṇava akṣaram bhavati yat akṣaram nārasiṃham eka akṣaram tat bhavati iti akṣaram jagat hitam vā etat rūpam akṣaram iti nṛsiṃha pada vyākhyāna avasare vyākhyātam tat akṣara śabdāt pratyabhijñāyate tathā nārasiṃham iti taddhitāt sāma prabhṛti upāsyam sarvam pratīyate

original: tataḥ sarvasminnupāsye pratīte ekamevopāsyaṃ mūlanṛsiṃhavyūhākhyaṃ vaktuṃ viśinaṣṭi -- ekākṣaraṃ tadbhavatīti | yadakṣaraṃ nārasiṃhamupāsyam ityanūdya tadekaṃ bhavatītyakṣaraṃ ca iti mahācakramadhyanābhivartitvena kṣīrodārṇavasaṃbandhitayā upāsanaṃ vidhīyata ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: tatas sarvasmin upāsye pratīte ekam eva upāsyam mūla nṛsiṃha vyūha ākhyam vaktum viśinaṣṭi ekākṣaram tat bhavati iti yat akṣaram nārasiṃham upāsyam iti anūdya tat ekam bhavati iti akṣaram ca iti mahācakra madhya nābhi varti tvena kṣīroda arṇava saṃbandhi tayā upāsanam vidhīyate iti arthaḥ

original: tatra kecit nārasiṃhamekākṣaram iti viśeṣaṇopādānāt ekākṣaranṛsiṃhamiśritapraṇavo nābhyāṃ nyasanīya ityācakṣate; tadapi sāṃpradāyikatvānna viruddham | tasminnapi pakṣe nārasiṃhamiti taddhitāt ekākṣaro nṛsiṃhamantraḥ praṇavamiśrito dvātiṃraśannṛsiṃhavyūhaṃ vihāya yāvatprākaraṇikaṃ mūlanṛsiṃhavyūhagatamupāsyaṃ pratīyata eva |
analyzed: tatra kecid nārasiṃham eka akṣaram iti viśeṣaṇa upādānāt eka akṣara nṛsiṃha miśrita praṇavaḥ nābhyām nyasanīyaḥ iti ācakṣate tat api sāṃpradāyika tvāt na viruddham tasmin api pakṣe nārasiṃham iti taddhitāt eka akṣaraḥ nṛsiṃha mantraḥ praṇava miśritaḥ dvātiṃraśat nṛsiṃha vyūham vihāya yāvat prākaraṇikam mūla nṛsiṃha vyūha gatam upāsyam pratīyate eva

original: tataśca etadvidyāṅgamekākṣaro nṛsiṃhamantro yathoktopāsyābhidhāyakatvāt tasya kevalaḥ praṇavena vikalpaḥ ekākṣaranṛsiṃhamantrasya praṇavastu niyata eveti
analyzed: tatas ca etad vidyā aṅgam eka akṣaraḥ nṛsiṃha mantraḥ yathā ukta upāsya abhidhāyaka tvāt tasya kevalaḥ praṇavena vikalpaḥ eka akṣara nṛsiṃha mantrasya praṇavaḥ tu niyataḥ eva iti

original: tattvārthaḥ | ata ūdhrvaṃ tattanmantranyāse tattaccakreṣu patragrahaṇam aratadantarālapatrāntarālavyāvṛttyarthaṃ draṣṭavyam | ṣaṭsu patreṣu sudarśanaṃ bhavati | aiśānapatramārabhya ṣaḍakṣaraḥ sudarśano mantro nyasanīya ityarthaḥ | evamuttareṣu patreṣu yojyam | aṣṭasu patreṣvaṣṭākṣaraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ bhavati | praṇavāntarbhāvenāṣṭākṣarateti kecit |
analyzed: tattva arthaḥ atas ūdhrvam tad tad mantra nyāse tad tad cakreṣu patra grahaṇam draṣṭavyam ṣaṭsu patreṣu sudarśanam bhavati aiśāna patram ārabhya ṣaṣ akṣaraḥ sudarśanaḥ mantraḥ nyasanīyaḥ iti arthaḥ evam uttareṣu patreṣu yojyam aṣṭasu patreṣu aṣṭa akṣaram nārāyaṇam bhavati praṇava antarbhāvena aṣṭa akṣara tā iti kecid

original: tadvadeva dvādaśapatreṣu dvādaśākṣaraṃ vāsudevaṃ bhavatīti | atrāpi dvādaśākṣaratā pūrvavat | ṣoḍaśapatreṣu mātṛkāmantravarṇasya ādyā varṇamātṛkādyāḥ sabindukā bindusahitāḥ ṣoḍaśa svarā bhavanti | dvātiṃraśatsu patreṣu dvātiṃraśadakṣaraṃ sāmābhivyaktaṃ mantrarājamānuṣṭubhaṃ bhavati | mūlamantrasyaiva ekaikamakṣaram |
analyzed: tadvat eva dvādaśa patreṣu dvādaśa akṣaram vāsudevam bhavati iti atra api dvādaśa akṣara tā pūrvavat ṣoḍaśa patreṣu mātṛkā mantra varṇasya ādyāḥ varṇa mātṛkā ādyāḥ sa bindukāḥ bindu sahitāḥ ṣoḍaśa svarāḥ bhavanti dvātiṃraśatsu patreṣu dvātiṃraśat akṣaram sāma abhivyaktam mantrarājam ānuṣṭubham bhavati mūlamantrasya eva ekaikam akṣaram

original: yattu ekaikamakṣaram ekaikasminpatre tatpraṇavasaṃpuṭitaṃ kāryam, ṭha pratyakṣaramubhayata oṃkāro bhavati ' iti śruteḥ | tadastrākhyamaṅgaṃ mahācakramupāsitaṃ tannikṣiptamaniṣṭe vastuni trāsakāritvāt tadastraṃ pañcamamaṅgam | ata eva astrāṅgamantraṃ vyācakṣāṇairasmābhiruktaṃ prapañcasāre -- ṭha asutrāsādikau dhātū staḥ kṣepacalanārthakau |
analyzed: yat tu ekaikam akṣaram ekaikasmin patre tat praṇava saṃpuṭitam kāryam pratyakṣaram ubhayatas oṃkāraḥ bhavati iti śruteḥ tat astra ākhyam aṅgam mahācakram upāsitam tat nikṣiptam aniṣṭe vastuni trāsa kāri tvāt tat astram pañcamam aṅgam atas eva astra aṅgamantram vyācakṣāṇaiḥ asmābhiḥ uktam prapañcasāre asu trāsa ādikau dhātū staḥ kṣepa calana arthakau

original: tābhyāmaniṣṭamākṣipya kṣipyate phaṭkhaḍagninā ' iti | sārvakāmikaṃ mokṣadvāramityuktārtham | ṛṅmayaṃ yajurmayaṃ sāmamayaṃ brāhṛmayamamṛtamayaṃ bhavatīti pañca mayaṭpratyayāḥ prācuryārthā grāhrāḥ | ṛgyajuḥsāmātharvapracuram | brāhṛmayamiti brāhṛśabdena atharvavedaḥ so'yaṃ brāhṛ veda
analyzed: tābhyām aniṣṭam ākṣipya kṣipyate phaṭ khaṭ agninā iti sārvakāmikam mokṣa dvāram iti ukta artham ṛk mayam yajuḥ mayam sāma mayam brāhṛ mayam amṛta mayam bhavati iti pañca mayaṭ pratyayāḥ prācurya arthāḥ grāhrāḥ ṛk yajuḥ sāma atharva pracuram brāhṛ mayam iti brāhṛ śabdena atharvavedaḥ saḥ yam brāhṛ veda

original: ityetadbrāāhṛṇābhidhānāt | vedapracuratā arāṇāṃ vedabuddhyopāsyatvāt | vikārārtho vā mayaṭ vedavikārātmakā ityarthaḥ | amṛtamayaṃ kṣīrapracuranābhikaṃ kṣīravikāranābhikaṃ vā iti | tasyeti tacchabdānnābhistho viṣṇuḥ mūlanṛsiṃhavyūhaḥ parāmṛśyate |
analyzed: iti etat brāāhṛṇa abhidhānāt veda pracura tā arāṇām veda buddhyā upāsya tvāt vikāra arthaḥ vā mayaṭ veda vikāra ātmakāḥ iti arthaḥ amṛta mayam kṣīra pracura nābhikam kṣīra vikāra nābhikam vā iti tasya iti tad śabdāt nābhi sthaḥ viṣṇuḥ mūla nṛsiṃha vyūhaḥ parāmṛśyate

original: tatparicārakāndevānāha -- purastādvasavaḥ paricārikā āsate rudrā dakṣiṇata ādityāḥ paścādviśve devā uttarato brāhṛviṣṇumaheśvarā nābhyāmiti | evaṃ diṅnābhiparicārakānuktvā athedānīṃ pāśrvaparicārakānāha -- sūryācandramasau pāśrvayoḥ kukṣipradeśayoriti yāvat | tadetanmahācakram ṛcā abhyuktam |
analyzed: tad paricārakān devān āha purastāt vasavaḥ paricārikāḥ āsate rudrāḥ dakṣiṇatas ādityāḥ paścāt viśve devāḥ uttaratas brāhṛ viṣṇu maheśvarāḥ nābhyām iti evam diś nābhi paricārakān uktvā atha idānīm pāśrva paricārakān āha sūryācandramasau pāśrvayoḥ kukṣi pradeśayoḥ iti yāvat tat etat mahā cakram ṛcā abhyuktam

original: yasmin mahācakre, akṣare, aśū vyāptāvityasya rūpaṃ saro matvarthe, tasminvyāptimati | parame utkṛṣṭe vyomavatsarvavyāpakatvena sthite | adhītyuparibhāve | ṛca iti ṛggrahaṇam upalakṣaṇārtham | ṛcaḥ vedāḥ niṣeduḥ yasmin cakre viśve sarve devāḥ nṛsiṃharūpeṇa niṣeduḥ sthitāḥ | yadvā ṛca iti ṣaṣṭhī |
analyzed: yasmin mahācakre akṣare aśū vyāptau iti asya rūpam saraḥ tasmin vyāptimati parame utkṛṣṭe vyoma vat sarva vyāpaka tvena sthite adhi iti upari bhāve ṛcaḥ iti ṛc grahaṇam upalakṣaṇa artham ṛcaḥ vedāḥ niṣeduḥ yasmin cakre viśve sarve devāḥ nṛsiṃha rūpeṇa niṣeduḥ sthitāḥ yat vā ṛcaḥ iti ṣaṣṭhī

original: anuṣṭupsaṃbandhini akṣare vyāptimati cakre sarve vedāḥ sthitāḥ tatsudarśanamantrādisaṃbandhi cakramityarthaḥ | ya upāsakaḥ tanmahācakraṃ na veda nopāste kim ṛcā ṛgvedādinā yadi vā ṛcā anuṣṭupchandaskayā ṛcā iti | anenaitaddarśayati -- mahācakropāsanagarbhitameva anuṣṭubupāsanaṃ kuryāt na tu tadrahitamiti |
analyzed: anuṣṭubh saṃbandhini akṣare vyāptimati cakre sarve vedāḥ sthitāḥ tat sudarśana mantra ādi saṃbandhi cakram iti arthaḥ yaḥ upāsakaḥ tat mahācakram na veda na upāste kim ṛcā ṛgveda ādinā yadi vā ṛcā anuṣṭubh chandaskayā ṛcā iti anena etat darśayati mahācakra upāsana garbhitam eva anuṣṭubh upāsanam kuryāt na tu tad rahitam iti

original: ya ittadvidusta ime samāsata ityuktārtham | itiśabdaḥ ṛksamāpta dyotayati | tadetanmahācakraṃ bālo vā yuvā vā veda upāste tasya idaṃ phalam -- sa mahānbhavati | mahatīṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ jane prāpnoti | yadi vā mahān mahāviṣṇuriti | sa guruḥ sarvaiḥ devavadārādhyaḥ | sa sarveṣāṃ mantrāṇāmupadeṣṭā bhavatyupadeśakaḥ |
analyzed: ye id tat viduḥ te ime samāsate iti ukta artham iti śabdaḥ dyotayati tat etat mahā cakram bālaḥ vā yuvā vā vede upāste tasya idam phalam sa mahān bhavati mahatīm pratiṣṭhām jane prāpnoti yadi vā mahān mahā viṣṇuḥ iti sa guruḥ sarvaiḥ deva vat ārādhyaḥ sa sarveṣām mantrāṇām upadeṣṭā bhavati upadeśakaḥ

original: sāmābhivyaktānuṣṭubhā homaṃ kuryāditi vidyāṅgo'yaṃ homaḥ tasmindravyānupādānāt pratidinaṃ haviṣyamannaṃ sājyaṃ juhuyāditi | tathā sakhyānupādānātsakṛddvādaśavāraṃ vā | yadi vā sūtrāgatadaśapadānāṃ mūlanṛsiṃhavyūhe dvātiṃraśadvyūhe ca vyākhyātatvāt ubhayoddeśena homaṃ kuryāt |
analyzed: sāma abhivyakta anuṣṭubhā homam kuryāt iti homaḥ tasmin dravya anupādānāt pratidinam haviṣyam annam sa ājyam juhuyāt iti tathā sakhya anupādānāt sakṛt dvādaśa vāram vā yadi vā sūtra āgata daśa padānām mūla nṛsiṃha vyūhe ca vyākhyāta tvāt ubhaya uddeśena homam kuryāt

original: tataśca kṣīrodārṇavaśāyine nṛsiṃhāya trinetrāya pinākahastāyogrāyedam iti hutvā | brāhṛādidvātiṃraśadvyūhātmakāya nṛsiṃhāyogrāyeti juhuyāt ityevaṃ pratipadaṃ mūlamantrāvṛttiḥ | yadvā anuṣṭubhā ityekavacanāt sakṛnmūlamantramuccārya svāhākārāntaṃ juhuyāt pratipadam uddiśya tyāgaḥ kāryaḥ |
analyzed: tatas ca kṣīroda arṇava śāyine nṛsiṃhāya trinetrāya pinākahastāya ugrāya idam iti hutvā nṛsiṃhāya ugrāya iti juhuyāt iti evam pratipadam mūlamantra āvṛttiḥ yat vā anuṣṭubhā iti ekavacanāt sakṛt mūlamantram uccārya svāhākāra antam juhuyāt pratipadam uddiśya tyāgaḥ kāryaḥ

original: tathā sāmābhivyaktānuṣṭubhā arcanaṃ ṣoḍaśopacārādi kuryādityanuṣaṅgaḥ | atrāpi homamantravanmantrāvṛttyanāvṛttī eṣṭavye |
analyzed: tathā sāma abhivyakta anuṣṭubhā arcanam ṣoḍaśa upacāra ādi kuryāt iti anuṣaṅgaḥ atra api homa mantra vat mantra āvṛtti anāvṛttī eṣṭavye

original: tadetanmahācakraṃ rakṣoghnaṃ mṛtyutārakaṃ guruprasādāllabdhaṃ kaṇṭhe bāhau śikhāyāṃ vā badhnīta yaḥ tasmai gurave yasmātsaptadvīpavatī dviguṇāvṛttāpi bhūmiḥ pṛthivī dakṣiṇārthaṃ nāvakalpate, tasmācchraddhayā bhaktyā yāṃ kāṃcidbhūmiṃ yathāśaktyanurūpāṃ dadyāt sā dakṣiṇā bhavati |
analyzed: tat etat mahā cakram rakṣaḥ ghnam mṛtyu tārakam guru prasādāt labdham kaṇṭhe bāhau śikhāyām vā badhnīta yaḥ tasmai gurave yasmāt sapta dvīpavatī dviguṇa āvṛttā api bhūmiḥ pṛthivī dakṣiṇā artham na avakalpate tasmāt śraddhayā bhaktyā yām kāṃcid bhūmim yathāśakti anurūpām dadyāt sā dakṣiṇā bhavati

original: evaṃ prāguktaṃ śrutita upāsanamavagataṃ pañcāṅganyāsa upasaṃhmatamekasmānmatāt | atha matāntaraparyālocanayā mahācakra evopasaṃhmataṃ tasmātpratyakṣaramubhayata oṃkāro bhavatītyatra mūlamantrākṣarāṇāṃ praṇava upasaṃhmatatvāt praṇavapradhānamevedaṃ mahācakraṃ tasmiñśaktibāhulyaśravaṇānmāyayā bahirveṣṭitaṃ bhavati |
analyzed: evam prāguktam śrutitaḥ upāsanam avagatam pañcāṅganyāsaḥ upasaṃhmatam ekasmāt matāt atha mata antara paryālocanayā mahācakre eva upasaṃhmatam tasmāt pratyakṣaram ubhayatas oṃkāraḥ bhavati iti atra mūlamantra akṣarāṇām praṇavaḥ upasaṃhmata tvāt praṇava pradhānam eva idam mahācakram tasmin śakti bāhulya śravaṇāt māyayā bahis veṣṭitam bhavati

original: bahirmāyayā veṣṭitaṃ bhavatītyasakṛcchravaṇāt uddhṛtapadavyākhyānāvasare pratipadaṃ yasmātsvamahimnā sarvālm̐lokānsarvāndevānsarvānātmanaḥ sarvāṇi bhūtānītyasakṛnmahimaśabdavācyāyā māyāyāḥ sarvalokasarvadevātmabhūtānāṃ sādhanatvena śravaṇāt tadveṣṭitamāyādhāratvena yathāsaṃkhyaṃ pṛthivyādilokagrvedādivedāgnyādidevabhūtānāmātmanāṃ ca
analyzed: bahis māyayā veṣṭitam bhavati iti asakṛt śravaṇāt uddhṛta pada vyākhyāna avasare pratipadam yasmāt sva mahimnā sarvān lokān sarvān devān sarvān ātmanaḥ sarvāṇi bhūtāni iti asakṛt mahima śabda vācyāyāḥ māyāyāḥ sarva loka sarva deva ātma bhūtānām sādhana tvena śravaṇāt tad veṣṭita māyā dhāra tvena yathāsaṃkhyam ca

original: sādhanatvaśravaṇānmahācakrāntargataveṣṭitamāyādhāramevedamupāsanam | na tu mūlanṛsiṃhagataṃ pañcāṅganyāsārthaṃ ca antaraṅgatvānmahācakramevedamupāsanam | tadapi saṃpradāyāgatamupādeyamityupāsanāvikalpaḥ | tatrāpi bahutaraṃ saṃpradāyānukūlyāgatatvāt antyamevopāsanamupādeyamiti kecit |
analyzed: sādhana tva śravaṇāt mahācakra antargata veṣṭita māyā ādhāram eva idam upāsanam na tu mūla nṛsiṃha gatam pañcāṅga nyāsa artham ca antaraṅga tvāt mahācakram eva idam upāsanam tat api saṃpradāya āgatam upādeyam iti upāsana avikalpaḥ tatra api bahutaram saṃpradāya ānukūlya āgata tvāt antyam eva upāsanam upādeyam iti kecid

original: tasminmate praṇavasāvitrayajurlakṣmīnṛsiṃhagāyatrīti mantracatuṣṭayamaṅgaṃ sāmābhivyaktaṃ yathāyogyatayā mahācakraprakāśakatvena yojyaṃ tathaivopāsyaṃ mahācakramiti rahasyaṃ tattvaṃ ca iti ||
analyzed: tasmin mate praṇava sāvitra yajuḥ lakṣmī nṛsiṃha gāyatrī iti mantra catuṣṭayam aṅgam sāma abhivyaktam yathā yogyatayā mahācakra prakāśaka tvena yojyam tathā eva upāsyam mahācakram iti rahasyam tattvam ca iti

original: evaṃ nṛsiṃhabrāhṛvidyāṃ sakalamatānusāriṇīṃ kṛtsnāmabhidhāya, athedānīṃ tadanuṣṭhātuḥ kaimutyanyāyena phalakathanāya praśnottararūpākhyāyikāmavatārayati --
analyzed: evam nṛsiṃhabrāhṛ vidyām sakala mata anusāriṇīm kṛtsnām abhidhāya atha idānīm tad anuṣṭhātuḥ kaimutya nyāyena phala kathanāya praśnottara rūpa ākhyāyikām avatārayati

original: prathamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
analyzed: prathamaḥ adhyāyaḥ

original: atha upāsyopāsakabhāvena cedanuṣṭubvidyā tasya nṛsiṃhasya viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padaṃ paramaṃ sthānaṃ mahācakranābhikṣīrodārṇavaprabhṛti tatra sthitāḥ upāsakāḥ anuṣṭhātāraḥ japtāraḥ adhyetāro vā sadā sarvakālaṃ paśyanti |
analyzed: atha upāsya upāsaka bhāvena ced anuṣṭubh vidyā tasya nṛsiṃhasya viṣṇoḥ paramam padam paramam sthānam mahā cakra nābhi kṣīroda arṇava prabhṛti tatra sthitāḥ upāsakāḥ anuṣṭhātāraḥ japtāraḥ adhyetāraḥ vā sadā sarvakālam paśyanti

original: kīdṛśaṃ tadityapekṣite, āha -- divīva dyuloka iva cakṣuḥ khyāteḥ sūryamaṇḍalam ātatam ā samantāt tataṃ vistṛtaṃ vartulaṃ prakāśātmakaṃ sarvaprakāśābhibhavakāraṇam ataḥ sūryacandranakṣatrādīnāṃ brāhṛṇi praveśaḥ pratiṣiddhaḥ tapakartṛtā ca yatra sūryo na tapatītyādinā |
analyzed: kīdṛśam tat iti apekṣite āha divi iva dyu lokaḥ iva cakṣuḥ khyāteḥ sūrya maṇḍalam ātatam ā samantāt tatam vistṛtam vartulam prakāśa ātmakam sarva prakāśa abhibhava kāraṇam atas sūrya candra nakṣatra ādīnām brāhṛṇi praveśaḥ pratiṣiddhaḥ tapa kartṛ tā ca yatra sūryaḥ na tapati ityādinā

original: evaṃ tasmin ādhidaivātmake duḥkhe pratiṣiddhe ādhyātmikaduḥkhaprāptau tatpratiṣedhati -- yatra na duḥkhamiti | viduḥkhatā duḥkhābhāvamātre prāpte, suṣuptavajjaḍatā syāditi tadvyāvṛttyarthaṃ sadānandamiti | brāhṛādivanditamiti | tadādinyāyena nābhisthabrāhṛviṣṇumaheśvaraiḥ paricārakaiḥ vandanīyaṃ mahācakrākhyaṃ sthānam | yatra gatveti |
analyzed: evam tasmin ādhidaiva ātmake duḥkhe pratiṣiddhe ādhyātmika duḥkha prāptau tat pratiṣedhati yatra na duḥkham iti viduḥkhatā duḥkha abhāva mātre prāpte suṣupta vat jaḍa tā syāt iti tad vyāvṛtti artham sat ānandam iti brāhṛ ādi vanditam iti tad ādi nyāyena nābhi stha brāhṛ viṣṇu maheśvaraiḥ paricārakaiḥ vandanīyam mahācakra ākhyam sthānam yatra gatvā iti

original: tasya gantavyatāmāha -- tadviprāsa iti | tattādṛśaṃ sthānaṃ viprāsaḥ viprāḥ brāāhṛṇāḥ upāsakāḥ vipanyavaḥ medhāvinaḥ samādhau dhāraṇaśaktiyuktāḥ | jāgṛvāṃsaḥ jāgaritāvasthāyāmeva avasthātrayātpracyutya samindhate samṛdiṃdha kurvanti | tādātmyapakṣe tu mantrabrāāhṛṇayoryathāsvarūpaṃ vyākhyeyam | itiśabdo mantrasamāpta dyotayati |
analyzed: tasya gantavya tām āha tat viprāsaḥ iti tat tādṛśam sthānam viprāsaḥ viprāḥ brāāhṛṇāḥ upāsakāḥ vipanyavaḥ medhāvinaḥ samādhau dhāraṇa śakti yuktāḥ jāgṛvāṃsaḥ jāgarita avasthāyām eva avasthā trayāt pracyutya samindhate kurvanti tādātmya pakṣe tu mantra brāāhṛṇayoḥ yathāsvarūpam vyākhyeyam iti śabdaḥ mantra samāpta dyotayati

original: padacatuṣṭayābhyāsaḥ sarvopaniṣatsamāpta dyotayatīti sarvaṃ nirmalaṃ siddham ||
analyzed: pada catuṣṭaya abhyāsaḥ sarva upaniṣad samāpta dyotayati iti sarvam nirmalam siddham

original: iti aṣṭamādhyāyabhāṣyam ||
analyzed: iti aṣṭama adhyāya bhāṣyam

original: iti śrīmatparamahaṃsaparivrājakācāryasya
analyzed: iti śrīmat paramahaṃsa parivrājaka ācāryasya

original: śrīgovindabhagavatpūjyapādaśiṣyasya
analyzed: śrī govinda bhagavat pūjya pāda śiṣyasya

original: śrīmacchaṃkarabhagavataḥ kṛtau
analyzed: śrīmat śaṃkara bhagavataḥ kṛtau

original: nṛsiṃhapūrvatāpanīyopaniṣadbhāṣyaṃ
saṃpūrṇam ||
